Trump and his MAGA acolytes will do anything they can to suppress votes in the midterms. They are so scared of the voice of the people that they're willing to try and use the USPS to reject and toss out your legitimate ballot.
RUSH $35 or more to fight these suppressive policies, defend mail-in voting, and make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062926_4&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Let us be very clear, Team: The Constitution places the authority to run elections squarely with the states and Congress – not with the Executive branch .
However, Trump has issued executive order after executive order, trying to impose sweeping new federal controls over our elections.
His latest executive order, targeting the USPS, is just another unlawful attempt by this MAGA administration to sow chaos ahead of the fall midterm elections. We cannot allow overreach of this magnitude to go unchecked.
Fuel our work to protect our fundamental right to vote with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062926_4&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062926_4&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062926_4&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062926_4&amount=50]

Trump's executive order purports to address “noncitizen voting,” which is one of his obsessions. Instead, the latest executive order is dangerous, unlawful, and harmful to voters.
Here's the truth:
➜ States already have proven systems in place to verify voter eligibility
➜ Noncitizen voting is already a federal crime
➜ Instances of noncitizen voting are incredibly rare
Rather than solving actual problems, Trump is prioritizing his fever dreams and fears about losing the midterms to manufacture problems. MAGA is desperate to justify granting the federal government unprecedented authority over an election process that the Constitution clearly delegates to the states and to Congress.
We can't sit by and stay silent while our right to vote is attacked. Help us fight back with $35 or whatever you can to protect mail-in voting and stop Trump's suppressive policies >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062926_4&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:
Peter

My name is Melanie Lucero, and I'm running to be the Republican nominee for Congress in Virginia's 5th District.

I'm a United States Marine Corps veteran, former Intelligence Community member, small business owner, and housing expert. I'm not a career politician. I'm running because our district deserves a representative who fights for the people, not the political establishment.

Early voting is NOW OPEN, and Republican Primary Election Day is August 4.

This is an unusual time of year to hold an election in Virginia, and many voters don't realize voting has already begun. That's why your vote and support are so important.

When elected, I'll fight to lower costs, eliminate government fraud, waste, and abuse, improve healthcare access and reduce high premiums, defend our constitutional freedoms, protect the Second Amendment, secure our border, and always put America First.

Campaigns shouldn't be won by special interests. They should be won by hardworking Americans who believe we can do better.

If you're able, please consider making a contribution today. Individuals may contribute up to $3,500 and couples up to $7,000, but every dollar helps us reach more voters and grow this grassroots campaign.

He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards. After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA 's collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation - not just posturing through press statements, but through policy. Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read "Free The Uyghurs." After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc. Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans. PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE P.O. We’re a little behind, but we can catch up with your help.
#
Peter,
Right now, millions of eligible Latino voters are still unregistered, even though upcoming elections in key states could be decided by razor-thin margins.
That’s the gap we’re working on closing. Which is why we’ve set a critical goal to raise **$30,000 by tomorrow at midnight** to fully fund this urgent work. And right now, we’re exactly **52% of the way there.**
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260629-2.T_tlGn&refcode=em20260629-324&t=1&akid=324%2E1366028%2EvDqnrh)
As you can see, we still have a way to go, and the clock is ticking. **[Can you rush $26 — the cost of registering one voter — right now to help us reach our goal by June 30 and register Latino voters?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260629-2.T_tlGn&refcode=em20260629-324&t=2&akid=324%2E1366028%2EvDqnrh)**
Our organizing is focused on finding those unregistered voters, helping them register, and turning them out, because when Latino voters participate at full strength, we can change election outcomes.
But Trump and anti-democracy politicians know the strength and power Latinos have when we show up in big numbers. That’s why they’re pushing voter suppression laws and attacks meant to discourage our communities from participating.
Our path to building a movement they can’t ignore is simple. Register more Latino voters, mobilize them, and show up at the ballot box.
**[Will you chip in $26 right now to help us close the gap and hit our goal by tomorrow at midnight?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260629-2.T_tlGn&refcode=em20260629-324&t=3&akid=324%2E1366028%2EvDqnrh)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

body:
$5, Peter.
That's the amount I'm asking you to split between my campaign for Governor of Georgia and Gina Hinojosa before the June 30 fundraising deadline.
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-1459&t=1&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)
$5 because Donald Trump and his allies are working every day to drag our country backward.
$5 because Georgia has always been on the front lines of the fight for our democracy.
$5 because the decisions we make in this election won't just shape the next four years — they'll shape the future of our state for a generation.
**_$5 because I’m facing my first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since becoming the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Georgia, and I need your help._**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-1459&t=2&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)
You might think a single $5 contribution can't make much of a difference in a race as important as this one.
But campaigns like ours aren't powered by billionaires or corporate special interests.
They're powered by people: Teachers. Nurses. Students. Retirees. Working families.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-1459&t=3&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)
People chipping in $5, $10, or $25 because they believe Georgia deserves leadership that will fight for affordable housing, good jobs, strong public schools, reproductive freedom, and the right to vote.
And when enough people step up, it adds up fast.
That's how we build the grassroots campaign it will take to win and fight back against the flood of MAGA money that is already pouring into Georgia.
**[So today, I'm asking: Will you split a $5 contribution between my campaign for Governor of Georgia and Gina Hinojosa's campaign for Governor of Texas before the June 30 end-of-quarter deadline? My team and I will put your donation to work immediately, reaching voters, organizing communities, and building the campaign we need to move Georgia forward.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&refcode=em20260629-1459&amount=5&t=4&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)**

Thank you for being part of this fight.
Gratefully,
Keisha Lance Bottoms

my name is Cait Conley, and I am the official Democratic nominee against Mike Lawler in NY-17. I’m a proud fourth-generation Hudson Valley native from a blue-collar family. After graduating from West Point, I spent 16 years as an active-duty Army officer, deploying six times overseas to keep America safe. Now, I’m running for Congress in one of the toughest battleground districts in the entire country. This is one of only three House districts nationwide that split their ticket for Kamala Harris and a Republican member of Congress in 2024. Lawler is beatable – but only if we’re able to go toe-to-toe with him, communicating with voters across the district. name: Roy Cooper
subject: A long email but one worth reading:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
10,000 votes 10 years ago
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&refcode=em20260629-3&t=1&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to split a $5 donation to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina and Chris Pappas. **[If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&refcode=em20260629-3&t=2&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)**
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for over 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight — or sometimes even large — lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on Election Night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead — which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
This current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
Experts are calling this race a “Toss Up.” Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran. Even the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes — just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 — in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency — only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
**[Please: Will you split a $5 donation, or whatever you can, between our campaign and Chris Pappas before our end-of-quarter deadline to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&refcode=em20260629-3&t=3&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-3&t=22&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)**
Thank you for reading. I appreciate it.
Roy Cooper

And it comes back to something really simple: it’s about being seen. The significance of visibility for queer people of all ages cannot be overstated. When I first ran for Congress, the visibility and representation my candidacy was able to grant folks in my district who felt otherwise unseen was the center of my campaign. It continues to inspire the work I do as the first queer Latina in the House of Representatives. I’m doing this for queers kids all over my district and I’m doing this for her: [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134283312/630752466/1131826177?amount=25&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.06.29_Pride&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2ZlYTVlYS0yMzc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Awg6KC0CqIMakmw_Y2EEcIvycFTlnpIwzddDybME6c0=) Growing up, I didn’t see people like me in elected positions. But I saw pieces of myself everywhere else. I saw myself in Rogue from the X-Men comics. In Xena: Warrior Princess. In Buffy, in Willow. I watched Ellen come out on national television with my mom, and I didn’t fully understand why it felt so important at the time, but it did. I went to Lilith Fair at the Gorge in 1999, the same day Brandi Chastain scored the winning penalty kick in the Women’s World Cup Final and took her shirt off. (I’m not saying those two things are related, but I’m also not not saying that.) Those moments mattered because they were little flashes of recognition. Like the world briefly saying:**you exist, you belong here too.** That’s what Pride is to me. It’s not just a celebration. It’s visibility. It’s survival. And that’s why what’s happening right now matters so much. **We are watching real attempts to erase transgender people from public life and we’re just not going to take it.** Because Pride has always been a refusal to disappear. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134283313/630752467/1131826177?amount=25&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.06.29_Pride&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2ZlYTVlYS0yMzc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Awg6KC0CqIMakmw_Y2EEcIvycFTlnpIwzddDybME6c0=) Thank you for fighting with me for visibility and freedom for all of us 💙 — Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. clean_body: | Peter, I’ve been thinking about what Pride means to me this year. And it comes back to something really simple: it’s about being seen. The significance of visibility for queer people of all ages cannot be overstated. When I first ran for Congress, the visibility and representation my candidacy was able to grant folks in my district who felt otherwise unseen was the center of my campaign. It continues to inspire the work I do as the first queer Latina in the House of Representatives. I’m doing this for queers kids all over my district and I’m doing this for her: = Growing up, I didn’t see people like me in elected positions. But I saw pieces of myself everywhere else. I saw myself in Rogue from the X-Men comics. In Xena: Warrior Princess. In Buffy, in Willow. I watched Ellen come out on national television with my mom, and I didn’t fully understand why it felt so important at the time, but it did. I went to Lilith Fair at the Gorge in 1999, the same day Brandi Chastain scored the winning penalty kick in the Women’s World Cup Final and took her shirt off. (I’m not saying those two things are related, but I’m also not not saying that.) Those moments mattered because they were little flashes of recognition. Like the world briefly saying:you exist, you belong here too. That’s what Pride is to me. It’s not just a celebration. It’s visibility. It’s survival. And that’s why what’s happening right now matters so much. We are watching real attempts to erase transgender people from public life and we’re just not going to take it. Because Pride has always been a refusal to disappear. = Thank you for fighting with me for visibility and freedom for all of us 💙 — Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. She grew up in a working-class Union household in Port Orchard and was the first in her family to attend college. # **Indiana tops list for cheapest gas prices in the country, thanks to Braun 's gas tax suspension**

Gov. Mike Braun said he might suspend the state's gasoline use tax if the war with Iran drags on for several weeks. (WISH photo/Garrett Bergquist)_ INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) -- Indiana has the cheapest regular gasoline of any state in the country, according to [AAA Fuel Prices](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fnkdg-hhlljjcji-i/).Governor Mike Braun on Wednesday said that thanks to the suspension of the gasoline usage tax and excise tax, Hoosiers have had the cheapest gas in the country for a month."Affordability is my top priority. Since I suspended Indiana's gas taxes, Hoosiers have had the cheapest gas prices in the country. Those savings are a big benefit for families trying to make ends meet at the kitchen table. Making life more affordable for Hoosiers will always be priority one," Braun said in a release.According to AAA's report, Braun's decision to suspend the gas taxes dropped the average gasoline cost paid by Hoosiers by 61 cents per gallon over the last month. Indiana's average gas price is 60 cents per gallon less than the national average. I'm writing this from a boat in the Tsugaru Strait in Japan where my husband is going to make history.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5c6307ca-7569-49a9-8759-d787a3541adb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The water between Honshu and Hokkaido is deep blue and cold and moving in ways you can't see from shore. On the port side, my husband Rob is swimming toward Hokkaido. He's been swimming for 8 hours and has gone over 18 miles/30 km. He'll be swimming for ten to fifteen total and will cover 25-28 miles/40-45 km
Yesterday I did a 30-minute ocean swim in the same water. In a wetsuit. I was freezing. Rob will be out here for ten to fifteen hours in nothing but a Speedo, a cap, and goggles. No wetsuit allowed. He's coated head to toe in diaper rash cream -- zinc -- because it's the only sun protection that stays on through that many hours of salt water. That's why he's glowing white out there. War paint, basically.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/952dcccd-6db7-4bc6-bd28-19387f3a214c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To survive the cold, he's gained 20 to 30 pounds of brown fat for insulation. He intentionally remade his body into a different kind of machine. We talk a lot about loving the bodies we have. Rob keeps redefining what a body can even do.
If he reaches the other side, he becomes the first person in history to complete the Double Seven -- the Seven Summits and the Oceans Seven. Every continent's highest peak. Every one of the seven hardest open-water channels on earth.
Sixteen years. fifteen expeditions (because it's our second time on Tsugaru). One last swim. Follow the tracker here:
[https://live.garmin.com/session/4535967f-f025-8256-ace5-1e74102d2e01/token/385B6549885A80B2A617BCF6BD0A3D0](https://substack.com/redirect/f2eafe53-bfe5-445c-8cb8-7d8932200c4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tsugaru is the one that got away. In 2023 he was pulled from this same water, told he wouldn't make the time limit. He came home, said almost nothing about it, and started training again. The record is the headline. The years of getting back in the cold are the actual story.
Right now, he's battling a strong 4.6 knot current that is pulling him off course. We can't physically fight it. So he keeps swimming as the coast he's trying to land on gets further and further away.
Here's what it actually takes, from where I'm sitting.
He can't touch the boat. Not once. Any assistance and the swim is over. So every hour I toss him a bottle on a retractable dog leash -- 350 calories of liquid nutrition, the only fuel he gets. He drinks it treading water and keeps going. I tried to swim alongside him earlier with fins on. I couldn't keep up. He doesn't have fins.
The cost of this stuff is real, and it isn't pretty. After Molokai, he developed SIPE -- swimming-induced pulmonary edema -- two days later and ended up in the ER. In the English Channel and the North Channel, he was stung by jellyfish hundreds of times and kept swimming. On Everest, both our bodies were slowly dying at altitude. On Vinson, in Antarctica, we battled 40 below.
We've learned not to ask each other how we're doing in the middle of these things. The question only makes you remember the pain. So instead we just say, "You're doing good, yah?" Not a question, really. A reminder. A small act of holding each other up across cold water.
There's something in both of us that goes looking for the edge. But out here it doesn't feel like punishment. It feels like an awakening. A celebration of what the mind and body can actually do when you stop negotiating with them.
We've learned not to ask each other how we're doing in the middle of these things. The question only makes you remember the pain. So instead we just say, "You're doing good, yah?" Not a question, really. A reminder. A small act of holding each other up across cold water.
We make a quiet trade in our marriage. He spent the last year and a half helping me through a Senate campaign -- knocking doors, holding the camera, holding me together on the hard nights. Now it's my turn. To watch the GPS track. To throw the bottle. To send calm seas across the water and trust that he knows how to do the hard thing.
You don't get to do anything this big alone. Behind every person attempting something impossible is a boat full of people who believe it's possible too.
I've lost friends to the mountains. I know how thin the line is between a story you tell at the finish and a story someone else has to tell for you. So I don't romanticize the risk. I'm just deeply proud of a person who decided one impossible thing wasn't enough, and went looking for the second.
Whatever happens out here today, he already did the hard part. He kept showing up.
If this stirred something in you -- some thing you've been afraid to start -- send it to the person you'd want in your boat.

Peter,

Your inbox looks like mine right now. _A mess_.

Would you be willing to volunteer for a unique campaign with a vision for building a new America together?

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b03fa524197b/seattles-biggest-teslamusk-protest-yet-61304?e=10cc7d1928)

| |
**Peter — I’m running for Congress and I’m writing to tell you why.**
There are three key reasons:

1) I saw my mom suffer as a two time cancer survivor without health insurance. She died the year Obamacare came out. I will fight with everything I have to keep anyone else from enduring the many ways **our broken system punishes working people.**
2) I ran for this same office two years ago and was the ONLY candidate **warning about the threat to our democracy and the need to expand and reform the Supreme Court,** along with the rest of my plan.

**Amazingly, I am once again the only candidate for WA-02 who even mentions the threat we’re facing in the Voter's’ Guide**. We can’t win a fight we won’t acknowledge and we can’t tackle any of our priorities if we don’t win.
3) I believe in you, in US, and our ability to not just get through this crisis but **seize the opportunity to reimagine America.** We can build something we’ve never seen before, an America focused on you, your family, and your community instead of the rich and powerful.

**We can accomplish amazing, beautiful things together** but we won’t get there by electing the same career politicians that helped build the broken system that got us here in the first place.

I am uniquely qualified among the candidates for this position with proven experience accomplishing things people told me were impossible and the success I’ve had mobilizing thousands locally to fight for economic and social justice. **You can**[**read more**](https://us.list-manage.com/U3AnEas0u2b?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**about that on my NEW website.**
---
| [SHOW ME THE SITE!](https://us.list-manage.com/DdxlBmSJZ1_?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)
---
| |
**I’M NOT GOING TO ASK YOU FOR MONEY!** This is usually where candidates ask you for a donation but not only am I not taking corporate money, I’m not accepting any donations.
**I want something more much valuable.** I want your partnership in making this campaign successful and reinventing America.
[**CLICK HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/Um__kIYyWq2?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**for our volunteer form** and join our merry band of change-makers ready to make history together. The incumbent may have all the money, but this can be our moment.
Excited to be on this journey with you.
— Devin

PS. Please join us on the social media sites below!

subject: Why I have to fish instead of fundraise
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=6&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa) This isn’t typical during a campaign, but I'm about to largely go offline for more than a week.

I'm Bill Hill, and I'm running for Congress in Alaska. In a few days, I'll be leaving the campaign trail and heading to Bristol Bay for the start of the world's largest wild sockeye salmon run, where I've been commercial fishing for most of my life.

Every summer, millions of salmon return to Bristol Bay in one of the greatest wild fisheries on Earth. The season only lasts a few short weeks, and when the fish are running, fishermen go to work. There's no asking the salmon to wait until after an FEC deadline.

So while most candidates spend the days before a major fundraising deadline calling donors, I'll be out on the water earning a paycheck and helping support my family.

That's the reality of running for Congress when you're not a millionaire.

[Will you split a contribution between my campaign and Voter Protection Project today to help keep this grassroots campaign moving while I'm out on the water?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=7&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa) | [CONTRIBUTE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=8&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa)
---
Before I head out to fish, there's something I need you to know:

**This race is absolutely winnable.**

National Republicans know it. That's why they'll spend heavily to protect Nick Begich and keep this seat in Republican hands.

Alaskans have rejected Republicans before, and if we have the resources to compete, we can do it again.

My campaign has never taken a dime of corporate PAC money. We're building this campaign the same way I've built my life — through hard work and support from regular people.

While I'm out on the water, I won't be able to spend the days leading up to our FEC deadline making fundraising calls like other candidates do. That's why I'm asking for your help today:

[Will you split a donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project before I head out to Bristol Bay? Every dollar helps us build the grassroots campaign we need to hit our FEC goal and win this race.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=9&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa)
[GIVE NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=10&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa)
---
Thank you for standing with me.

— Bill Hill 🏔️🎣

P.S. I'll be offline and out on the water ahead of the FEC deadline, but this campaign won't stop fighting. subject: I could be Louisiana’s last Black Congressman

body:
MAGA wants to wipe out Black representation in Louisiana without getting any more blood on their hands.
| | | | | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001F7UnlmgtnciCC5eOfx6RSpLM_F20VmJN0ejp4vu0n3WJEXwVw978MFnNL-EfM5pPsNWYALnEKI2kc8AvLGmczvj3nO6Abm9DoQ5GEnuBj3bVPbfqx57ZqbsIHLuzEPbYbvI02qXJFZN9UNno-rNfzBotcwnPkiA5wYTEMCYFxQDqxe2nfUYhnZIhqbdoeh5ZtqT058fyU3_7Eh8mzqLSbBEMjpI11nmth3tHFssIuPc=&c=TTMTNpHA07Xzc5xz_uRC8PkTHoOgqxAZmpq2Vwmte9fC1ow-ve0-PQ==&ch=FrwmUEdmrnXexcx_h1Z72JeAeEzVDy1epdvn1rq3NVG_K878mm0W4g==)

| Peter,
My name is Troy Carter and I proudly represent Louisiana's 2nd congressional district, the last remaining majority-Black district in the state.
And if MAGA has its way, the district I represent will be the last ever majority-Black district in Louisiana. I could very well be Louisiana's last Black Congressman.
By now, you've heard about what MAGA did to Black voters in Louisiana.
In April, the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Then MAGA declared a state of emergency to cancel our election, tossed out tens of thousands of ballots, and rammed through a brand-new map that erased one of our majority-Black districts -- the seat held by my colleague and dear friend Cleo Fields.
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001F7UnlmgtnciCC5eOfx6RSpLM_F20VmJN0ejp4vu0n3WJEXwVw978MFnNL-EfM5pPsNWYALnEKI2kc8AvLGmczvj3nO6Abm9DoQ5GEnuBj3bVPbfqx57ZqbsIHLuzEPbYbvI02qXJFZN9UNno-rNfzBotcwnPkiA5wYTEMCYFxQDqxe2nfUYhnZIhqbdoeh5ZtqT058fyU3_7Eh8mzqLSbPI5yHNWgPv3PNbYAAlbwWs=&c=TTMTNpHA07Xzc5xz_uRC8PkTHoOgqxAZmpq2Vwmte9fC1ow-ve0-PQ==&ch=FrwmUEdmrnXexcx_h1Z72JeAeEzVDy1epdvn1rq3NVG_K878mm0W4g==)
---
But that's not the full story.
While they were debating the map that wiped out Cleo's district, MAGA had a second map waiting in the wings -- one that went even further. It eliminated my district too. Then Black voters showed up. They flooded the Capitol, furious at being stripped of their representation. And facing that kind of heat, MAGA blinked.
And then MAGA pulled a bait and switch. They benched the map that killed my district and passed the one that eliminated Cleo's -- and the moment the ink was dry, they sprang the trap:
---
| [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001F7UnlmgtnciCC5eOfx6RSpLM_F20VmJN0ejp4vu0n3WJEXwVw978MFnNL-EfM5pPsNWYALnEKI2kc8AvLGmczvj3nO6Abm9DoQ5GEnuBj3bVPbfqx57ZqbsIHLuzEPbYbvI02qXJFZN9UNno-rNfzBotcwnPkiA5wYTEMCYFxQDqxe2nfUYhnZIhqbdoeh5ZtqT058fyU3_7Eh8mzqLSbOOfhT2Gt37a2M6wVeURyd4=&c=TTMTNpHA07Xzc5xz_uRC8PkTHoOgqxAZmpq2Vwmte9fC1ow-ve0-PQ==&ch=FrwmUEdmrnXexcx_h1Z72JeAeEzVDy1epdvn1rq3NVG_K878mm0W4g==)
---
MAGA activists immediately challenged the very map their own legislature had just passed, claiming my district was an "illegal racial gerrymander." It was a setup. They didn't want to vote to eliminate my seat in the open, so they're trying to get a court to do their dirty work behind closed doors -- so MAGA can wipe out Black representation in Louisiana without any more blood on their hands.
We've been here before. I'm one of five Black people elected to serve in Congress, the fourth since Reconstruction. The first, John Willis Menard, was denied his seat in Congress, challenged by that period's MAGA movement.
I'm not backing down from this fight. But I can't win it alone. Right now, MAGA's lawyers are working to convince a court to do what they were too scared to do in the open: erase my district and silence the Black voters who sent me to Congress. They are betting that we'll be too tired, too distracted, or too broken to fight back. Let's prove them wrong.
[That's where you come in, Peter. We need a surge in support of Democrats from across the nation to help us fight for Louisiana's last majority-Black district. Can I count on you to chip in $50, $25, or even $15 to stand with every Black voter in Louisiana who refuses to let MAGA drag this state back to the Jim Crow era? ](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001F7UnlmgtnciCC5eOfx6RSpLM_F20VmJN0ejp4vu0n3WJEXwVw978MFnNL-EfM5pP1PVQEWHDy7rIEj6B1B4DoC0Ie2enoN3V2_XRE-YE5RiArHIKUXimqxkoAqjyCAqv0ecBt9inmQULCaU76c4sNEFfN17deuf1C2pG9JY9vahWaSvQT600l9VpqpSrWq0RAyCvziytpec1NZLTgLLy20TOqBYu0jtP1j5F6heC0jcKFp30ETJ_6g==&c=TTMTNpHA07Xzc5xz_uRC8PkTHoOgqxAZmpq2Vwmte9fC1ow-ve0-PQ==&ch=FrwmUEdmrnXexcx_h1Z72JeAeEzVDy1epdvn1rq3NVG_K878mm0W4g==)

clean_body: MAGA wants to wipe out Black representation in Louisiana without getting any more blood on their hands. | | | | | == | Peter, My name is Troy Carter and I proudly represent Louisiana's 2nd congressional district, the last remaining majority-Black district in the state. And if MAGA has its way, the district I represent will be the last ever majority-Black district in Louisiana. I could very well be Louisiana's last Black Congressman. By now, you've heard about what MAGA did to Black voters in Louisiana. In April, the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Then MAGA declared a state of emergency to cancel our election, tossed out tens of thousands of ballots, and rammed through a brand-new map that erased one of our majority-Black districts -- the seat held by my colleague and dear friend Cleo Fields. | | == But that's not the full story. While they were debating the map that wiped out Cleo's district, MAGA had a second map waiting in the wings -- one that went even further. It eliminated my district too. Then Black voters showed up. They flooded the Capitol, furious at being stripped of their representation. And facing that kind of heat, MAGA blinked. And then MAGA pulled a bait and switch. They benched the map that killed my district and passed the one that eliminated Cleo's -- and the moment the ink was dry, they sprang the trap: | == MAGA activists immediately challenged the very map their own legislature had just passed, claiming my district was an "illegal racial gerrymander." It was a setup. They didn't want to vote to eliminate my seat in the open, so they're trying to get a court to do their dirty work behind closed doors -- so MAGA can wipe out Black representation in Louisiana without any more blood on their hands. We've been here before. I'm one of five Black people elected to serve in Congress, the fourth since Reconstruction. The first, John Willis Menard, was denied his seat in Congress, challenged by that period's MAGA movement. I'm not backing down from this fight. But I can't win it alone. Right now, MAGA's lawyers are working to convince a court to do what they were too scared to do in the open: erase my district and silence the Black voters who sent me to Congress. They are betting that we'll be too tired, too distracted, or too broken to fight back. Peter,
I'm truly so sick and tired of hearing about how Donald Trump needs OUR support and OUR loyalty.
Every single Republican candidate for office repeats the MAGA loyalty oath like their lives depend on it.
"I solemnly swear to preserve, protect, and defend Donald Trump from all perceived enemies foreign and domestic."
He's the damn President of the United States! The PEOPLE deserve and demand HIS loyalty and HIS support, protection, and hard work -- not the other way around.
Look, I am sorry to rant like this but we aren't even two whole days out from the runoff election in which I was chosen by a landslide to represent the people of Louisiana and my MAGA opponent barely scraped by to get her nomination...and already she has done nothing but praise and thank Trump for endorsing her and helping her win her primary.
"We have a chance to send a clear message that Louisiana stands with President Trump," Letlow said. "He endorsed me because he knows I will stand with him."
Nobody helped us win. The people did that, all by themselves. When I am elected to the US Senate, I'll make sure we send a clear message that the people are fed up with Trump's corruption and incompetence and we demand change and accountability.

name: Bennett for Governor
subject: Walk with me at the Bangor 4th of July Parade
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Bennett for Governor · P
body:
I'm asking you to join me at the Bangor 4th of July parade and help show Maine what this campaign is building.

| | |
---
---
---
Dear Peter, [Are you able to join me at Bangor 4th of July Parade on Saturday July 4th.](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/7_4_bangor?e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bangor_parade&n=1) This year’s 4th of July celebration carries special meaning. As we mark the 250th anniversary of our country, we have the chance to celebrate our independence, and to reflect on the kind of people we want to be and the kind of future we want to build together. Our founders gave us more than a nation. They gave us an example of courage, faith, determination, and a belief that free people, working together, can do extraordinary things. That spirit still lives here in Maine. It lives in people who care about their communities, who believe public service still matters, who know we can do better, and who are ready to roll up their sleeves and help build a stronger future together. That is why I am asking you to join me at [parade or event name]. I will be there to celebrate this remarkable milestone in our country’s history and to celebrate the values that still make America and Maine worth believing in: independence, responsibility, hard work, service, and the idea that our best days are built together. When we walk together, we send a simple message: that Maine’s future does not belong to cynicism, division, or politics as usual. It belongs to people who are willing to come together and do the work of self government with optimism, common sense, and faith in one another. **Here are the Details:** **Parade: Bangor 4th of July Parade** **Date: Saturday July 4th** **Time: 8:45am** **Meet-up Location: Corner of Wilson and Acme St. Brewer Maine** **RSVP:[Walk with me](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/7_4_bangor?e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bangor_parade&n=2)** I would be honored to have you with me. Bring your family. Bring your friends. Come celebrate this historic day with us, and let’s show what it looks like when people come together in a spirit of pride, purpose, and hope.

Friends,
The fight to keep Virginia's 5th District strong for America First values is at a critical moment. With the deadline fast approaching, I'm reaching out personally to ask for your support today.
We must hit our fundraising goal by midnight tonight to power through the final stretch of this campaign and defeat our never Trump opponent whose campaign consultants are working against Trump and his America First Agenda. Every dollar helps us reach more voters, defend our conservative principles, and ensure we send a proven fighter back to Washington.
As a Navy SEAL veteran, husband, father of five, and your Congressman with prior service in the Virginia General Assembly, I've always stood firm on conservative values while delivering real results. I was the first incumbent endorsed by President Trump for reelection this cycle.
In the General Assembly, my team and I passed bills where every Republican and every Democrat voted yes, including two tough McGuire bills in the State Senate that many said couldn't pass. At the same time, I earned the highest awards for conservatism.
This year in Congress, I received the Club for Growth's top conservatism award, the Champion of Limited Government from the Institute for Legislative Analysis, and CPAC's Award for Conservative Excellence. In just eighteen months my incredible team and I have returned close to ten million dollars back into the pockets of 5th district our constituents owed to them by the federal government. In this appropriations cycle we successfully secured 18 out of 18 community project funding requests including a new fire truck for Louisa County, Nottaway County Sheriff's Office renovation, and more.
In Congress, my team and I also recently passed two bills out of the House in just three weeks. One was the Wintergreen bill, a 25-year fight that six previous Members of Congress couldn't finish.
Your contribution today -- whether $25, $100, $250, or more, will help keep a true conservative leader fighting for you in Washington.

## SCOTUS Blocks Trump's Fed Firing
The Supreme Court on Monday [blocked President Trump](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb8GOxx4sK4WFGnsNm1KB-GxkoA4gDr79xl38gdpXvPunDvnfj2mh_bBr89PHVFVl6YVzxKwVsxT2beMEU3ac837lSomRaPLBAw6yjoq2GS1D69JNlY5REDRoOL3HnouBXTNogapheXOILL5hijFzQ5oheBDb2foXePVRWOdYJxxYKKdDWPSCs2l41zzjkiG1teU2-_k17qgC690YG5Nik1QS61bIeKDwEhgPM-zNetsrieB8UITGNl1YCAw_jnRtxQNvmhqUvqhNe9xow4tZh1oxoL5wHapMTRZ2e30IfjS3Ylkz6h9eHfXfw12KPgNAAD__59qf_M) from firing Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook for now, in a 5-4 ruling that preserved the central bank's independence. In a separate decision, the justices [let Trump fire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAQhp8GOzYwILoFxW3s9ra3NIijcoNgYNzNvv2Je84bnPqbfJPv__cYHy7EkNa_bkdLSx4TvmpEIixjPY-CO_p8FirndVV93r2rIwgwXBiuxDi7EN-jbma7IAKqBq3seuilVmCazXrnwEtnnIapmzp0dw0ovTTQm75dTBPsZRNGCSkkCHWbvBB6Vk7qRUonDdMC50C53P7nkGjDJb7zE8vN572JdiM6KlN_GAwMBtpwCzFejMFQcD2jo5ATg-HTwSdHFLEyGNq7aqVq-U8m_-ZUzv3gIc14YJoxEXcrJh-w8iWUkFZ-lEzoL-llaYqdj1eIMVTTMS3W3YXP-4Z-tefTwlcAAAD__8ujjMY) Federal Trade Commission member Rebecca Slaughter, overturning a 90-year-old precedent and expanding presidential power over other independent agencies. Trump moved to fire Cook last August over mortgage fraud allegations that she denies. She is the first Fed governor targeted for removal in the central bank's 112-year history. The decision affirmed a long tradition of [shielding the central bank](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0b-OpDAMBvCngS4o_wRsQXEN3V57JcoEZ_BtiJHjmdW8_Smje4PtXPxsfZ_853P7DJix3H-HExZJtBX4rhlEgLf6uBhOiPRg4UdTNdIZQ92stqPSo3J62wPm1-b7fUkAFlwPi5lmOxvv7Ngfy4eZJuf0NN_maXKj9frDRQPeGRghBdvj0q7p0WmjjdVuuEWt_e6C8cmYYMbOa9hRiIe_hEUOSPlFT-Ah0tnn5RC5aud-dXbt7JqwhBJheIWDqInOrhCp0Pnq7HpRxtiGwIIxQ2fX_yXVu6W6ZYpfVQk_zquqhIzlriipBDtwyIqhAj9B3VuAQqwKCTQfdhSk0myEIs3eQvlq6xeTQBTYVWI6VcsgGENWWAQ4AUOJoIx33thZz8MhZ-552a9vzBnrOHVe38-A-V1YfvSl52L_BQAA__8fX6xU) from political interference. That protection appears unique to the Fed, now that the Court has allowed Trump to dismiss members at other independent agencies like the FTC.
## Holiday Heat Wave Hits US
A [dangerous heat wave](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFu9CAUhE-DO6wHz8v6Lyj-xt2mTWmx8LBJsFkBNtrbR84V0o00oxnN9_mYHybEsC8fZiNdfZp3aiVSrZTncrwybWTTkWs-rlSxabOmzBKk4qA4wuxMiO956Jz2RJKwIy3uoxzFgFJ1q0Zvb-ikt7fRocW786Tw6YH-KQAcXRf01QYKQYCQgP3TAgwOjRi8EEYoNgC5UFPuv1LY60o-vtNJubdp66Jea30Vhv-ZnJicWmu9fZbrxeUzOV2SycmZfaGcjsJj2he-kqm8mZN4NHkhXpqpKxWePD8Kr2sovBF9Mzl1WbtXCzGGou5sgGUzIf5u1z8BO7X8CQAA___Id4G2) is expanding across the central and eastern United States this week, with over 140 million people under heat alerts heading into the Fourth of July holiday. Temperatures will soar into the upper 90s and low 100s from the Great Lakes to the Mid-Atlantic, with heat indices reaching [105 to 115 degrees](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQhU8D3SDPmJhQuNiGLttuiYw9BG8MjmwTK7dfsVf425lPn957fx7zw_jgj-dvs7Mua5wPrjlwKZzmfL4T72zjmUo6LyrbuFuTZxKkQCiQYnbGh-_ct06vzMSyZY3Dne7YS1LtpuUgcBgEKUXjzdI4Doz32-hGVOu6oGu9vmxCSYECSchusUL0ThrsV0SDqukFO19i6v5Gf5SN1_CNH06djXsb9FbKOzfyV0NTQ1OttTsWe7W4_teFTdk4NTRtbEpDE8oRdh-Cjwckn19wZliSsZxhi8E784XK_IILh2o-DJVz4XRA9cGtPnEGGyHZw8gbEQ5t0u5dL2NWQ9OL5258-J-u_GjSj6Z_AQAA___IvIve) in cities including New York, Philadelphia, Washington, Chicago, and Boston. The National Weather Service called it the first widespread heat wave of the summer, with the heat dome expected to [peak Thursday through Saturday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGP4yAUhH8N7ojgYRG7oLjGXa690nqBR0wOmwieY-Xfr7z7E7aZZkafZubfbb5hyml7_MWVHMcyb3S0TMxU57a_Kq3ky1657meq-bJ6bDMosFJZadQcMOXP3HfBRSIg05HT1wEG3Ruw3eLGOHpj1X0cSAcA8oMN8eoJR4sRve6SO2nKGqWVBmUud69UHwzqPmqN2opeUUhc6uVZ0sYLxfwpb6oXX9Yuu4X51YT5I2ASMB2EvPx4AqaTLGBSp8AoYIqlksfGAqYNOZUNs4BpIWR54JtkPLcuskT53PNHHkT_5ZrCQY1lKzsvkrBxV114HSnn1OxV9OqxYsrfdfhXH74dfAUAAP__aViG0w) and potentially set close to 100 new daily record highs by July Fourth. Forecasters urged residents to limit outdoor activity, stay hydrated, and seek air conditioning during the worst of the heat.

name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: I made a choice
body:
This race is too consequential to sit out. The stakes are too high.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
| | | |
---
Peter, deciding to run for this U.S. Senate seat wasn’t easy.
I had planned on serving North Carolina from here at home. That’s why I was so humbled when North Carolinians twice elected me to be their Governor.
**But this Senate race is too consequential to sit out. The stakes are simply too high.**
I entered this race to fight for people like you, who’ve put your trust in me – and I have full faith that together, we can win. But tonight, we’re facing the biggest test yet of our grassroots movement’s strength:
After 11:59 p.m., we have to close the books on every dollar we’ve raised since April 1 and hand them over to the FEC. Before long, those numbers will be published for all to see – including our MAGA loyalist opponent, his megadonors and the entire GOP machine. [**_So with time running out to reach our ambitious $1.5 million goal, I’m personally asking you to help out by making your first $5 donation, right now._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=5&t=8&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=5&t=9&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
---
I’m running because our nation cannot afford two more years of unchecked Republican power in Washington. The attacks on health care, on democratic values and even on Americans – **they have to stop.**
Our leaders should be focusing on strengthening our communities by investing in public schools, securing health care access and prioritizing hardworking folks over the wealthiest few. That’s what I strove to do in North Carolina – and by the end of my time in office, we added thousands of jobs by expanding the clean energy economy, gave public school teachers statewide a much-needed raise, expanded Medicaid and more.
**This is the work I’m ready to continue as the next Senator from North Carolina. But that means we have to flip this seat from red to blue for the first time in a generation and take back the Senate for the people who elect us, which is easier said than done.**
I’ve never lost a race, but this one will be the most competitive of my career. It’s the best pick-up opportunity for Democrats this cycle, and our ability to flip the Senate hinges on us succeeding. That’s why far-right groups are already spending nearly $100 million so far to attack me – and experts expect this to be the most expensive Senate race ever, so they will spare no expense to help President Trump’s handpicked candidate buy his way to victory.
So if they see us missing goals like the one we set for tonight, they _will_ use this as an opportunity to strike. They _will_ flood the airwaves with millions more in attack ads to smear me, knowing that their investments are working as intended, because we _will not_ have enough funds to fight back.
[**_Chipping in $5, $25 or whatever amount is right for you before the end of the day won’t just help us close the gap in time; it’ll prove to everyone that momentum is on our side. So if you’re with us, Peter, please make it clear by making a donation right away._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=5&t=10&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)

---

---

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

## Bitcoin Was the Prototype
Say what you want about Bitcoin — it proved something the experts swore was impossible. It proved that millions of people want a way to store wealth that no government can print, freeze, or inflate away. That idea was radical in 2009. Today it's a trillion-dollar fact. But here's what the true believers don't like to admit: Bitcoin got the _idea_ right and the _backing_ wrong. It's backed by nothing but belief. It can lose a third of its value in a month. And it consumes as much electricity as a small country just to keep the lights on. It was the prototype. A brilliant, world-changing prototype — but a prototype all the same. So here's the question worth sitting with: what happens when someone takes everything Bitcoin got right — the digital freedom, the scarcity, the independence from any government — and fixes the one thing it got wrong, by backing it with real, verified gold? You get the finished version. And it starts trading on Kraken on **July 8**. And to be clear: this isn't another speculative crypto, and it isn't paper gold. It's backed by real, certified, in-ground gold — the gold stays right where it is, and the value trades. I'm not going to unpack the whole thing in an email. But I've been watching it closely, it's cleared one of the toughest exchanges in the world, and I put together the full briefing on what it is. [**See the finished version →**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e852600/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUyLndlYWx0aGRhaWx5LmNvbS9vL29wLzExNTgwNDM/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA2MzA/LbmNscTYxaGI5TQ/gakOZGw/s9ib0fad79a) Get to the good, green grass first... **Brian Hicks, The Prophet of Profit**
President & Founder, Angel Publishing **P.S.** There's an estimated **$5 trillion** in verified gold sitting in the ground right now — real, proven, and completely frozen out of the digital economy. The thing launching July 8 is the first attempt to change that. [Here's how it works.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e852600/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUyLndlYWx0aGRhaWx5LmNvbS9vL29wLzExNTgwNDM/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA2MzA/LbmNscTYxaGI5TQ/gakOZGw/s9ib0fad79a)

body:
What is liberty really worth if you don’t use it to stand for the TRUTH.

If there was ever a message of mine to read, I hope you choose this one.
| Friend,
---
With Independence Day nearly here, I’ve been doing a lot of personal reflection lately...
---
250 years since the signing of the Declaration of Independence. 250 years of a nation striving for freedom.
---
_But what is liberty really worth if you don’t use it to stand for the**TRUTH**._

I always knew the price I could one day pay for defending my dear friend of 40 years, a true patriot, and our president, Donald J. Trump, from the Left’s vindictive impeachment witch hunt.

[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcEOmzAQRL_G3ED22kBy8CEV4paqqirliMzuEqyCQbZplL-vaNMP6PXN7GhH87gPd-cXH55f3co25mmIacizTz4Q7xyIAzK59-yS23kACU0pm1LL06cKsoTkFBZsVXuBi6qNaYvZErRM0xVrYKMakjSSmxrVqhaMQomFt2eUbLRUUkujK8cEeNXEiohAjsJIt3DMVeT9GBePLmSXfk5bRK5wW4vFzjnvSeibgF5AnxiPyNXLh8h0OgT08aB3STxxSFzmeKQsoB8naKWsp-uowdUjnue6P_I6oFt3559B6O7vd2AENKeyMvljFbrj1fnlAzMK3X3_0Zf_qnx42o6IfGqP4cuH4RYyhyx09-1WREv7yy-LT00rjHyemX865f9f4JeF3wEAAP__oBeTGQ)
__
---
_But as I said, what is the value of a free nation if we do not use that freedom to FIGHT for what we know in our hearts to be right and true?_
---
And now, years later, the vengeful Democrats are cashing in on what they see as their **_LAST_ _SHOT_** to **JAIL** an INNOCENT 82-year-old man for the rest of his years!
---
**To score political points, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – CANNOT save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---

...Being an _enemy_ of the Democrat’s Deep State is not something to fear,_it’s a badge of honor – a sign that you were willing to take the arrows for what you know is RIGHT!_

[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcEOmzAQRL_G3ED22kBy8CEV4paqqirliMzuEqyCQbZplL-vaNMP6PXN7GhH87gPd-cXH55f3co25mmIacizTz4Q7xyIAzK59-yS23kACU0pm1LL06cKsoTkFBZsVXuBi6qNaYvZErRM0xVrYKMakjSSmxrVqhaMQomFt2eUbLRUUkujK8cEeNXEiohAjsJIt3DMVeT9GBePLmSXfk5bRK5wW4vFzjnvSeibgF5AnxiPyNXLh8h0OgT08aB3STxxSFzmeKQsoB8naKWsp-uowdUjnue6P_I6oFt3559B6O7vd2AENKeyMvljFbrj1fnlAzMK3X3_0Zf_qnx42o6IfGqP4cuH4RYyhyx09-1WREv7yy-LT00rjHyemX865f9f4JeF3wEAAP__oBeTGQ)
__
---
That is why on the eve of 250 years of American independence, you will not see me sulk in the possibility of spending the rest of my life behind bars as an innocent man.
---
Instead, I will continue to use the freedoms this beautiful country provides us to _FIGHT_ for true justice. I will **_NEVER_ _SURRENDER_**!
---
As the saying goes, I would rather die on my feet than live on my knees.
---
**And the battlefield of my fight is in the courtroom, Friend.**
---
Asking for help has never been my strong suit, so believe me when I say that I’m reaching out today because _YOU_ are my last hope of keeping my defense going.
---
The Democrats have already STRIPPED me of my law licenses, pushed me to the point of BANKRUPTCY, and will not stop until they see me finished.

**_Why else do you think they worked so hard to force me to the brink of bankruptcy?_**

But as I said, what is the value of a free nation if we do not use that freedom to FIGHT for what we know in our hearts to be right and true? And now, years later, the vengeful Democrats are cashing in on what they see as their LAST SHOT to JAIL an INNOCENT 82-year-old man for the rest of his years! To score political points, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – CANNOT save me with a federal pardon in state court. Make no mistake, the Left’s playbook is always to wear you down... They’ve labeled me a “ DEAD MAN WALKING ,” RAIDED my home, ARRESTED me twice, took a MUGSHOT of me, and forced me into BANKRUPTCY , but the TRUTH remains... ...Being an enemy of the Democrat’s Deep State is not something to fear,it’s a badge of honor – a sign that you were willing to take the arrows for what you know is RIGHT! That is why on the eve of 250 years of American independence, you will not see me sulk in the possibility of spending the rest of my life behind bars as an innocent man. Instead, I will continue to use the freedoms this beautiful country provides us to FIGHT for true justice. I will NEVER SURRENDER! As the saying goes, I would rather die on my feet than live on my knees. And the battlefield of my fight is in the courtroom, Friend. Asking for help has never been my strong suit, so believe me when I say that I’m reaching out today because YOU are my last hope of keeping my defense going. The Democrats have already STRIPPED me of my law licenses, pushed me to the point of BANKRUPTCY, and will not stop until they see me finished. They know full well that the kind of legal defense it will take to beat these phony charges has to be the best of the best... and they also know that it won’t come cheap. Why else do you think they worked so hard to force me to the brink of bankruptcy? If you can’t afford to help right now, please just hit the back button on this letter and carry on with your day. Take care of your family and yourself first. Your thoughts and prayers already mean the world to me. But if you can contribute to my new Defense Trust, just know that I could use your support now more than ever to retain a top-notch defense team. ## Texas Secures $34 Million AstraZeneca Settlement
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton secured a nearly [$34 million settlement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAQxvGnwR0WDATsguIad7n2SmuAIUbGdmRzcXJPf0qa3X7rkf6a3_fnOl4xl7zefuNCrj7TNq50HoVqpX3Eo-74j1YKeFCthRZa64ETjiDAcGG4EmPEXF6jbqLzIvayISdtB520CkwzuV5jEJqUijYqTElcZN8DiIsn6aPvmuzeMWGUkFKA0G2njE0p6RQkJd8HpgXFXLe9rRNVeuKRymt70N6GbWmKm2q9H0z9YjAwGM7zbOfHX3ofGQy41xwKMRjeLgbDRFjqxGD4lDje-BeNfwPzOYfZY5gZDGB67r23EnTkVgnJtaSOdwEs7y10EowFjaLZXbyfuZR8GMu0uC2Yy-fL-rNtHw7-BwAA__8Nf4xa) from drugmaker AstraZeneca on Monday over alleged illegal kickbacks tied to Medicaid prescriptions. Paxton's office sued under the Texas Health Care Program [Fraud Prevention Act](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAURp8Gd4zg8jNDQZGGbtOmtK7hskaL8cig9WyePvI2SZ_6k46-c369zW9YamnvP3EjP155nxudvdIYdMzYx4G_qVHETmNU2qiNjivOIMByYbkSc8JSv2Y9Jb-I5OREXt4f8JB3BXZa_bKopMHoRZKMRrqctdHKkUR04PJjKv6CCauElAKEvj2UveecdY6S8uIi04JSGftxGysNemHP9Wv_pOMW922qfh3j2Zn6wSAwCOd53j6odXOtDAIeo8RKDMIlxiDUPWJlEL5JDMIHNf7E19gbV3ortZa98b-6_J8IDIIRgmeSWhmT-JJJcK2s486i4CYuMkmQkFWeDp-e50Xr9s60eN-w1O_D4_8yf3r4EwAA__89ZpCt), alleging the company offered providers free nursing services, reimbursement support, and other inducements to steer them toward prescribing AstraZeneca drugs. Many of those prescriptions were covered by Texas Medicaid, the office said, producing millions in claims it called tainted by the company's payments. AstraZeneca will pay the state $33,998,000. "_I will not allow Big Pharma to misuse taxpayer dollars to put profit ahead of Texans' health_ ," Paxton [said in a statement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOnDAQhU8DnZFt_BsoXKSh27Qp0WDGYMXYyJ4sS04fscmeIN2T5pvRvO_HY3qADz6u32FHQy-XpohnCUiEeYJCGX5jRAsFiQLuGKnABpPkUjOuWcunBXy4JlUvZubLIGo0outlL7pW6nozfB7EonjPv7RC4Rx8zW7mVtpB8663S-3NfYzrlgvBJVdN3-rOOaecFejmwVaK4-Ip5YY2JHxBceFKT8yNTXsdzEZ0lKr9VsmxkuN5ns0bAqKUI14rRswQmjU9Kzne7So5ZgwIBe_44dg_kP3EyA54UYqsoP2VsbCIkMPFWsV2H4J_Tz4-GKwZ_6bZr-zYIO_AbNoPiFedzXKc907RXaX4uoMP77_p_2w_jfwTAAD__4fhmrg). The agreement resolves the state's claims, which AstraZeneca settled without the allegations being decided in court.
## Three Charged in Del Rio Killing
Three women have been [charged with murder](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_u4yAQhJ_G7rBgbflPQXGNu1x7pbWYxaDDEMEmTu7pT8kr_PqZ0Xzfn9t2wxBDOn7jSZpfLm-JrhqJmcqGlQv-o0Q7VmKOdFLiih43kDAKOYpebhZDfG9Da7WRdlEtaTXNMKuph7H1eujBzXLZ0cCs1D45IDNLOZthsQi9aYP-jMmxl0pJkEM39-PknBvcrsiZZW8GSTZwLh17YnphdfGdn1S6PZ9t1J75Xpv-VwNrA-t1XZ3LrwkflUP6RBpYP0wNrN-yODN7KsKFJ4m_IUaywpSMVlh8x3B4FpXRmJAOwb4QiSuflMTusRxkxfkolkpbtL1fIcZQx6kZ5HFiiN9D_DONTw3_AwAA__8w6Ys2) in the broad-daylight stabbing of a 32-year-old Del Rio mother, Caroline Peña. Del Rio police were called to Val Verde Regional Medical Center around 2:10 p.m. Thursday after Peña arrived with multiple stab wounds. The attack happened in the 800 block of East 10th Street. Peña, a twin and mother of five, was flown to a San Antonio hospital and died that night. Friends said the confrontation [unfolded at a busy intersection](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO3DAQBU9DZT3gb0gpUOBE2Tp1KDTJ5gyxlLQg26sdn96QDfgCDgsPKKDej7f1DUst--M7bjTzVz7Wnc5eiZnaip0b_qKdInZirrTRzh2fuGqpHUgHRq4JS32tdkhzkGlSA83Kj3pU3mg3PGeZo0sO1aR9GJNR98mFpHCypEyOPgxlvmTSGamU1NLeRuN8ztnmqCiHKQorKRU-2o2fxPSFPdfX8UntFo9tqPOT-aML803oRejlPM_bO-39fq1CL9i4xEpCL1eY0EtsZbuQ20-Cf3Bp_xJsxwbvJXVIVKGVAzIyVuiMIZT9AQbOY6MdsDXqTEnoRXsDNpBKOBJ4aSewY0QYVQ7gR5d0sPkutRnanD7OUmvpzgsrHxuW-ieD_-_8z1n_DgAA__92Jph-) near a Sonic. Surveillance video, evidence, and [witness interviews](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZB41DYOHwMElzvbSC1EPbg-WbLyye5flvv7E_MIlFZXqVdWfj-WDYor76zdltvITyrLz0RKLcF2oSaW_vPNKjUUSZ96l0UYLAk4aJj3A4immcxk7b5_g575j25sHPnoz4NRtduxn85w8A5mVAsA8mzASm6d_3L0fuIv2CoNpgL4HhPH2GCYTQhjD2nN4zqsagX2UUm-ysfAPtZDO8s31tpbcJbuJfDY1_FLoFLrjOG5fjaR4Oi-DQtek1FOhu5YpdGuNmRW6C6vQwSU4K3SDPkrmXa8b1Rd7fUTZdP6qnqsuQb_ROhfZuCp0M5jhPps7gFHoumr95xFTim0yaoRXppjeBeX_bv22-C8AAP__UWmLBg) led detectives to Kitty Mia Diaz, 21; Amaya Diaz, 19; and Kyandra Renee Faz, 21, who are held at a GEO Correctional Facility in Del Rio. Police have not released a motive and say the investigation is ongoing, with additional charges possible. Del Rio sits on the Rio Grande about 150 miles west of San Antonio.
## Paramount+ Greenlights Texas Tech Docuseries
Paramount+ has [greenlit a four-episode docuseries](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdEa2cQwULtLQ_WlTojWsDysLPtnLcZenj4jyBik_aTT6Zn5-zV-QKB2PH7Cj53fM84FXJWTGMkPlAr_xwAUqMhPueHCFDWajjJPKyU7NKyT6zLZZfVDrqBv0uh_MoPvOuGbzISgXx1FZdGijtuPQobV9iOqbMkZDk_xdplyntFZG2XboXB9jtHHRGMO4CKtwTZxLyxsyvqFG-uQXlnbJe0N-Y35W0X0XZhJmuq6rxReWD2_peNAZQl5-3UlhpnuaMBPlBUj-gycU2PN5sOQsCxJCRcl8ypgzByCSa17OiiVhlfHmW1eYqSl-fV6JKFXXC6seOyT6q8T_d-TLmz8BAAD__5gPims) following the Texas Tech Red Raiders football team through their offseason, set to premiere ahead of the fall 2026 college season. Produced by [Skydance Sports and Second Wind Creative](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuSwyAMhk-DO2dAdkwoKLZxl2239MggbGawyYDy2tPvOFfYQpX06X_8XKcrxhT35Rs3svwKedrpWRMxU5mwcsFf2slhJeZEG-1cccUJJAytHNpOTh5jek994-0svVENWaUvcFG6g6FZrQHSZ_QIfZBaGa9mPUvtjQl0dgqgifZ4JodOKiVB9qdLN-gQQh-cojAbJ3pJPnIuJ16J6YU1pHd-UDm5vDXJrsy3KrovAaOA8XPA5NZjK2A84ggYDw0B4zFgBIw3LLjl-87tUoj2FJeVa_uB24NuQ848Y0qtz-5eqUSqTbH-9owpxTpo0ctlw5g-Jvh_1T0s_AUAAP__U5WEcg), the untitled series has been filming since January and follows head coach Joey McGuire as he rebuilds the roster. Production began before quarterback [Brendan Sorsby was ruled ineligible](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOrDAQRL8GMkZ-MDYEDm5CNjfdEDV292DJ4JHd89qvXzH7CZtUUjqnpPq6zBeIKe7X_7Ch4xflecdnTciMZYbKBb5xRw8VmRNuuHOFFWYllOmE6bSYA8T0nvs2uEWEUbbopB3UIK1Wpl2dIi2IRgAryQQagHpFZ5CLNvrsvW2jO2TCaCGlUKI_DdpYIurJS6Rl9E0vMETO5cQrMr6gUnrnB5aTz1ub3Mp8q43-16ipUVNACCnueJSNmg53oyZxxIftGP3aUc68QEpdyP5esUSs3Q0KbPm-cyeVNqMVv2hbXLg9Y0qxGtv04rpBTJ9p_tthD6d-AgAA__8GoH9A) over a gambling case and eventually left the team. Texas Tech is coming off its first Big 12 title last December and a Top 10 ranking, though the Red Raiders fell to Oregon 23-0 in the Orange Bowl.

Paxton's office sued under the Texas Health Care Program , alleging the company offered providers free nursing services, reimbursement support, and other inducements to steer them toward prescribing AstraZeneca drugs. Many of those prescriptions were covered by Texas Medicaid, the office said, producing millions in claims it called tainted by the company's payments. AstraZeneca will pay the state $33,998,000. "I will not allow Big Pharma to misuse taxpayer dollars to put profit ahead of Texans' health ," Paxton . The agreement resolves the state's claims, which AstraZeneca settled without the allegations being decided in court. 📰 [$10 Million Gift to UAB Aims to Improve Rural Health Care Across Alabama](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-DJyR2wVyg9n_N-om3I4q-N1q8fXJ05yAIxA1KvmUS24J3UF1WwZxXlvRVjKhxe6yWAtGB8b5TQd3guoLCVSOVGNBAyC5RiyRzkF4tCxxbvmTYKprFkaM1cLaoRH4YmIUGu85rb-S2h8ckSqho2LLOiuR82fyShlgmKU_ajseaW4C3qDyIHqNhZYvxg8VPRxQ2j82hNgVVi0wN2gfyUgLJ26DZi_3KDLIk-pbiYanvZoqHKHVVZ8zqpIdxxtsNJ2xkdyRKLNA1A=&c=bfFaGSkJKnGG009b3cyjhPT4Dj5VZbGs0N9e-tEUUnl1n3P4v1lRpg==&ch=8NNp9W5bhpKMo9UhcMFWgENqAzMAoIhczYR8MEIG39ho-S2hMp6URg==) Mike and Gillian Goodrich's multi-million dollar donation will create the Goodrich Rural Innovation in Training for Alabama (GRIT) program, aimed at expanding access to health care in underserved rural communities. The initiative will provide scholarships, support rural residency programs, invest in rural clinics, and establish a new endowed chair in rural health to help address Alabama's growing shortage of primary care physicians. The investment is a boon to Alabama's medical infrastructure but also underscores the need for sustained public policies and government action to strengthen rural health care and ensure that all Alabamians have access to quality medical care regardless of where they live.

📰 [Alabama unemployment edges up to 3.0% as jobs and wages reach record levels](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-DJyR2wVyg9n_N-om3I4q-N1q8fXJ05yAIxA1KvmUS24J3UF1WwZxXlvRVjKhxe6mob7cZNO0GOWoz4gMbAkSZ1P6eyyXZzWKgmDuWF6VCEA9Sx3OE_uxx34BWWQ5YpfUnL8tW57vQNQCKHZvcFghS3hyGPU8bmSxaUgcSZBRyBhSm3fYt5RE2fiiDUUIxbqGrcw7VCOvK9Cw74_F7J9_zvZ1V-2eXKPrs0k5tI8VS1IvPe-gEJuzc9q2nX2At9H&c=bfFaGSkJKnGG009b3cyjhPT4Dj5VZbGs0N9e-tEUUnl1n3P4v1lRpg==&ch=8NNp9W5bhpKMo9UhcMFWgENqAzMAoIhczYR8MEIG39ho-S2hMp6URg==)
Alabama's unemployment rate rose slightly to 3.0% in May, even as the state reached record highs in both overall employment and total jobs. While average wages increased statewide, the strongest wage growth was concentrated in specific sectors such as construction, professional and business services, and leisure and hospitality, rather than being broadly shared across the entire economy. Significant disparities also remain across the state, with some counties and cities continuing to experience substantially higher unemployment rates than others.

📰 [Republican ballot numbers drop, Democratic ballot numbers increase as voter turnout declines](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-DJyR2wVyg9n_N-om3I4q-N1q8fXJ05yAIxA1KvmUS24J3UF1WwZxXlvRVjKhxe6U79zHNO8vzYYUxF2lKNyf-ooWRdKKxb0EpecO-P0CllbNWmWcI0trwjBCv4ObTuVk-xGnC17yfJ_0LmPph6ZpoGhb1vKxa-wBwsq86Ldaal2ncHchQ6_TvTBL0VGeYxJ9p_FvSKMJ9OBo4llCmdHHTNf7N2dkgd3lzmuukwCSyeUK_jskUp99uEjvZzvmkiW-IlMjbG_cXNLi-mjs4M_zxalJ6sgFYSfDUywMkS2xB0=&c=bfFaGSkJKnGG009b3cyjhPT4Dj5VZbGs0N9e-tEUUnl1n3P4v1lRpg==&ch=8NNp9W5bhpKMo9UhcMFWgENqAzMAoIhczYR8MEIG39ho-S2hMp6URg==)
Voter turnout in Alabama's June 2026 primary runoff fell to just 10.7%, continuing a long-term decline in participation in runoff elections. While Republicans still cast the majority of ballots, the total number of Republican votes dropped significantly compared to 2022, while Democratic ballot numbers increased, driven in part by competitive races and local organizing efforts in some areas. Political leaders from both parties noted that local contests and candidate familiarity played a major role in determining turnout levels across the state.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
I know we're all keyed up to celebrate the 250th Anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. It marked a significant shift in the course of human history and set a standard that we are still striving to achieve: that all are created equal.
I have had a lot of people tell me they weren't going to celebrate this year because things are too dark and our democracy is at too great a risk. To me, that's the very reason to celebrate, to exercise our freedoms, and to reclaim the history of this nation.
To me, the greatest way to celebrate the birth of this nation is exactly what you're doing, participating in the democratic process. Our forebears fought for this democracy, and it is now our turn to carry that struggle forward. Every time you put up a yard sign for your candidate, wear a statement T-shirt, or remind someone to register to vote, you are defending our democracy.
So this July 4th, embrace your democratic heritage. Celebrate Independence Day by exercising your right to free expression. Honor those who fought to build this republic by committing to vote whenever you get the chance.
Be Safe. Happy 4th of July.

We're 140 days from the general election.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

clean_body: You Don't Want to Miss This | | | | | == | | | CAMPAIGN UPDATE | | | | | | == | MAKING HISTORY | | THE WEEK AHEAD | | Hamilton Watch Party Don't Forget to Wear Your Campaign T-shirt 🗓️ June 30 🕓 7 P.M. 📍 Jay and Susie Gogue Performing Arts Center at Auburn University -- Ham Amphitheatre == | | Lafayette 250th Celebration 🗓️ July 1 🕓 12 P.M. 📍 Lafeyette Square | | | Cleburne County Independence Day 🗓️ July 3 🕓 5 P.M. 📍 McIntyre Park | | JaxFest 2026 🗓️ July 3 🕓 6 P.M. 📍 Jacksonville Public Safety Complex | | | Auburn 4th of July Celebration 🗓️ July 4 🕓 5 P.M. 📍 Duck Samford Park | | | | | THE WEEK BEHIND | | | | | | | | | Almost as often as we get asked why we picked orange and blue as the campaign colors, we get asked, "When are you going to have yard signs?" The answer is...NOW! We also have a fresh supply of t-shirts, bumper stickers, buttons, and koozies for everyone. Last week, we sent merch to Calhoun, Randolph, Talladega, Cleburne, St. Claire, Lee, and Tallapoosa counties. We are asking for donations to cover production costs, and you can do that through ActBlue. | | == | | | | | | | | | In Case You Missed It | BLOG POSTS | == AL.com published an editorial by Tripp Skipper, a former staffer for public officials including Jeff Sessions, Robert Aderholt, and Mike Rogers, basically said the election was already over, and there was no point in the Democrats even bothering. I sent Tripp a history lesson, and I thought you might like to see it: Hi Tripp, Over the last 18 months, Democrats have been overperforming across the country. We've flipped seats in New Hampshire, Texas, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Pennsylvania, Mississippi, Virginia, and New Jersey. You probably noticed that several of those seats are in deep red states. Why do you think that is? Let's go back to 1986 when Alabama had been run by the Democratic Party for over a century... | == | A Few Things to Think About | | | ALABAMA IN THE NEWS | 📰 == Mike and Gillian Goodrich's multi-million dollar donation will create the Goodrich Rural Innovation in Training for Alabama (GRIT) program, aimed at expanding access to health care in underserved rural communities. The initiative will provide scholarships, support rural residency programs, invest in rural clinics, and establish a new endowed chair in rural health to help address Alabama's growing shortage of primary care physicians. The investment is a boon to Alabama's medical infrastructure but also underscores the need for sustained public policies and government action to strengthen rural health care and ensure that all Alabamians have access to quality medical care regardless of where they live. | 📰 == Alabama's unemployment rate rose slightly to 3.0% in May, even as the state reached record highs in both overall employment and total jobs. While average wages increased statewide, the strongest wage growth was concentrated in specific sectors such as construction, professional and business services, and leisure and hospitality, rather than being broadly shared across the entire economy. Significant disparities also remain across the state, with some counties and cities continuing to experience substantially higher unemployment rates than others. | 📰 == Voter turnout in Alabama's June 2026 primary runoff fell to just 10.7%, continuing a long-term decline in participation in runoff elections. While Republicans still cast the majority of ballots, the total number of Republican votes dropped significantly compared to 2022, while Democratic ballot numbers increased, driven in part by competitive races and local organizing efforts in some areas. Political leaders from both parties noted that local contests and candidate familiarity played a major role in determining turnout levels across the state. | A CALL TO ACTION | Volunteer: We're building a strong volunteer team to power the campaign through the general election, and we need your help. Sign up below to help move this campaign forward. | == | Follow Us: We need you to like, comment on, and share our social media posts. We also need you to talk to your friends about the campaign. We need you to come to any events we have in your area so your friends can see they're not alone. | == == == | | | Donate: Your contribution helps us keep our campaign moving by funding outreach, events, and voter engagement efforts across the district. | | == | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | I know we're all keyed up to celebrate the 250th Anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. It marked a significant shift in the course of human history and set a standard that we are still striving to achieve: that all are created equal. I have had a lot of people tell me they weren't going to celebrate this year because things are too dark and our democracy is at too great a risk. To me, that's the very reason to celebrate, to exercise our freedoms, and to reclaim the history of this nation. To me, the greatest way to celebrate the birth of this nation is exactly what you're doing, participating in the democratic process. Our forebears fought for this democracy, and it is now our turn to carry that struggle forward. Every time you put up a yard sign for your candidate, wear a statement T-shirt, or remind someone to register to vote, you are defending our democracy. So this July 4th, embrace your democratic heritage. Celebrate Independence Day by exercising your right to free expression. Honor those who fought to build this republic by committing to vote whenever you get the chance. Be Safe. Happy 4th of July. We're 140 days from the general election. FRIEND,

Spots are limited, and we want you to have one.

Voters for Tomorrow Action Fund invites you to Building What's Next: A Virtual Power-Building Rally on July 1st from 6:00 to 7:30
PM. This is a rallying call for the next generation of candidates, organizers, campaign staff, volunteers, and movement leaders.

The message is simple: We cannot build the future without people willing to step forward and lead.

Too often, we wait for someone else to run for office, manage a campaign, or organize a community. This event is designed to
challenge that mindset and help you see yourself as part of the solution.

Through stories and conversations with leaders from across the political and advocacy landscape, you will hear why leadership is
accessible, why your voice and lived experience matter, and how you can take the first step.

Featured topics include:

- Why We Can't Wait for Someone Else

- Power Is Built Every Day

- Millennials and Gen Z: The Future Is Already Here

- Your Story Is the Reason We Fight

- What We Owe the Next Generation of Leaders

Date: Tuesday, July 1st

Time: 6:00 - 7:30 PM

Where: Virtual

Seats are limited, so reserve your spot today. Come ready to be inspired, to nominate yourself or someone you believe in, and to
join the Voters for Tomorrow leadership pipeline.

The future is not something that happens to us. It is something we build together.

We refuse to watch from the sidelines.

name: Luke Farley
subject: Will you join my team of advisors?
body:
We need your help to continue building a better North Carolina...

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/xQZErk99Oh5?e=5b0cffdfcb&c2id=b6fb190cfac8b855862ac57518dc196f)
| | | | | | **Exclusive Invitation for Peter Willis.****PLEASE DO NOT FORWARD.**
---
| | Peter,
While we're hard at work serving North Carolina, we're also preparing for the next election — and I want you on my team.
As you know, I came into this office as a political outsider. Before running for Labor Commissioner, my only political experience was serving as a grassroots volunteer for my local county GOP.
Thanks to your support and confidence, here we are.
Since taking office, we've eliminated DEI and other woke policies at the N.C. Department of Labor, stood with President Donald J. Trump to end the H-1B visa scam and put American workers first, and focused every day on making North Carolina the safest place to work and the best place to do business.
Unfortunately, the Left isn't sitting on the sidelines. We're already hearing about the Radical Democrats that are preparing to target this office in the next election — and outside liberal groups will spend whatever it takes (George Soros’ money) to try to defeat our North Carolina First movement.
**But I won't back down.**
**You elected me to serve We the People, not the political establishment** , and that's exactly what I'm doing. But I can't keep advancing our conservative agenda without your continued support.
[**We have an important fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, and we still need to raise $12,475 to stay on track.**](https://us.list-manage.com/mJmtgIBHjLQ?e=5b0cffdfcb&c2id=b6fb190cfac8b855862ac57518dc196f)
If you believe in the work we're doing, I'd like to personally invite you to join the [**Commissioner's Circle**](https://us.list-manage.com/10a8oztfD7O?e=5b0cffdfcb&c2id=b6fb190cfac8b855862ac57518dc196f) — my monthly leadership team supporting our mission.
---
| [ACCEPT INVITATION TO JOIN MY LEADERSHIP TEAM >>>](https://us.list-manage.com/d00Qk_K3NmY?e=5b0cffdfcb&c2id=b6fb190cfac8b855862ac57518dc196f)
---
| | With a monthly contribution of at least $25, you'll become a member of my core leadership team and help advance our mission to keep North Carolina the safest place to work and the best place to do business.
If you're ready to stand with us, [**click here to join the Commissioner's Circle**](https://us.list-manage.com/lhsQ1vihjEB?e=5b0cffdfcb&c2id=b6fb190cfac8b855862ac57518dc196f).
**PLEASE NOTE:** This is an invitation reserved for a select group of supporters who have stood with me. Please do not forward this email. If you know someone who shares our values and would take this responsibility seriously, you may nominate them by replying to this email.
I am grateful for your friendship, your encouragement, and your support. I would not be serving as your Labor Commissioner without people like you.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
Together, we'll continue fighting to make North Carolina the safest place to work and the best place to do business — for this generation and the next. Thanks for joining me in the fight.
Yours in service,Luke
**Luke Farley** N.C. Labor Commissioner

**Ken Paxton is obsessed with us.**
He knows that Powered by People holds the key to his defeat, so he's doing everything he can to stop us from organizing.
