# [The Future of Campaign Finance Is Here ](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6253617&post_id=204288532&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA0Mjg4NTMyLCJpYXQiOjE3ODI4MzM4NDQsImV4cCI6MTc4NTQyNTg0NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYyNTM2MTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.0W3YaQIDZuk0ckobtjS2l6XplfQyPOg9Z8dM8JWLgDM)

This morning, the Supreme Court struck down federal limits on how much political parties may spend in direct coordination with federal campaigns. This is the biggest campaign finance decision since _Citizens United_ -- and if you're not sure what this means or why this matters, you're not alone. Here's why this is important.
Previously, the Court decided that spending from corporations or outside groups to political campaigns -- independent money -- is a form of protected free speech. Essentially, independent money/independent expenditures = no limits. The saving grace for campaigns that don't have billionaires funding them: FCC regulations give candidates -- not independent expenditures -- a discount on advertising rates. That means that when people-powered campaigns buy TV ads, they pay a lower price than corporations or outside groups.
But now, the Court has ruled on coordinated spending. This is spending done by the party committees -- like the National Republican Senatorial Committee or the Republican National Committee -- directly with campaigns. For over a decade, campaign finance law still had firm limits on how many of those dollars could be spent.
Until this morning, anyway.
The NRSC and JD Vance sued in order to get them thrown out, and they just won.
Here's what you should know:
**The previous state of play put a limit on coordinated spending by party committees to prevent a workaround to unlimited contributions.**
Until today, there were hard limits on how much money a party committee could spend in direct coordination with its own candidates.
Here's what that looked like in practice: Campaign X is spending $10 million. A party committee could take on part of the bill for line items on their budget, but only up to a certain amount - they were **limited** in how much they could spend on Campaign X. So Campaign X would still need to be funded by smaller dollar, grassroots donors. That also means that Campaign X had to earn the support of normal people - not just wealthy, well-connected insiders.
Why were these limits important? Because political party committees could bring in **way** more money than candidates and their campaigns ever could. So without a cap, a few major donors could funnel contributions through the committees, who could then spend nearly **unlimited** cash in direct coordination with their candidates. It's a campaign finance loophole big enough to drive a truck through, and the Supreme Court ruled that limiting coordinated spending was a necessary safeguard against corruption when it last upheld the limits in 2001.
**Republicans didn 't like the status quo because Democrats raise more small dollar donations, which gave us more efficient campaign spending and let us outraise them.**
Campaign finance laws have shifted a lot since 2001. Republicans had wins in 2010 and 2014 that have re-opened the door to unlimited spending by outside political groups.
Now, Republicans' argument is this: if we already loosened limits on independent spending, why not go all the way? Why not let donors funnel massive amounts of money to political parties, with basically **zero restrictions** , to then spend however they want, in **unlimited amounts** on candidates?
Of course Republicans want to do this. Democrats have run circles around Republicans when it comes to grassroots fundraising because we're the party focused on working class people -- not folks writing seven, eight or nine-figure checks to make politicians do their bidding.
And check out who's on their side: In addition to JD Vance leading this charge, Trump's own Solicitor General has broken decades of longstanding precedent by refusing to defend this federal statue. He's joined by Mike Johnson, Mitch McConnell and every politician who has made a career cheering on super PACs and selling government relationships to the highest bidder.
**So what does this all mean? This ruling = more money for Republicans, less transparency and more DC insider control.**
Any candidate anywhere in the country could wake up one day to $10 million, $50 million, $100 million or more in spending from a national committee to support them. The party that gets the most money from the biggest check-writers is the one who benefits: that's Republicans.
This ruling is the latest strike in a decades-long effort to dismantle campaign finance laws entirely. Unlimited party spending means that candidates will become even more dependent on whoever is bankrolling the party. Think of famous tech moguls and billionaires who have already poured hundreds of millions of dollars into GOP races, giving them an even bigger seat at the table.
Who loses? Regular working families. Voters get drowned out. Small dollar donors get silenced. Transparency disappears. And good luck figuring out who's actually pulling the strings.
**Who wins? Michael Whatley wins big.**
The _current_ RNC chair described it as a "complete game changer," and even went so far as to say, "We're going to be able to obliterate these guys." Whatley, the former RNC chair and a well-connected DC insider, could get an immediate bailout thanks to the RNC's remarkable $120 million cash on hand and to his elite DC connections.
We already saw the strength of big money before this decision came down. GOP super PACs have poured nearly $100 million so far into North Carolina. The Senate Leadership Fund, the Senate GOP's super PAC, has committed $71 million to this race. A second GOP super PAC has committed another $17 million.
This race was already expected to be the first billion-dollar Senate race in history. Today, the Supreme Court basically guaranteed it.
This decision wasn't just a legal change to campaign finance laws. It decided that wealthy donors deserve more power and access to your elected officials than you do.
But we won't let this news slow us down. And we won't let this stop us from fighting for hardworking families across this state and the country.
I know that North Carolina has a chance to send a message this November that no amount of party money, fueled by an elite few, can buy this election. We're going to win this race, and we're going to send Governor Cooper to the U.S. Senate.
We are growing an incredible grassroots movement of volunteers and donors. If you're able to [chip in](https://substack.com/redirect/03dae659-fb6d-4b24-bea3-f377f77fc41e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a few dollars or [volunteer](https://substack.com/redirect/d5bd2ba2-4f76-4dec-9041-50e2561be3a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to knock on doors, we appreciate your support.
Thanks for being in this fight.
Jeff, Campaign Manager for Cooper for North Carolina

name: Jen Kiggans
subject: If you can...

body:
We’re in a tough spot

| | | | | | Peter, it’s the end of the month....
As a Navy Veteran, Nurse Practitioner, and Mom, I’ve never been one to shy away from a challenge, but the truth is, we’re currently in a bind. The FEC quarter ends in just a couple of hours, and right now, we are not where we need to be.

Peter,
In light of our quarterly FEC fundraising deadline at 11:59 p.m. tonight, I’m asking you to make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina. By giving $5, you’ll be declaring your membership in the fight for working families and that you refuse to stand by and watch a Washington DC insider and former Big Oil and Utility company lobbyist buy this seat.
**By giving $5, most critically, you’ll help us reach our can’t-miss fundraising goals – including the $1.5 million target we need to hit by the end of the day.**

Hi friends,

Early voting begins July 21, and the Republican Primary is August 18. We're=

on between now and Election Day matters.

This week, we continued meeting voters in north, south, and central Wyoming=
. Every stop reinforces the same thing: people are paying attention, asking=
thoughtful questions, and looking for listening and leadership.

We've now participated in a number of candidate forums across the state, an=
d there are more to come. If you haven't had a chance to hear directly from=
us, I encourage you to attend a forum, stop by a meet and greet or town ha=
ll, or spend some time watching the forum videos and interviews we've poste=
d on our Facebook page. The best way to make an informed decision is to hea=
r from the candidates in their own words.

Now is the time to get involved. Talk with your family. Visit with your nei=
ghbors. Invite a friend to an event. Join a neighborhood door-knocking effo=
rt, text your contacts. Make sure everyone who plans to vote is registered,=
knows when early voting begins, and has a plan to cast their ballot. A few=
minutes of encouragement can make all the difference. We are continuing to=
have our volunteers in neighborhoods around Wyoming, knocking on another 4=
50 households this past week.=C2=A0

Thank you for the time, conversations, and warm welcomes we've received acr=
oss Wyoming. We'll keep showing up, listening, and earning your support, on=
e community at a time.

-Eric

On The Trail

PINE BLUFFS

Kelly and I had a great evening in Pine Bluffs for a meet-and-greet and the=
ir famous Politics and Pie Social.

This event has brought candidates and the community together since 1984, wh=
en Lawrence Anderson started it with the simple belief that voters deserve =
the chance to meet the people asking for their vote before the primary. Tha=
t tradition continues today, and it showed last night.

Good conversations and even better pie. Thank you to everyone in Pine Bluff=
s who came out to visit.

CHEYENNE

When we were prepping for the pie social in Pine Bluffs, we realized we had=
no mixer! No problem, we can =E2=80=9Cranch-adapt=E2=80=9D! Getting things=
done is about collaboration and teamwork! Coconut, chocolate and banana cr=
eam pies were delicious!

PINE BLUFFS

Kelly and I were lucky enough to get a tour of the Pine Bluffs Distillery o=
peration. Owner Chad shared the history of his successful family business, =
including his decision to keep it in his smaller, local community. We were =
also able to see some beautiful local keg art, sample some of their newly r=
evealed offerings, and tap a keg!

Their business is a community anchor, and their =E2=80=98Farm to Flask=E2=
=80=99 story is one to hear.

GILLETTE/NEWCASTLE

Kelly and I spent a morning at The Local Coffee Shop in Gillette for a meet=
-and-greet, where the conversations were real =E2=80=94 housing and healthc=
are are on people=E2=80=99s minds, and we=E2=80=99re listening. Later, we s=
topped by the senior center and wrapped the evening at a barbecue in Newcas=
tle. Grateful for the various handshakes and every honest conversation

GILLETTE

Kelly and I attended the Third Street Plaza Ice Cream Social & Candidate Me=
et-and-Greet in Gillette.

Good crowd and good conversations, many about healthcare.

Rural access and keeping care close to Wyoming communities have always been=
a priority, and I=E2=80=99ll work hard to keep care within reach.

CASPER

I participated in a candidate forum at the Politics in the Park in Casper.

One thing I made very clear was that Wyoming is not for sale, and I=E2=80=
=99ll do whatever it takes to protect public lands and make sure decisions =
are made in Wyoming, for Wyoming.

Kelly and I also enjoyed meeting people at the booth, where we served root =
beer floats.

BAR NUNN/CASPER
Kelly and I spent time with the Wyoming Stock Growers Association, Wyoming =
Farm Bureau Federation, and Wyoming Wool Growers Association in Bar Nunn.

Agriculture is the backbone of Wyoming, and I have always fought to protect=
the property rights and livelihoods of the men and women who work this lan=
d. That means pushing back on federal overreach, protecting water rights, a=
nd ensuring Wyoming producers have a seat at the table when decisions are m=
ade.

We spent the afternoon touring Life Care Center in Casper. It is a great fa=
cility with great people taking care of Wyoming seniors every day. It was g=
ood to see the work up close and visit with the staff and residents who cal=
l it home.

CHEYENNE

Kelly and I had a fantastic turnout for a meet and greet in Cheyenne. Thank=
you, Cathy Ellis!

Great crowd and good, honest discussion on state priorities. We talked abou=
t weed mitigation for rangeland, regional offices, and more. These are the =
kinds of issues that matter to Wyoming citizens

HULETT
Kelly and I spent a great evening at a meet and greet event in Hulett.

I was able to talk with a lot of friends, old and new, including quite a fe=
w members of the UW Cowboy Joe Club, who are doing great work on behalf of =
the University.

It was a great summer evening with lots of ideas and hope for Wyoming.

IT'S PARADE SEASON!!

Kelly and I had a wonderful start to the weekend across two great Wyoming c=
ommunities! We started in Glenrock, where a huge volunteer crew joined us f=
or the Deer Creek Days parade =E2=80=94 Dan Holman even brought out a class=
ic Ford truck to lead the way =E2=80=94 and we enjoyed plenty of great conv=
ersations with folks at the park afterward. We then traveled to Glendo and =
were reminded once again why we are in this race. Thank you both communitie=
s for the warm welcome

We had folks representing the campaign at Flaming Gorge Days in Green River=
this weekend, and they even made it into the parade. It means a lot to sho=
w up in communities across this state and be welcomed the way Wyoming alway=
s does!

We also participated in the parade in Lovell and LaBarge, and participated =
in Super Day in Cheyenne. Our field team is doing a great job sharing our m=
essage around the state. Keep an eye out for us, especially around July 4!=

| | If you’ve ever donated to a political campaign (or even engaged with one online), you’re probably getting inundated with texts and emails. **They're all saying: “we only have a few hours left!!!”** But does it really matter if you donate one day vs. the next? As much as I want the answer to be no, the real answer is that **while these deadlines aren’t**** _everything,_****they do matter.** Here’s why: After every quarter, campaigns must disclose what they raised and what they spent. This transparency is vital. But the moment these reports go public, everyone from our opponent’s team to would-be supporters to journalists to endorsing organizations **comb through these reports to see if I’m a “viable” candidate.** I have a hunch that y’all have so generously supported this campaign not because I’m some great fundraiser, but because you believe in this vision we share for East Tennessee.**You believe that I’m the best chance to beat Tim that this district has had in generations.** **Beyond viability, why should you contribute now instead of later?** We have some expenses coming up that are catapulting this campaign into our most _expansive_ phase yet:
* $1905 – 10,000 pieces of campaign lit for doorknocking & events
* $2938 – 500 yard signs from a local, union business
* $7,869 – Design, print, and assembly of our BIG road signs
* $16,429 – Bi-weekly payroll for our local team
* $21,475 – Sending a mailer to 31,000 voters in TN-02

**Money doesn’t make a movement. But it does help fuel one.** Last week, we set an FEC filing goal of $22,227 so we could hit a record quarter filing of $175,000. Our FEC filing closes at midnight tonight (for real) and **we’re now just $4,071.47 away from that goal!** Will you chip in my lucky number of $27 or whatever amount is comfortable for you to help us make history in East Tennessee? clean_body: Let’s discuss, plus some campaign updates! | | | If you’ve ever donated to a political campaign (or even engaged with one online), you’re probably getting inundated with texts and emails. They're all saying: “we only have a few hours left!!!” But does it really matter if you donate one day vs. the next? As much as I want the answer to be no, the real answer is that while these deadlines aren’t everything,they do matter. Here’s why: After every quarter, campaigns must disclose what they raised and what they spent. This transparency is vital. But the moment these reports go public, everyone from our opponent’s team to would-be supporters to journalists to endorsing organizations comb through these reports to see if I’m a “viable” candidate. I have a hunch that y’all have so generously supported this campaign not because I’m some great fundraiser, but because you believe in this vision we share for East Tennessee.You believe that I’m the best chance to beat Tim that this district has had in generations. Beyond viability, why should you contribute now instead of later? We have some expenses coming up that are catapulting this campaign into our most expansive phase yet: $1905 – 10,000 pieces of campaign lit for doorknocking & events $2938 – 500 yard signs from a local, union business $7,869 – Design, print, and assembly of our BIG road signs $16,429 – Bi-weekly payroll for our local team $21,475 – Sending a mailer to 31,000 voters in TN-02 Money doesn’t make a movement. But it does help fuel one. Last week, we set an FEC filing goal of $22,227 so we could hit a record quarter filing of $175,000. Our FEC filing closes at midnight tonight (for real) and we’re now just $4,071.47 away from that goal!** Will you chip in my lucky number of $27 or whatever amount is comfortable for you to help us make history in East Tennessee? They're winning primaries left and right, and traditional Dem leaders are quickly becoming irrelevant.

But when you look at what the Democratic Socialists of America believe, it's not a different policy angle.

They're not looking to reform the country--they want to rebuild it from the ground up.
It's radical and it's pulling the Democrats farther left than they've ever been.
Pretty soon, every Democrat is going to have to answer where they stand.
We can't ignore it anymore; we have to know what the Democratic Socialists are about and how to address it.

|
## America 250: Pursuit of Happiness SV
---
Peter Ohtaki — June 28, 2026
---
Americans know by heart the inalienable rights listed in the Declaration of Independence - Life, Liberty and the _**Pursuit of Happiness.**_ No other constitution or founding document lists this right - _**Opportunity**_ \- as the enduring right which distinguishes the USA. Often described as _**the American Dream**_ \- if you work hard, you can succeed here despite wherever you’re from, whatever your background or ethnic origin. Industrialization turned the U.S. into a superpower, as innovation after innovation scaled in America - electricity, cars, aircraft, food, movies, television, oil, etc. Growing up in Silicon Valley, I’ve lived through waves of innovation - semiconductors, PCs, dot.com bubble, iPhone, social media and now AI. Silicon Valley innovation fuels S&P500 growth - that’s been the American Dream in the Golden State.
#### Only 4 in 10 U.S. adults feel proud about America’s 250th anniversary
We’re only one of two houses on my street flying the American flag. Political polarization has resulted in hostility and undermined America’s confidence in our institutions. I get it - [60% of Americans live paycheck to paycheck](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a43e831fab5fd158fe43d66&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2024-5-4%2Finflation%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6a41fd3c8dab983b60d4634b%26ss_email_id%3D6a43e831fab5fd158fe43d66%26ss_campaign_name%3DAmerica%2B250%253A%2BPursuit%2Bof%2BHappiness%2BSV%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-06-30T16%253A01%253A40Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a41fd3c8dab983b60d4634b&l=en-US&s=6zOVbhaU_0TQoRMVwzK3IIfMAms%3D) and our government seems dysfunctional. Nearly 8 in 10 say signers of the Declaration would be disappointed.
#### What did Jefferson and Adams expect?
Exactly 50 years after signing the Declaration of Independence, co-authors Thomas Jefferson and John Adams, both died on the same day July 4, 1826. Both early Presidents and leaders of opposite political parties, they began corresponding again during the War of 1812 against the British, when the country’s survival was again tested:
---
|
---
| Quotes from Thomas Jefferson in blue from his letters to John Adams 1812-13
---
#### The Bicentennial was jubilant
The Bicentennial seemed exciting here - many parades, events and Elton John sang _Philadelphia Freedom_. I’m not sure things were that different in 1976. We lost Vietnam, Russia/Soviet Union was our enemy, and Iran would soon take Americans hostage (read _[Cold War 2.0](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a43e831fab5fd158fe43d66&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2024%2F5-4%2Fcoldwar20%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6a41fd3c8dab983b60d4634b%26ss_email_id%3D6a43e831fab5fd158fe43d66%26ss_campaign_name%3DAmerica%2B250%253A%2BPursuit%2Bof%2BHappiness%2BSV%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-06-30T16%253A01%253A40Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6a41fd3c8dab983b60d4634b&l=en-US&s=_BkrFh3IGX2Ab5A69BA1tAJz0OE%3D)_). Our economic competitor was Japan, not China. Manufacturing started to leave, as the term “Rust belt states” was coined. After the oil price shock from the OPEC embargo during the 1973 Yom Kippur War in the Middle East, inflation ran at 5.76% in 1976. 30-year fixed rate mortgages were 8.85% after falling from 16.64% in 1972. Democrats controlled the House, but Republicans often were in the White House. The only difference was Reagan could have dinner with Speaker Tip O’Neill and figure out a compromise.
#### What’s the Good News?
---
|
---
| Gemini sources: US National Accounts, EU World Bank/IMF, China National Bureau Statistics
---
The Gross Domestic Product per capita in the U.S. is nearly twice Europe and 6x China. Our economy continues to grow with innovation driving productivity, much from Silicon Valley. Well-functioning and efficient capital markets with limited governmental regulation facilitates innovation.
#### Celebrate the Semiquincentennial America 250!

name: Voter Registration Team @ Voter Action Project
subject: What voter registration and turnout does
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
MS NOW: ‘The largest investment ever’: DNC launches voter registration drive [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=063026_2&amount=30]
The 2025 elections showed us a valuable truth, folks: Voter participation is increasing in all the right ways.
Voter registration activity increased across the country. According to the team at National Voter Registration Day, New York recorded more registrations for their 2025 events than in 2024, and California saw similar increases. Earlier this fall it looked like voter participation was going to make a real jump, even in a so-called "off-year".
Then Election Day came. New Jersey had more voters turn out for a gubernatorial election than they had in 20 years. Crucial counties in Pennsylvania saw their highest turnout levels in almost 15 years. New York City reached a turnout percentage unseen in over five decades.
We can drive even higher levels of participation when voters understand the stakes and feel like their vote matters , just like it did last November. That's why our voter registration efforts are so important, and why we work on it all year long.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=063026_2&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=063026_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=063026_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=063026_2&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=063026_2&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=063026_2&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=063026_2&amount=36]
The key is getting young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever. Pundits in Virginia said they could have called the election results when they saw the first turnout numbers from the major college campus locations around the state. That's the kind of impact these young voters can have.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The upcoming midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- can be game-changing. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of this year's voter registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=063026_2&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=063026_2&amount=20]

subject: Today was a victory for all of us. ✊🏽
body:
Today's decision should put to rest any further attempts to take a political hacksaw to our Constitution. | | | Peter, Today, the Supreme Court upheld the constitutional right to birthright citizenship. This is a victory — for all of us. ✊🏽 Let's be clear about what this win means: _this was the only outcome that should have ever been on the table._ Birthright citizenship is a fundamental constitutional guarantee and a cornerstone of our democracy. Friend, it’s Liz, Seth’s wife. Senator Markey has spent the last few days attacking my family over our finances. **Here’s my message to him:** _This is not the 1970s. It is 2026. As surprising as it may be to you, a woman can support her family all on her own._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134323499/630875749/2090747700?refcode=260630_lm_liz_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YTNkMTZmNy05Zjc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q-vl71ZkKADQJ1nKIUrBE7bh6_URSfdjYsYbnzmm_VM=) Seth and I file jointly. subject: Every student deserves a dignified path forward.
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Dave Beckwith For Congress_
body:
A 4-year degree the leaves students with loads of debt doesn't have to be the answer for everyone.
| | | | Hi Friend,
**The Q2 FEC deadline closes at midnight** and I still need **50 donors to give $50** before then to reach our goal. Help me make tonight's number one that gets noticed.
_**[GIVE $50 BEFORE MIDNIGHT](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)**_
I have heard from many Virginia families, specifically from our parents, that their kids are being funneled toward a four-year college degree as if it is the only acceptable measure of success, while the trades, the technical careers, and the skilled workforce that actually powers our economy go begging for talent. A generation takes on crushing student debt for degrees that do not lead where they were promised. Meanwhile, employers in construction, manufacturing, technology, and defense cannot find the trained workers they need.
I am going to Washington to help recalibrate this cycle.
As a homeschool dad of three, I did not just arrive at this issue through policy papers. I have lived the reality that parents, not federal agencies, know what path is right for their child.
**I will go to Congress and fight for federal investment in vocational training and apprenticeship programs that connect students directly to high-paying careers, debt-free.** A young person who completes an apprenticeship and starts earning a competitive wage is not a lesser success story than a college graduate.
To me, this is a fight worth bringing to Washington. I hope you see it that way too and will help me get there.
If 50 people give $50 before midnight, we are that much closer to putting that voice in Congress.
_**[HELP ME REACH THAT GOAL](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)**_
If you have already given recently, **forwarding this to one person who has not yet heard about this campaign means just as much.**
---
| | | God Bless, Dave Beckwith
**Beckwith for Congress** _Safe. Strong. Responsible._

_P.S. — The skilled trades are short millions of workers while student loan debt just crossed $1.8 trillion nationally. I am running to change this._

body:
We're dropping something brand new today, and it's about to make waves. You made it possible, so you get the first look.

| | | | | [|

| | | | | |
Hey all. Adam here (actually me, I promise). If you’re getting this email, you donated to the campaign at some point in the last 6 months. First, I am forever in your debt. Second, I think it’s time to show the latest example of what you paid for. I’m not asking for money in this email. I’m just excited to share:
The new Adam for Congress campaign video, “Make Them Remember.”
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/wNHnKVgtgMZ?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| | This video is... incredible. I don’t have the words to describe what it’s like seeing myself like this. I usually hate watching myself on camera, but Jordan and Ceci from [The Back House Studio](https://us.list-manage.com/1CrCWfNAt7I?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) in Falls Church did right by us. I knew he would too, because Jordan’s been coy about it for weeks now as he pieced this together. He knew he was going to make us proud.
So, give it a watch. Give it several watches. Then send it to everyone you know, no matter where they are. People need to hear that we’re coming.
If you’ve got feedback, accolades, or questions, let me know what you think (you can reply directly to this email; responses go straight to me). You were part of making this video, even if you didn’t know until today, and it’s just as much yours as it is mine.
Massive thanks to Jordan and Ceci at Back House, but even more thanks to all of you who believed in me enough to make this all possible. August 4th is coming fast. And I’ve got a feeling, if we look half as good as a campaign as we do in this video, we’re going all the way.
Happy almost-Independence Day, everyone. Let’s take this country back.
Adam

Four conservative members of the US Supreme Court just said that birthright citizenship should be stripped away, despite the Constitution's guarantees.
Worse yet: all 6 of the Republican Justices on the Court decided to blow open a devastating loophole that will now allow the super rich and billionaire political donors to coordinate spending unlimited sums of cash with candidates for public office.
The loophole is an arcane procedure called a "coordinated party expenditure" that now can be used to funnel unlimited cash through official party committees straight to candidates. Before the Court's ruling, these coordinated expenditures were subject to legal limits enforced by the FEC.
Justice Elena Kagan summed up how corrupt the Court's decision was in her dissent: "With no limits on coordinated expenditures, the party can serve as the candidate's checking account."

These emails are the best way for our campaign to stay in touch with supporters like you. If you'd prefer to unsubscribe, [click here](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/7010?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.30_Hard_B1_F1_S1_C1_actives-exp_N-T0&t=1&akid=6431%2E196590%2EyiqLa6).

Every dollar we raise goes toward fighting for working families and ensuring Wisconsin stays blue. ->_**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/7342?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.30_Hard_B1_F1_S1_C1_actives-exp_N-T0&t=4&akid=6431%2E196590%2EyiqLa6) | | [ CHIP IN $5 -> ](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/7311?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.30_Hard_B1_F1_S1_C1_actives-exp_N-T0&t=5&akid=6431%2E196590%2EyiqLa6)

**But Tom Tiffany isn 't slowing down:** His MAGA billionaire backers just poured millions into this race! When you only count on billionaire and corporate PAC donations, you don’t have to worry about a summer slump at all.

**_If we fall short of our goal tonight, that one sign of weakness could be enough to give Tom Tiffany the edge he needs to crush our small lead in the polls. _**

That’s why taking a day off isn’t an option for us. Not with polls showing this race as a dead heat.

This race will be decided by whoever continues to put in the work to reach Wisconsin voters in the moments when nobody is watching. That moment is right now.

[**_My team and I are fighting like hell to win this race and beat back the dreaded summer slump. Can I count on you to step up and ensure we have the cash to compete through the election? name: Wes Moore
subject: Since becoming governor
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1569%2E1086043%2EaAsf5E)
Peter,
I want to make sure to tell you _why_ it’s so important that folks **[step up and help us reach our fundraising goal before our end-of-quarter deadline tonight.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260630-1.irByNO&refcode=em-20260630-1&t=2&akid=1569%2E1086043%2EaAsf5E)**
Since I’ve become governor, the focus has been simple: **Work, Wages, and Wealth.**
That’s what our administration has been fighting for, for every Marylander, however we have the power to make it possible.
We’re lowering utility bills and building more housing across Maryland. We’re standing with federal workers and bringing more jobs to our state. And we’re standing up to the chaos of the federal government.
But Peter, there’s still so much more work to be done.
I’m running for re-election to keep pushing that mission of work, wages, and wealth for everybody. This campaign will only be successful if I have the support of a grassroots movement -- including you. I can’t do it alone. That’s why I’m asking:
**[Can you chip in any amount to power our movement? Anything you can give before tonight’s deadline will set the pace of our re-election campaign for the summer and beyond.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260630-1.irByNO&refcode=em-20260630-1&t=3&akid=1569%2E1086043%2EaAsf5E)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260630-1.irByNO&amount=5&refcode=em-20260630-1&t=22&akid=1569%2E1086043%2EaAsf5E)**
I know that between reckless tariff policies and wars of choice overseas, the costs of the chaos coming out of Washington are being felt by our working families here at home.
I’m glad to have you by my side as we work to find solutions to bring costs down in Maryland -- and whether or not you’re able to chip in today, you’re a valuable part of our grassroots team.
Elevate,
Wes
[ ](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260630-1.irByNO&refcode=em-20260630-1&t=23&akid=1569%2E1086043%2EaAsf5E)

| **Statement from WAGOP Chairman Rep. Jim Walsh on SCOTUS ruling in Watson v. RNC:**
[](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30675&L=15788&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9XQUdPUC9zdGF0dXMvMjA3MTY3NTMyMzc0MjM2Mzg2Mj91dG1fY29udGVudD1DTVRReE5UZzFNalElM0Q=&hash=05fa179b476c2cbcf2de1625112afe04697455123b18949c1f2993cc3530bbd4)
"The Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP) is disappointed but not deterred by today's 'Watson' opinion from the U.S. Supreme Court ([https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/25pdf/24-1260_g3cn.pdf](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30675&L=15789&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc3VwcmVtZWNvdXJ0Lmdvdi9vcGluaW9ucy8yNXBkZi8yNC0xMjYwX2czY24ucGRmP3V0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNVFF4TlRnMU1qUSUzRA==&hash=b21514e582c16f0a4e26ec905aa301323474d339d3bdc0aedb21e70906e6c367)). The opinion was a 5-4 split, so the Court itself was far from unified on the issue of how ‘Election Day’ is defined. We believe that the Court's minority, led by Justice Alito, made the clearer point that mail-in ballots should be received, not just postmarked, by Election Day.

"Going forward, three points essential to election integrity in Washington remain.

"First, at the federal level, passage of the SAVE America Act is more important than ever. It is an essential reform.

"Second, here in our Washington, WAGOP will redouble its efforts to reform state election law and practices to align with the federal SAVE America Act. We need state and federal election law to support one another, not undermine each other.

"Third, WAGOP will continue to expand its election integrity ground game. This means watching ballot processing even more closely. In our state, ballots must be collected from ballot boxes by 8 PM on Election Day or clearly postmarked by Election Day. Ballots 'found' after Election Day that are not clearly postmarked by Election Day cannot be counted. That's current state election law.

"One final note: Washington's current law allows ballots postmarked by Election Day to be received by county election officials and counted up to 21 days after Election Day. This is the least secure and most problematic timeline in the nation. As Justice Alito writes in his 'Watson' dissent, this practice erodes the constitutional definition of 'Election Day.' WAGOP remains committed to making Washington State elections fair, transparent, and trustworthy. That requires common-sense reform."
#

It’s one of the reasons I founded my Climate PAC: to help root out that influence and elect leaders who are accountable to people, not corporate power. Today, voters in Colorado have an opportunity to choose _real_ leaders in must-win primaries for our movement. **But many of the leaders we’ve endorsed have been up against _nearly $2 million_ in dark money that has flooded into Colorado — and there are many races like this around the country.** **[That’s why my team set a goal of bringing in 15,000 grassroots donations — regardless of the dollar amount — to build an unshakeable movement of individuals from coast to coast. Look, this wave of dark money is no accident.
**Special interests are _flooding_ state and local level races with untraceable money to undermine our climate champions and keep us from building the firewall we need against the fossil fuel industry’s destruction and the Trump administration’s rampant profiteering.**
This spending spree underscores just how important down-ballot races can be. Because whoever advances in tonight’s primaries could decide whether communities divest from fossil fuels that poison us — or whether corporate polluters will be allowed to continue doing business as usual, even when it makes everyday people seriously ill or renders our planet unlivable.
Those decisions, and the leaders who make them, have the power to fundamentally change the way we live, work, and relate to the natural world around us. **Big Oil doesn’t need another seat at the table, where these decisions are made — _we do._**
**And getting our seat at the table starts with electing the leaders who understand the urgency of this fight for climate justice.**

body:
Donald Trump isn’t giving up. Neither are we.
#
Peter,
Today, the Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration’s xenophobic executive order to end birthright citizenship in _Trump v. Barbara_ effectively.
By reaffirming that every child born on American soil is a citizen, the Court chose to embrace our multiracial and multicultural reality, rather than succumb to a political agenda rooted in the fear of it.
**This is a huge victory — but it’s not the end of the fight. We know Donald Trump and his MAGA enablers are going to continue to silence our voices.[Will you pitch in $3 to power Voto Latino’s work to defend our communities and political power? ](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260630-1.BD0LgN&amount=3&refcode=em20260630-327&t=1&akid=327%2E1366028%2E4wQMNQ)**
This ruling protects millions of families — workers on H-1B, F-1, and L-1 visas, mixed-status households, the children of DACA and TPS holders, and the millions of Americans born here to unauthorized parents, who are mostly all Latino.
**Today's ruling reaffirms that no executive order, no political agenda, and no climate of fear can override a constitutional promise in the 14th Amendment** — one that was fought for, won, and has been the law of the land for over 150 years.
That matters because this case was never about legal theory — it was about whether our country would allow politicians to decide who belongs and who doesn’t on a whim.
**Today, that effort failed, Peter.**
This victory belongs to the countless advocates, organizers, community members, and supporters like you who refused to stay silent. Together, we showed that when we organize, speak out, and defend our democracy, we can stop even the most dangerous attack on our rights.
But let’s be clear: Donald Trump isn’t giving up — and neither can we.
**Voto Latino will continue to organize voters and build the political power needed to hold him accountable and protect our rights.[Will you make a gift today to help Voto Latino keep up the fight?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260630-1.BD0LgN&amount=3&%3Brefcode=em20260630-327&t=2&akid=327%2E1366028%2E4wQMNQ)**

Thank you,
Team Voto Latino

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

So, I decided to put my entire career – not to mention every cent I had – on the line to spread the story myself.

I left my job as a research analyst... went home to my third-floor apartment in one of Baltimore’s worst neighborhoods... and with a borrowed laptop, I wrote my first financial prophecy.

And in an investment paper that’s now been read by more than one hundred thousand people...

I explained how the endless miles of new fiber optic cables being laid was creating a new railroad across America.

And that this new “railroad” was going to upend the telecommunications industry and pave the way for a new internet economy.

I also warned it would decimate some of America's most dominant companies like AT&T.;

At the time, this was an outlandish idea, with analysts calling AT&T; “dominant”, “unstoppable”, and “the giant that no other company can topple.”

But those who were willing to open their minds to my so-called “radical” ideas were not only able to sell these companies before they collapsed...

Amazon, Adobe, Qualcomm, SunMicrosystems, Uniphase, Texas Instruments... These are household names now, but when I first recommended them in the late 90s, they were complete unknowns.

Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | I wish this wasn’t the case... But it’s happening, . And now a colossal societal shift is about to upend everything. I first warned my readers of this threat months ago. Many disregarded it. It seemed too far off... too extreme... but now it’s happening... and mark my words: it’s going to from here because the cat is now officially out of the bag. Let me explain: News just broke that Meta is laying off 10% of its employees (around 8,000 jobs) in a push for "efficiency." On the same day Microsoft announced it will offer voluntary retirement to 7% of their U.S. workers (stated another way, quit now on your terms or we’ll fire you). Oracle, Block, Snap, Amazon, and others have all done the same. Although most people think this is about AI... it’s not. The story goes far deeper and is far more consequential. It’s something that I’ve been warning off for months now. And I’m not the only one. Two Nobel Prize winners have warned of . Because they know, as I do, this event could trigger a once-in-a-generation wealth shift. A transfer of wealth that’s already begun with Goldman Sachs estimating 12,400 Americans are being financially destroyed every day ... while others grow richer than ever before. Which side you’re on could depend on what you do next. Because for those who understand what’s unfolding, this could be one of the greatest wealth-building phenomena of their lives. But for those who bury their head in the sand... this force threatens to wipe out years of investment returns and could even destroy their financial future. . 26 years ago, I started telling friends, family, and anyone who would listen about an unprecedented societal shift that was barreling down on us. I’d discovered that a new technology was about to unleash massive, almost unimaginable, changes. I likened the impact to the railroad boom, the Industrial Revolution, and the rise of personal computing. At the time, I was working as an investment analyst for an elite research group, but my colleagues and bosses refused to listen to me. No matter what I said, they simply would not acknowledge the sands shifting beneath their feet. The legendary Dr. Kurt Richebächer – one of the world’s leading Austrian economists – even called me and my ideas “radical.” But I was certain this new technology would trigger a transformation that was simply unfathomable to most people... and those on the frontier could reap financial returns unlike any the world had ever seen before. So, I decided to put my entire career – not to mention every cent I had – on the line to spread the story myself. I left my job as a research analyst... went home to my third-floor apartment in one of Baltimore’s worst neighborhoods... and with a borrowed laptop, I wrote my first financial prophecy. And in an investment paper that’s now been read by more than one hundred thousand people... I explained how the endless miles of new fiber optic cables being laid was creating a new railroad across America. And that this new “railroad” was going to upend the telecommunications industry and pave the way for a new internet economy. I also warned it would decimate some of America's most dominant companies like AT&T.; At the time, this was an outlandish idea, with analysts calling AT&T; “dominant”, “unstoppable”, and “the giant that no other company can topple.” But those who were willing to open their minds to my so-called “radical” ideas were not only able to sell these companies before they collapsed... They also had the chance to get in early on the firms that would go on to command this new internet economy: Amazon, Adobe, Qualcomm, SunMicrosystems, Uniphase, Texas Instruments... These are household names now, but when I first recommended them in the late 90s, they were complete unknowns. Since then, I’ve issued a number of other financial prophecies, many of which have come to pass precisely as I predicted. But today, I believe could surpass anything I’ve ever done... It’s an investigation into what I call The Final Displacement ... and I don’t think we will ever again see a story that rivals the magnitude of this during my lifetime. I’m not talking about AI... quantum computing... augmented reality... the blockchain... or anything else you might be thinking of. No. This is far bigger than them all. In fact... It’s the cornerstone that all our recent technological innovations have been built upon and the future will be built upon too. . Outside of the labs in the world’s most prestigious universities and tech companies, almost nobody has. But those who have ... those who can see the writing on the wall... they’re investing billions of dollars, as they know this will transform everything. Marc Andreessen... Ben Horowitz... Elon Musk... Jeff Bezos... Mark Zuckerberg...Jensen Huang... Bill Gates... the list goes on and on. They know, as I do, that in a few years from now, we will not recognize the world we live in. How we work, live, communicate, transact... it will all be completely upended by what’s coming next. Today, I’m going to share it all with you... . You see, despite the magnitude of this story, nobody is openly and freely discussing this turning point. And that deeply concerns me, because I believe its emergence will draw an indelible demarcation line in society. On one side, you’ll have those who understand it, invest in it, and who are greatly enriched by it. On the other side... you’ll have those who underestimate it, turn a blind eye and are unfortunately impoverished by the sweeping changes it ushers in. I know what side I’ll be on. And I know what side I want you to be on. my full investigation into this story. name: API PA
subject: SCOTUS Upholds Birthright Citizenship
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org/ [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/]
Hi Peter,
Today, many families in our community felt a sense of relief: the Supreme Court upheld our constitution and shot down the Trump administration’s attempt to undo birthright citizenship.
The Supreme Court’s decision rests in part on a 128 year old case, where Wong Kim Ark, facing anti-Chinese xenophobia, successfully fought to have his birthright citizenship recognized. The history and legacy of birthright citizenship runs strong in our immigrant communities — many of us have roots that stretch far overseas, but all our futures lie in America. We are happy to see that this critical right is preserved for generations of new Americans to come.
This decision is a relief — but it shouldn’t have to be. We know that the Trump administration has attempted repeatedly to erode our rights and freedoms, and that our communities still face attacks on our safety and dignity.
But, like we have throughout history, we are ready to stand strong and win.
When our communities are targeted, we know that information, organizing, and solidarity make a difference. At API PA, we're making sure Asian American communities have the resources they need to stay informed, understand their rights, and build the power necessary to protect one another.
This work is only possible because people like you make it possible.
If you believe that every family deserves to feel safe, that immigrant communities belong here, where we have made our homes, and that Asian Americans should have the power to shape Pennsylvania's future, will you become a dues-paying member today? [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/membership]
Being a member means you get to be a part of:
* Reaching families with multilingual information and resources.
* Organizing communities to advocate for policies that protect immigrant and refugee families.
* Developing new Asian American leaders and strengthening civic participation across Pennsylvania.
* Building the long-term power our communities need to respond to attacks on our rights.
Become a Member [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/membership]
This court decision is a win for today, but we’re gearing up to keep winning tomorrow and into the future. Together, we'll continue fighting for a Pennsylvania where every family belongs, every voice matters, and every community has the opportunity to thrive.
In solidarity,
Mohan Seshadri
Executive Director
Asian Pacific Islander Political Alliance

A Democrat super PAC recently announced a $50 million effort to flip Republican-held seats across the country, and our district is one of their top targets. They may have deep pockets, but what we've built together has never been about Washington insiders. It's been about the people who live, work, and raise their families right here in Colorado. Over the coming months, my team and I will be working tirelessly to connect with voters across all 27 counties, share our record, and make the case for the values we believe in. But we can't do it alone. The truth is, campaigns like this require resources. Every television ad, digital message, mail piece, and voter outreach effort will matter as outside money floods into our district. subject: Why I visited all 57 Delaware towns and cities
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
From Wilmington to Lewes and Dover to Seaford, we showed up everywhere to meet with voters and listen to their experiences.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3486%2E21716%2E1lU3zV)
Earlier this month I had the chance to visit all 57 Delaware towns and cities. From Wilmington to Lewes and Dover to Seaford, we showed up everywhere to meet with voters and listen to their experiences.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260630-1.1NrV2F&refcode=em20260630-3486&t=2&akid=3486%2E21716%2E1lU3zV)
Along the way, I got to attend the Separation Day Parade in New Castle, talk with our neighbors in Clayton about the impact of Trump’s reckless tariffs, stop by the scenic Leipsic River, and even serve some chicken tenders and fries at Uncle Bernie’s in Frederica.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260630-1.1NrV2F&refcode=em20260630-3486&t=3&akid=3486%2E21716%2E1lU3zV)
_And of course, I had to stop at the Milton Home Coffee Roastery._
While Donald Trump was busy stoking culture wars and bailing out his billionaire buddies, I wanted to remind Delawareans why they trusted me to represent them in Congress: to deliver lower costs, expand access to healthcare, and protect our fundamental rights.
I’m proud to be fighting for what’s right for Delaware — and this November, we have a chance to take back the majority, start holding the Trump administration accountable, and begin work on an agenda that puts working families first.
But in order to win re-election and help other Democrats across the country, I’m counting on your grassroots support.
[**So with our end-of-quarter deadline coming up at midnight tonight, can I count on you to pitch in $5 or any amount right now to help us reach our $275,000 goal?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260630-1.1NrV2F&refcode=em20260630-3486&amount=5&t=4&akid=3486%2E21716%2E1lU3zV)

In gratitude,
Sarah McBride

Peter,
My truck used to haul crops and farm tools, but now it's carrying yard signs, campaign lit, and a message of hope for Louisiana. And in 3 months, we put 30k miles on it.
I have been to every single one of the 64 parishes (what most folks call counties) in Louisiana. My farm pickup truck and I are on a mission to find every voter who wants accountability in D.C.
In the words of country legend Eddie Rabbitt, "I'm driving my life away," blaring Zydeco on the road as I crisscross the state of Louisiana from one event to the next. And honestly, I'm loving every minute of it.
---
| [](https://kseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001n1RKWlIzv0vIpFnimSi8e7M_FVKpNbsKPoTmw5qrv_Wk3vvqkoofGKp3yOBACB4KHiPDuu6C5UmBaURUdcwGLjghv-OkmLPbOppOMwEK3b6XrvTCuFUv9ZA3NpmSnZewq2UPoZjBUSRhvFEyqz6Z1bO2TDcUBJ8mRpKyEt1EA0QvK61scfmJThXH9uqcY0H6_eAX0TIcCsCYenaQUz2k4g==&c=rsUVi-cWDY-8tZNN7awY54IfsgAAJLEdvbNnHeBN9jC2dKD7eIsDqA==&ch=6X33UPgo69FFYw_2iMb_lOYg1GmtaXTDKC192UDknrQFIyYtX1tg0w==)

This truck and I worked hard to come out of the runoff in a landslide leading in every parish with 80% of the vote.
We made history. A Black person has not been elected statewide in Louisiana since Reconstruction.
But I didn't run to make history; I ran because I know from firsthand experience what so many Americans are going through. We aren't stopping or slowing down now - this freedom ride has only just begun.
My name is Jamie Davis. Our victory shocked the nation--and the pundits in Louisiana. I'm a successful third-generation row crop farmer farming over 3000 acres, the same land my grandfather once worked as a sharecropper - only now we own it.
James Carville was so inspired by our runoff that he said Democrats now have a "fighting chance" to flip Louisiana's open US Senate seat blue. A Democrat won this Senate seat in 2008 and in 2026, we are going to do it again. But we have to work for it.
I put 30,000 miles on my truck to hear what voters have to say, and I've got to report back: they are pissed off and ready to fight for the soul of this nation.
And I'll drive 100k more to find every single person--whether Democrat, Independent, or Republican--who is sick of MAGA ruining our country and wants a new direction. clean_body: I am driving my life away, but I gotta keep rolling to flip this state. | | | | | == Peter, My truck used to haul crops and farm tools, but now it's carrying yard signs, campaign lit, and a message of hope for Louisiana. And in 3 months, we put 30k miles on it. I have been to every single one of the 64 parishes (what most folks call counties) in Louisiana. My farm pickup truck and I are on a mission to find every voter who wants accountability in D.C. In the words of country legend Eddie Rabbitt, "I'm driving my life away," blaring Zydeco on the road as I crisscross the state of Louisiana from one event to the next. And honestly, I'm loving every minute of it. | == This truck and I worked hard to come out of the runoff in a landslide leading in every parish with 80% of the vote. We made history. A Black person has not been elected statewide in Louisiana since Reconstruction. But I didn't run to make history; I ran because I know from firsthand experience what so many Americans are going through. We aren't stopping or slowing down now - this freedom ride has only just begun. My name is Jamie Davis. Our victory shocked the nation--and the pundits in Louisiana. I'm a successful third-generation row crop farmer farming over 3000 acres, the same land my grandfather once worked as a sharecropper - only now we own it. James Carville was so inspired by our runoff that he said Democrats now have a "fighting chance" to flip Louisiana's open US Senate seat blue. A Democrat won this Senate seat in 2008 and in 2026, we are going to do it again. But we have to work for it. I put 30,000 miles on my truck to hear what voters have to say, and I've got to report back: they are pissed off and ready to fight for the soul of this nation. And I'll drive 100k more to find every single person--whether Democrat, Independent, or Republican--who is sick of MAGA ruining our country and wants a new direction. == | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | It's me, a pickup truck, and over 57,000 real people who have given what they can versus the MAGA machine. That’s what your support powers, Peter.

Jayapal HQ

name: Autism Health
subject: Join Us for Our Upcoming Cocktails for A Cause!
body:
** Join Us! Cocktails for A Cause Fundraiser
------------------------------------------------------------

We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health Inc. on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA.

Sponsored by Cellular Performance Institute, this special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, inspiring presentations from featured speakers (to be announced), and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences.

Tickets are $85 per person, and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health Inc.’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions.

We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://givebutter.com/cocktails-4-a-cause?gbtid=6973b353-2ebb-4a2b-be6f-b0a7a0f1fab1&mc_cid=1d349be106&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Don't Miss the Premiere of SHINE!
------------------------------------------------------------

If you've followed the work of filmmaker Mikki Willis, you won't want to miss this special event.

At just 14 years old, Azai Willis has created his second film, SHINE, an award-winning documentary short that asks a powerful question: What if your thoughts and choices were never fully your own? In just six minutes, SHINE explores what may be contributing to the growing depression, anxiety, and disconnection that so many young people are experiencing today and challenges us to rethink what has become accepted as normal.

The film recently won Best Documentary Short at the Santa Monica International Film Festival and is now being made available to the public for the very first time.

Today, June 30th, Mikki Willis will host a free live premiere of SHINE, followed by a candid father and son conversation exploring the inspiration behind the film, the challenges facing today's youth, and the importance of critical thinking, connection, and purpose. The event will also include a live Q&A session with the audience.

This will be the first opportunity for anyone outside the festival circuit to view the film. Reserve your free seat today and be part of this important conversation.

Register using the link below.
REGISTER HERE (https://mikkiwillis.com/shine?mc_cid=1d349be106&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Summer Movie Fundraiser
------------------------------------------------------------

Looking for a fun way to support Autism Health this summer? We are excited to partner with GroupRaise and Regal Cinemas for a special fundraising campaign that allows you to enjoy a night at the movies while supporting a great cause.

For just $30 per order, you'll receive a Regal Movie Ticket Bundle that includes two Standard 2D Movie Tickets, redeemable at any Regal theater location nationwide. Best of all, 20% of every purchase will be donated to Autism Health Inc. to help support our educational programs, support groups, webinars, scholarships, and research initiatives.

Did you know that many Regal Cinemas locations also offer Sensory Friendly Screenings? These special screenings are designed to create a more comfortable movie-going experience for individuals with autism and sensory sensitivities, making this fundraiser even more meaningful for our community.

Whether you're planning a family outing, date night, or looking for a unique gift, your purchase helps advance our mission of serving individuals and families impacted by autism and related neurological conditions.

Campaign Ends: Monday, August 17, 2026

Thank you for supporting Autism Health Inc. Every ticket bundle purchased helps us continue making a difference in the lives of families around the world.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://www.groupraise.com/offer-campaigns/78957-autism-health-inc-regal-fundraising-campaigns?mc_cid=1d349be106&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** AHS Recordings Now Available Online
------------------------------------------------------------

Missed the Autism Health Summit or want to revisit your favorite presentations? We are excited to announce that the full 3-day recordings from the Autism Health Summit are now available for purchase online.

This year’s Summit featured an extraordinary lineup of physicians, researchers, advocates, and thought leaders discussing emerging science, integrative approaches, environmental factors, clinical insights, and practical strategies for individuals impacted by autism and neurological conditions. Now, you can access these powerful presentations from the comfort of your home and learn at your own pace.

We are offering two recording options:
• General Recordings for parents, caregivers, and community members
• Professional Track Recordings for medical professionals seeking to earn 10.5 CME credits

Whether you attended the conference in person or could not join us in San Diego, this is an incredible opportunity to gain access to valuable education and expert insight from the Autism Health Summit.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=1d349be106&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Please Vote for the 2026 Author of the Year

We are honored to share that Tracy Slepcevic, Co-Founder and President of Autism Health Inc., has been nominated for the 2026 Author of the Year award through the International Impact Book Awards.

Tracy’s bestselling book, Warrior Mom: A Mother's Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism, has inspired and empowered families around the world through her heartfelt story of perseverance, faith, and determination as a mother navigating the autism journey. More than just a memoir, Warrior Mom has become a trusted guidebook for parents seeking hope, practical insight, and encouragement while advocating for their children.

The book has received praise from many respected voices, including the endorsement from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who described Warrior Mom as:
“An inspiring testimony to the miraculous power of maternal love.”

We would deeply appreciate your support in helping recognize Tracy’s impact and dedication to the autism community. Voting closes on August 31, 2026, and every vote makes a difference.

Learn more about Warrior Mom at: www.WarriorMom.com (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/links.givebutter.com%2Fengage%2F6byg%2FDE11Lyr/b43o/BmPGAQ/AQ/1abccffb-3e4a-488d-baf3-12655ba05bc5/5/CWQPtVft0S?mc_cid=1d349be106&mc_eid=UNIQID)
VOTE HERE (https://apply.internationalimpactbookawards.com/public-voting-form?mc_cid=1d349be106&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=1d349be106&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

name: Office of the First Lady
subject: News from First Lady Dawn Moore
body:
| | | | Hello Friends and Fellow Marylanders, Over the last few months, our administration has traveled thousands of miles around the state highlighing the work we’ve done together to uplift our communities and deliver results for our people. As First Lady, I’ve had the chance to celebrate the opening of a free grocery store in Prince George’s County; showcase our state’s equestrian history and culture with Preakness Festival 151; honor a Maryland family’s rich culinary legacy in Catonsville; and read to nearly 100 students and their families at Government House for the #ReadMoreMaryland Summer Celebration. I truly cherish every opportunity I have to see firsthand the progress we've made as a state in the last three years. Thank you all for taking this journey with us, and continuing to partner with our administration to leave no one behind. Take Care, **First Lady Dawn Moore** |
* * *

## **KEEPING UP WITH**
# **THE FIRST LADY**
[](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fleadership%2Ffirst-lady%2Fpress-releases%2Fgovernor-and-first-lady-moore-host-young-marylanders-readmoremaryland-campaign/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/h9zwI6WLPrJ0wDiUHTIbhYtk4gdPYvrB-q7vvN5V7Ko=452)
###
### **[Governor and First Lady Moore Host Young Marylanders for ReadMoreMaryland Campaign Summer Reading Celebration](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Flinks-1.govdelivery.com%2FCL0%2Fhttps:%252F%252Fgovernor.maryland.gov%252Fleadership%252Ffirst-lady%252Fpress-releases%252Fgovernor-and-first-lady-moore-host-young-marylanders-readmoremaryland-campaign%2F2%2F0100019f13a720c9-3c997888-7d67-4915-a051-829ee294c5f3-000000%2FB769ntXlIHEvmu8CcBEuYLH0WNLmO7YnK1Mve7VDurw=452/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/pexw_3KtqDtAttU5IBXYuHsPRCi5S7CmNM2SeMtemeQ=452)**
Governor Wes Moore and First Lady Moore hosted nearly 100 young Marylanders and their families for the #ReadMoreMaryland Campaign Summer Reading celebration at Government House.
Each student invited participated in the statewide [#ReadMoreMaryand literacy campaign](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fleadership%2Ffirst-lady%2Fpress-releases%2Ffirst-lady-moore-launches-readmoremaryland-campaign-advance-literacy-among-maryland-students/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/EtoYMYfMzVE7-Vaddn4pua5THuGr4FjYRDZN4raYVbw=452), which aimed to inspire Maryland students to read. In partnership with the [Governor’s Office for Children](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgoc.maryland.gov%2FPages%2Fhome.aspx/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/3uSEeKGjudeMmITCrBrHEkOmh0zTqkEgcJqQOfbNKbU=452) and the [Maryland State Department of Education](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.marylandpublicschools.org%2FPages%2FDefault.aspx/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/Kqz-9xBOk7295z_vSQTYbUZpttucZz3FwxCgF-2mwGA=452), the campaign reinforces the Moore-Miller administration’s commitment to education and advancing literacy among our Maryland students.
During the celebration, students enjoyed story time with the governor and first lady, fossil discovery with the Maryland Natural History Society, a coloring station provided by Crayola, and activities organized by the Maryland State Library Agency. Each student took home an age appropriate book and resources to inspire them to continue reading this summer.

###
### [First Lady Moore Receives the Lillian Miles Lewis Luminary Award from the John and Lillian Miles Lewis Foundation](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.flickr.com%2Fphotos%2Fmdgovpics%2Falbums%2F72177720334028439%2F/2/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/KjyyIXFwOD3RevuxBYfydf_dF8xTBeS0eN6do9qv958=452)
In honor of her leadership, service, and commitment to expanding opportunity, First Lady Moore received the Lillian Miles Lewis Luminary Award from [The John and Lillian Miles Lewis Foundation](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.johnandlillianmileslewisfoundation.org%2F/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/NbcmOj4far1yrfjyLLIemmHI7TnWVM1CcyvBDufUJ7w=452).
At the annual Good Trouble Gala, she delivered remarks recognizing the extraordinary contributions of Lillian Miles Lewis and the Moore-Miller administration's commitment to serving our communities and leaving no one behind.
The gala welcomed over 400 leaders, advocates, elected officials, philanthropists, and supporters to Washington, D.C. to celebrate the movers and shakers who are keeping the legacy of John and Lillian Miles Lewis alive.
