###
### **[Preakness Festival 151 Expands Impact into New Communities While Uplifting Maryland’s Horse Racing Industry](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.preaknessfestival.com%2F/2/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/VgU3JyWsKbEwxKM7tTeYwZtID1dgpJ-Nssbq2FeE5vY=452)**
Under the vision of First Lady Moore, the Preakness Festival expanded its impact by partnering with [Prince George’s](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwtop.com%2Fprince-georges-county%2F2026%2F05%2Ftheyre-not-horsing-around-saddle-up-for-preakness-day-in-prince-georges-co%2F/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/X1YdNn7wgEhBVkLTS4hL4NilTqPgBCEsDVIxuu7mze0=452), Howard, and Anne Arundel counties to celebrate the 151st running of the Preakness Stakes at Laurel Race Track.
Preakness Festival 151 hosted events and co-branded experiences including: [Maryland Horse Farm Tours](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.wbaltv.com%2Farticle%2Fmaryland-horse-farm-tour-equine-champions-ahead-preakness%2F71219528/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/VMThlqzaOEMLDG3n20ZmvUjqWpv3J40IopbZ9YrxI5Y=452), Governor’s Classic Golf Tournament, [Prince George’s County Toast to Preakness Brunch](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.flickr.com%2Fphotos%2Fmdgovpics%2Falbums%2F72177720333604775%2F/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/Dv4majpUh0Bs1apY06vJ0QyvSgtXv-Bp3mH5V5HH55U=452) and [Brian Westbrook Foundation’s Youth Equestrian Expo](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.brianwestbrookfoundation.com%2F/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/G5emQ1GqZVrVZHceoD0hsxZTU60kBa006D6ftgWSLL0=452).
The Preakness Festival is gearing up for the Preakness Stakes’ return to Pimlico Race Course in 2027. The Moore-Miller administration has invested $400 million into renovations at Pimlico and for the Park Heights community.
The Moore-Miller administration remains committed to growing the Preakness Stakes and enhancing its status as a premier event in the Triple Crown.
This month, Governor Moore [announced](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2Fgovernor-moore-announces-maryland-exercise-right-first-refusal-acquire-preakness-intellectu/1/0100019f199875b6-a7c2fffd-81a5-4139-8450-f3eefd888981-000000/Jevgl2OxV9ENqNr6Q-iIQ4Pl4AGKq3vpatZAajumjwo=452) that the state of Maryland is exercising its right of first refusal to match the $85 million offer made by Churchill Downs, Inc. to acquire the intellectual property (IP) rights to the Preakness Stakes and the Black-Eyed Susan. By exercising this right, the State will secure ownership of these iconic racing assets, ensuring that Maryland remains in firm control of the state’s multi-billion dollar horseracing industry for decades.

## **Delivering For**
# **MARYLAND

clean_body: | | | | Hello Friends and Fellow Marylanders, Over the last few months, our administration has traveled thousands of miles around the state highlighing the work we’ve done together to uplift our communities and deliver results for our people. As First Lady, I’ve had the chance to celebrate the opening of a free grocery store in Prince George’s County; showcase our state’s equestrian history and culture with Preakness Festival 151; honor a Maryland family’s rich culinary legacy in Catonsville; and read to nearly 100 students and their families at Government House for the #ReadMoreMaryland Summer Celebration. I truly cherish every opportunity I have to see firsthand the progress we've made as a state in the last three years. Thank you all for taking this journey with us, and continuing to partner with our administration to leave no one behind. Take Care, First Lady Dawn Moore | KEEPING UP WITH THE FIRST LADY Governor Wes Moore and First Lady Moore hosted nearly 100 young Marylanders and their families for the #ReadMoreMaryland Campaign Summer Reading celebration at Government House. Each student invited participated in the statewide , which aimed to inspire Maryland students to read. In partnership with the and the , the campaign reinforces the Moore-Miller administration’s commitment to education and advancing literacy among our Maryland students. During the celebration, students enjoyed story time with the governor and first lady, fossil discovery with the Maryland Natural History Society, a coloring station provided by Crayola, and activities organized by the Maryland State Library Agency. Each student took home an age appropriate book and resources to inspire them to continue reading this summer. In honor of her leadership, service, and commitment to expanding opportunity, First Lady Moore received the Lillian Miles Lewis Luminary Award from . At the annual Good Trouble Gala, she delivered remarks recognizing the extraordinary contributions of Lillian Miles Lewis and the Moore-Miller administration's commitment to serving our communities and leaving no one behind. The gala welcomed over 400 leaders, advocates, elected officials, philanthropists, and supporters to Washington, D.C. to celebrate the movers and shakers who are keeping the legacy of John and Lillian Miles Lewis alive. Under the vision of First Lady Moore, the Preakness Festival expanded its impact by partnering with , Howard, and Anne Arundel counties to celebrate the 151st running of the Preakness Stakes at Laurel Race Track. Preakness Festival 151 hosted events and co-branded experiences including: , Governor’s Classic Golf Tournament, and . The Preakness Festival is gearing up for the Preakness Stakes’ return to Pimlico Race Course in 2027. The Moore-Miller administration has invested $400 million into renovations at Pimlico and for the Park Heights community. The Moore-Miller administration remains committed to growing the Preakness Stakes and enhancing its status as a premier event in the Triple Crown. # [AI jobs debate flips as biggest spenders hire faster than everyone else](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A Ramp and Revelio Labs report shows companies spending 30 dollars per employee monthly on AI **[saw headcount rise 10.2% and entry-level roles increase 12%](https://substack.com/redirect/f1a976f5-a730-472c-a791-628385312be3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in tech-forward firms countering broad job loss fears.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Growth Across Functions:** Headcount rose in engineering sales administration customer service finance marketing and scientist roles with strongest gains in the information sector including software and tech firms.
* **Not Universal Creation:** Report admits findings do not show AI universally creates jobs but counters claims of broad losses noting skew toward VC-backed knowledge-work companies already expanding.
* **Entry-Level Resilience:** In high-intensity adopters entry-level headcount rose 12 percent despite Goldman Sachs data showing 16,000 net AI-related jobs erased monthly hitting Gen Z hardest.
* **Expansion Tool Effect:** AI lowers production costs for code debugging tools and documentation raising returns to expanding the entire firm rather than substituting labor.

# [Waymo and Uber abruptly kill Phoenix robotaxi pilot after intense learning phase](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Waymo and Uber **[confirmed the end of their limited Phoenix robotaxi pilot program](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd163e9-fcac-4432-b6ce-89095c9945df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd163e9-fcac-4432-b6ce-89095c9945df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with the dozen vehicles now shifting to autonomous deliveries for DoorDash while Waymo expands exclusive partnerships elsewhere.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Limited Deployment Learned:** Phoenix served as a first pilot market with an intentionally small deployment of just over a dozen vehicles helping Uber scale quickly in Austin and Atlanta with hundreds of vehicles.
* **Fleet Remains Active:** The Waymo vehicles deployed in Phoenix will continue operating there making autonomous deliveries via DoorDash which competes with Uber Eats.
* **Waymo Leadership Holds:** Alphabet-owned Waymo operates about 4,000 automated vehicles across the U.S. with exclusive Uber availability in Austin and Atlanta and own-app use in nine other cities.
* **Future Partnerships Planned:** Uber will partner with another AV company in Phoenix while Waymo plans Lyft integration in Nashville this year without exclusivity.

# [Brutal contrast: 65 years to save for NYC home down payment versus just 4 in the Midwest](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A Rocket report reveals a median-income household[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/084f0651-58c9-4b17-b64f-7dfec8b7587e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[needs 65.2 years to save for a down payment in New York City](https://substack.com/redirect/084f0651-58c9-4b17-b64f-7dfec8b7587e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** compared with just 3.1 years in Warren Michigan highlighting stark regional housing affordability gaps.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Fastest Savings Cities:** Detroit, Warren, Indianapolis, Milwaukee, Virginia Beach, Fort Worth and Jacksonville allow saving the median down payment in under five years due to low home prices and percentages.
* **Coastal Extremes Hit:** San Francisco requires 57.2 years and Los Angeles 41.5 years with median prices at $1.5 million dollars and $883,000 dollars respectively demanding 27 to 30% down payments.
* **Down Payment Percentages:** Median first-time buyers put down 30% in New York 27% in San Francisco and above 20% in Boston San Jose Washington D.C. and Austin.
* **Lower Options Help:** Conventional loans allow as little as 3% down while the national median first-time buyer put down 10% last year shortening save times.

# [Japanese yen plunges to dangerous 1986 lows triggering intervention panic](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* **Finance Minister Statement:** Satsuki Katayama confirmed the government stands ready to take appropriate steps against excessive moves and decisive action coordinated with the U.S.

# [Massive Chromebook graft exposed sending ex-education minister to prison for a decade](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Former Indonesian Education Minister Nadiem Makarim co-founder of Gojek received a 10-year prison sentence fine and massive restitution order[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/41ea6c9a-9324-472a-8650-12b2f942d2f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[for corruption in the Google Chromebook procurement for schools.](https://substack.com/redirect/41ea6c9a-9324-472a-8650-12b2f942d2f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/516ac4df-04c1-4619-9c8a-3d2975b931d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Procurement Favoritism:** Makarim met Google representatives and issued specifications matching only ChromeOS despite prior assessment that Chromebooks were unsuitable for remote regions.
* **Pricing Overcharge Alleged:** Lower-specification Chromebooks costing about 3 million rupiah were procured at around 6 million rupiah each with alleged conflict from Google investment in Gojek.
* **Prosecutor Demands Higher:** Authorities sought 18 years and 5.6 trillion rupiah restitution but the court imposed 10 years 1 billion rupiah fine and 809.6 billion rupiah restitution.
* **Google Denies Wrongdoing:** The company stated investments in Gojek occurred before Makarim's appointment and denied offering benefits for product adoption.

body:
Dear Peter,

I know you've been hearing from us a lot these last few days. That's because we're closing our fiscal year in the next few hours—and our 5X match ends at midnight.

[**The future of reproductive rights is being decided right now.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/134329612/630895229/-1451183686?sourceid=1151436&utm_campaign=26emige-0615aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=nancy&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOTRjZjQ5NS1hYTc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dmivL_bDruPSF_O0zA_Q8YXZ0TARtUVKKDeBfKWKnR0=&emci=19bc0773-1a70-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=a94cf495-aa74-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=954237) We could see a future where women are treated as second-class citizens—where decisions about their health and their lives are made by politicians, not by them.

Or we could fight back. And build a future where reproductive rights are recognized as human rights. Where every person has the power to shape their own future.

I know which future I'm fighting for. And I think you do too.

Peter —
Alex Vindman here. I have a last-ditch request for you before my official FEC deadline ends tonight at midnight.
The Senate majority will come down to my election in Florida. The most recent polls have this race within the margin of error. I am MAGA’s #1 target, which is why they are already spending money to pummel me with attacks.
I know in my bones that we can defeat Donald Trump’s handpicked candidate and protect our democracy. But it will take the largest grassroots movement that this state has ever seen.
I need your help.

#
# **Pennsylvanians Deserve a Higher Minimum Wage**
****
Senator Hughes joined fellow Senate and House Democrats at the Capitol [to call for action on legislation that would raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17716).
Pennsylvania's minimum wage has remained at **$7.25 an hour since 2009** , while neighboring states have increased their wages over the years.
Senator Hughes urged Senate Republicans to bring [House Bill 2189](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17717) up to vote. This legislation would gradually **raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour** over the course of three years.
The bill passed in the House in May and just needs to be voted on in the Senate so it can be signed into law by Governor Shapiro.
Senate Democrats are ready to vote for a minimum wage increase to give workers the raise they have been waiting for, for over 15 years.

* * *

[](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17718)
_**Everyone says affordability is the number one issue. The easiest way to address that issue is to be like New York, to be like New Jersey, to be like Maryland, to be like Delaware, to be like West Virginia, to be like Ohio. They 've already raised their minimum wage. **_
_**- Senator Hughes**_

* * *
The push to raise the minimum wage is part of the Senate Democrats' broader [Affordability Action Plan](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17719), which highlights legislation and budget items meant to support working families that are struggling under President Trump's affordability crisis.

* * *

**Stay in Touch on Social Media**
If you haven't visited Senator Hughes' [Facebook page](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17720), join the conversation by 'liking' the page and following our office on [X](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17721), [Bluesky](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17722), [Instagram](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17707), and [TikTok](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17709). We have lots of information available on these pages about community events and issues affecting our district.
If you have questions or concerns, send us an email at [hughes@pasenate.com](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172004.172406.220&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17710).

Peter, it’s Marni von Wilpert. Truth to Power said I could reach out with big news on this race.
Now that I’m the official nominee, this campaign is entering a new era. I want to reintroduce myself and explain why I’m running and what this campaign is about.
**[But first, can you split a $5 donation between me and Truth to Power before our end-of-quarter deadline on June 30th to finish the work we started with Prop 50 and flip CA-48 blue?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260630_1_ak.J5N4w_&refcode=em20260630-41498&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41498%2E3422442%2Elhjtsg)**

I’ve spent my career in public service.
After college, I joined the Peace Corps. When I returned, I founded a legal clinic to help people living with AIDS access life-saving care in Deep South Mississippi. Later, I became a federal labor attorney, where I helped write the PRO Act to make it easier for workers to unionize and unrig our economy.
I know how to beat the Republicans and flip competitive seats. I did it on the San Diego City Council, and in office, I worked to ban untraceable ghost guns to keep our schools safe, and opposed utility rate hikes that hurt working families.

name: Amy Friedman, Team Gina
subject: An important memo on the Texas governor’s race →
body:
The environment is here for Texas Democrats. Now we need the resources to match it.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter. It's Amy, Gina’s campaign manager.
I want you to read something. I put together a memo on where this race actually stands — because I think a lot of national Democrats don’t have the full picture yet.
The short version: Greg Abbott is more vulnerable than he’s ever been, and Gina is building exactly the coalition that wins this race. But Abbott has $106 million and he’s planning to spend it to paper over his record and stop us from taking back Texas. We need the resources to fight back.
**[Read the memo. Or if you don’t need convincing, pitch in what you can now.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20260630_2_memo.B_-Meb&refcode=em20260630-1463&t=1&akid=1463%2E299639%2E8v2rFM)**
[Donate »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260630_2_memo.mLfrVr&amount=5&refcode=em20260630-1463&t=2&akid=1463%2E299639%2E8v2rFM)
=============================================================
**SUMMER 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV**
**FROM:** Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas
**TO:** Interested Parties
Let me tell you exactly where our race stands, and why the next few months are going to determine whether this is the year we take Texas back.

The Texas governor’s race has been in single digits for months, and it still isn’t getting the attention it deserves from national Democrats.
**The polls tell a consistent story: Abbott is in the weakest position of his career.**
* Recent polls confirm this race is closing fast:
* Texas Public Opinion Research (April 2026): Abbott 48–Gina 43, with Gina winning independents by 13, moderates by 32, and Latino voters by 22
* Somos Votantes (April 2026): Gina leads with Latino voters statewide
* A PPP survey found Gina tied with Abbott 48-48 in TX-23, a district Trump carried by 15 points.
* A three-term incumbent who cannot break 50% in any publicly released poll is an incumbent in trouble.

**Abbott’s war chest is a real threat — and it’s built on corruption**
* Greg Abbott entered 2026 with $105.7 million on hand. Nine figures.
* He didn’t build this by winning over working Texans. His top donors include oil executives, private prison owners, and data center developers — at a time when data centers are threatening to spike Texas utility bills.
* This is what pay-to-play governance looks like. Abbott has handed out $1 billion in no-bid contracts to his donors. He rammed through a $1 billion school voucher scam after receiving the largest campaign contribution in Texas history from an out-of-state billionaire.
* The Greg Abbott Corruption Tax is real — and Texans are paying it every time their utility bill, property tax, or grocery receipt arrives.

**After 12 years in power, Greg Abbott owns Texas’s problems — and they are serious.**
* Texas has the highest uninsured rate in the country (for adults and for children).
* More than one million Texas kids lack health coverage, and it’s getting worse.
* Abbott has refused Medicaid expansion for over a decade, leaving hundreds of thousands of Texans without coverage and billions of federal dollars on the table.
* Property taxes have increased 75% under Abbott. Texans pay the highest property tax burden in the state’s history. Abbott has said for years he’ll fix it. But it keeps getting worse.
* Abbott held public school funding hostage in 2023, refusing to fund classrooms unless the Legislature passed his voucher scam. School districts across the state have had to lay off staff, cut programs, and close schools as a result.
* Texas has had more major power outages than any other state. The grid failed in 2021, killing Texans. Abbott promised it was fixed, but problems persist.

**Gina has built something real — but we need more resources to carry her message forward.**
* Gina is running a people-powered campaign. Her average donation is under $50.
* She is winning key demographics: independents by 13, moderates by 32, Black voters by 57, Latino voters by 22, and voters 18-24 by 49.
* Gina is tied with Abbott in a Trump +15 district. She is cutting into Abbott’s base. It’s a sign she’s genuinely connecting.
* But $106 million is a lot of money. When that money hits the airwaves across the state, we’re going to need real resources to fight back.

**Texas Democrats are positioned to win.**
* All the warning signs are flashing for Republicans – not only are they trailing in polling, but they are losing special elections left and right this year in historically deep red areas of Texas, where Democrats are turning out to flip school board seats, county commissions, and state Senate seats too.
* For the first time in years, Texas Democrats have candidates at the top of the ticket with real momentum in both the governor’s race and the U.S. Senate race:
* Gina is closing the gap in a state that hasn’t elected a Democratic governor for 30 years. Talarico has a small edge in the Senate race. The environment is here. Texas has a very strong Democratic ticket. Now we just need the investment to match it.

**The bottom line.**
* Greg Abbott is scared. He’s told his own donors he’s at real risk of losing seats statewide. His approval is at a career low.
* The coalition Gina is assembling: Latino voters, young voters, independents, moderates, working families across every corner of Texas — is the coalition that will win this race.
* This is Democrats’ best chance in 25 years to take back Texas. The coalition is here, the candidates are out front, working hard to carry their message to every voter. The environment is favorable. What determines whether we win is whether national Democrats decide Texas is worth the investment.
* **We can win this race if we all show up.**

=============================================================
Peter, I see the internal numbers, I hear from our organizers on the ground, I watch what’s happening with voters in every corner of this state. I know what this race looks like, and I’m telling you: We can win.
But not without you. Abbott is preparing to unleash his $106 million war chest. We need to be ready.
[**Will you rush a donation to Gina right now?** ](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20260630_2_memo.B_-Meb&refcode=em20260630-1463&t=3&akid=1463%2E299639%2E8v2rFM)
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260630_2_memo.mLfrVr&amount=5&refcode=em20260630-1463&t=22&akid=1463%2E299639%2E8v2rFM)
Thank you for being part of our campaign.
– Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas

Property taxes have increased 75% under Abbott. Texans pay the highest property tax burden in the state’s history. Abbott has said for years he’ll fix it. But it keeps getting worse. Abbott held public school funding hostage in 2023, refusing to fund classrooms unless the Legislature passed his voucher scam. School districts across the state have had to lay off staff, cut programs, and close schools as a result. Texas has had more major power outages than any other state. The grid failed in 2021, killing Texans. Abbott promised it was fixed, but problems persist. Gina has built something real — but we need more resources to carry her message forward. Gina is running a people-powered campaign. Her average donation is under $50. She is winning key demographics: independents by 13, moderates by 32, Black voters by 57, Latino voters by 22, and voters 18-24 by 49. Gina is tied with Abbott in a Trump +15 district. She is cutting into Abbott’s base. It’s a sign she’s genuinely connecting. But $106 million is a lot of money. When that money hits the airwaves across the state, we’re going to need real resources to fight back. Texas Democrats are positioned to win. All the warning signs are flashing for Republicans – not only are they trailing in polling, but they are losing special elections left and right this year in historically deep red areas of Texas, where Democrats are turning out to flip school board seats, county commissions, and state Senate seats too. For the first time in years, Texas Democrats have candidates at the top of the ticket with real momentum in both the governor’s race and the U.S. Senate race: Gina is closing the gap in a state that hasn’t elected a Democratic governor for 30 years. Talarico has a small edge in the Senate race. The environment is here. Texas has a very strong Democratic ticket. Now we just need the investment to match it. The bottom line. Greg Abbott is scared. He’s told his own donors he’s at real risk of losing seats statewide. His approval is at a career low. The coalition Gina is assembling: Latino voters, young voters, independents, moderates, working families across every corner of Texas — is the coalition that will win this race. This is Democrats’ best chance in 25 years to take back Texas. The coalition is here, the candidates are out front, working hard to carry their message to every voter. The environment is favorable. What determines whether we win is whether national Democrats decide Texas is worth the investment. We can win this race if we all show up. ============================================================= Peter, I see the internal numbers, I hear from our organizers on the ground, I watch what’s happening with voters in every corner of this state. I know what this race looks like, and I’m telling you: We can win. But not without you. Abbott is preparing to unleash his $106 million war chest. We need to be ready. Thank you for being part of our campaign. – Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas Email us: mailto:info@ginafortexas.com

But now the real fight begins.
This moment calls for steady leadership and a clear plan for what we build next in New Mexico. I’m ready to invest in strong public schools so every child can read earlier and thrive. Make childcare, housing, and everyday costs more affordable for New Mexico families. Bring career and trade pathways into schools as early as middle school so every student has a path designed for them. Give New Mexicans a raise and stand up for small businesses by cutting red tape and unnecessary barriers. Protect access to healthcare and strengthen resources in rural communities. And build safer communities by addressing the root causes of crime.
**That’s my vision: a New Mexico for all New Mexicans.**
Because while extreme Republicans and their allies push chaos, cuts, and division, I am doing something different. I am a leader who has lived the challenges working families are facing and knows what it takes to deliver real results. I’ve taken on tough fights before, and I know what it takes to win them. **But this race is bigger than any one person — and we’re going to win it the same way we’ve gotten here: Together.**
I’m ready for the road ahead: Ready to show up in every corner of New Mexico and make the case for strong public schools, affordable childcare and housing, lower costs for working families, and a healthcare system that actually works for everyone. clean_body: TKWhat this race will come down to Peter, it’s Deb Haaland. The general election is officially underway in New Mexico. I’m humbled, honored, and grateful to the thousands of people who have stepped up to power this campaign. But now the real fight begins. This moment calls for steady leadership and a clear plan for what we build next in New Mexico. I’m ready to invest in strong public schools so every child can read earlier and thrive. Make childcare, housing, and everyday costs more affordable for New Mexico families. Bring career and trade pathways into schools as early as middle school so every student has a path designed for them. Give New Mexicans a raise and stand up for small businesses by cutting red tape and unnecessary barriers. Protect access to healthcare and strengthen resources in rural communities. And build safer communities by addressing the root causes of crime. That’s my vision: a New Mexico for all New Mexicans. Because while extreme Republicans and their allies push chaos, cuts, and division, I am doing something different. I am a leader who has lived the challenges working families are facing and knows what it takes to deliver real results. I’ve taken on tough fights before, and I know what it takes to win them. But this race is bigger than any one person — and we’re going to win it the same way we’ve gotten here: Together. I’m ready for the road ahead: Ready to show up in every corner of New Mexico and make the case for strong public schools, affordable childcare and housing, lower costs for working families, and a healthcare system that actually works for everyone. ## Campaign Update
Nate Completes 12-County Town Hall Tour
* The Powell campaign wrapped up our two month Town Hall tour through all 12 counties in the district.
* As the final stops on the tour, last week Nate met with voters in Pomeroy and Davenport to discuss issues and hear residents' concerns.
* Nate summed up the tour by saying: "It was amazing to travel to every part of this huge and beautiful district. The really interesting thing I found is that despite significant diversity, from huge wheat farms to giant forests with logging to the urban center of Spokane, all the folks I spoke to shared the same concerns, that they are struggling withthe cost of living and are frustrated with the way the economy seems rigged against them".
* The campaign also had a booth at the Newport Rodeo, where attendees from all over the district learned about Nate and gave him a warm reception.
* Finally, in a packed week Nate attended a Meet & Greet at the home of Brian Parker and Leyna Bernstein in Spokane.

Every subscription helps us reach further, build something lasting, and keep these urgent conversations alive. We'd love to have you with us. Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/232153bf-f3a0-41c4-9146-9ecfa5854297?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

* * *
I'm standing in a diner parking lot in the middle of nowhere, Michigan. It's hot as hell, I just walked out of breakfast with my family, and I'm about to go kayaking with my kid -- which, for the record, matters more than anything I'm about to write. But I can't let this one go. Not today.
Because today the Supreme Court upheld birthright citizenship, and I'm grateful they did. I mean that. It's the right call. But here's the thing nobody wants to sit with: **it should have been nine to nothing.**
This was the easiest, plainest ruling any of these nine people will ever make. The 14th Amendment says what it says. A first-year law student gets this one right. A kid in a middle school civics class gets this one right. **The final vote was 6 -3** -- six justices upheld birthright citizenship, with Chief Justice Roberts writing the majority in genuinely beautiful language:
_" Citizenship, then and now, was the right to have rights--to freely participate in our political community. The Framers of the Fourteenth Amendment extended that promise to 'every free-born person in this land' [...] We keep that promise today."_
Great. Mean it. So why couldn't they all sign onto that sentence?
Because three of them -- _three_ -- couldn't get there. Three justices looked at the plainest words in the Constitution and dissented, essentially arguing that the President of the United States can narrow them by decree.
That is complete and total horseshit.
Brett Kavanaugh joined the majority to strike the order down -- good, credit where it's due -- but he dissented in part, and *how* he got there is the whole tell. Kavanaugh rested his vote on a federal law, not on the Constitution. Read that again. He would not say that the Constitution *itself* guarantees birthright citizenship. He needed a statute to lean on. And a right that only stands because Congress propped it up is a right that stops standing the day Congress -- or a president strong-arming Congress -- kicks the prop out. So count it honestly: **Three justices flat-out dissented, and a fourth voted the right way for the most dangerous reason on the menu**. The vote was 6-3. The rot is deeper than the scoreboard.
Just Imagine if Joe Biden was President and signs an executive order tomorrow that says, "There's no Second Amendment anymore. Nobody owns a gun, and I'm sending federal agents to come collect them." Imagine the meltdown. Imagine these same justices "discovering" the limits of executive power in about nine seconds flat. They would never let a Democrat do what they're carving out room for Trump to do. Never.
So no, I'm not spiking the football over a 6-3\. I'm telling you what the 6-3 _reveals._ Three justices would have let a president rewrite the Constitution outright, and a fourth thinks he can in principle. When four people on the highest court in the land are unable or unwilling to fully commit to the idea that a president can't erase the Constitution with a Sharpie, the court isn't a court anymore. It's an operation.
## **This was never just one ruling**
Once you see it, you can't unsee it. Because the same day, they gutted what's left of our campaign finance laws -- opening the door to complete and total coordination with party committees.
I've worked in this space for two decades. There used to be _rules._ Lines you couldn't cross. Now? Everybody's self-governing, which is a polite way of saying there are no rules at all. No guardrails. No checks on consolidated power.
And guess who that helps? It helps the billionaires. It helps Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, Sam Altman, and every oligarch who'd rather buy an election than win an argument. Every one of these rulings does the exact same thing -- it puts a little more distance between you and your own elected officials. Between you and your own power.
That's the throughline. That's the project. Birthright citizenship was the headline. The fine print is everything else.
Meanwhile NPR runs a story that Chief Justice Samuel Alito is finally retiring, then yanks it back an hour later, and now the whole internet is swimming in garbage information and nobody knows what's true. For the record -- selfishly -- I _hope_ Alito stays. I hope he's arrogant enough to cling to that seat the way Thomas seems determined to, so a Democratic president gets the pick. But that's a sideshow. The main event is the rot.
* * *

* * *
## **Don 't let them sell you the false equivalence**
Here's the one that's got them all mad at me. Justice Sonia Sotomayor -- a fantastic justice -- received something like $4,000 in Bad Bunny tickets from a record label which has the rapper as one of its clients. And Republicans are out here clutching their pearls, trying to tell you that's the same as Alito and Thomas taking lavish, all-expenses-paid vacations from billionaires like Paul Singer. People with actual business in front of the Court.
Give me a break. I said it on Twitter yesterday and I'll say it again: _when Benito has a case in front of the Supreme Court, then I 'll be worried about her tickets._ Ban all of it -- I don't think any justice should be taking that stuff. But don't you dare tell me a concert ticket and a billionaire buying influence over the people deciding his lawsuits are the same animal. They are not.
The right has built a whole religion around the Founders. They love to scream about the Founders.**** They do. "Oh, the Founders intended this. Oh, the Constitution, blah, blah, blah." They don't give a damn about the Founders. If they did, we wouldn't have a court where _three_ of the current justices worked on the Bush v. Gore side that stole the 2000 election from Al Gore. We wouldn't have a ruling that hands a president near-total immunity for crimes he commits in office. What world is that justice? Where did the Founders intend _that_?
They gutted the Voting Rights Act. They made gerrymandering easier than it's ever been. They kicked reproductive freedom back to the states, and more than half of states turned around and stripped women of rights they'd had for 50 years. And people are literally dying because of this. This isn't a philosophy. It's pure, outright power and corruption wearing a robe and wielding a gavel.
And make no mistake about where it's headed: a permanent oligarchy. The Epstein class. A political class that does nothing, that doesn't give a damn about you or me, locked into power for a generation. If Trump gets to appoint more of these justices -- if he builds a majority that genuinely believes a Republican president can rewrite the Constitution by decree -- then the president gets to do whatever the hell he wants. He basically already can.
You are less free than you were. Less safe. Less powerful. That's not opinion. That's the scoreboard.
So here's what we do about it:
The Republican Party is gone -- it's the party of Donald Trump now, and it exists to give him and his people unprecedented power. The only way they win is by cheating, and they will break every rule that's left to do it. The mid-decade gerrymandering. The SAVE Act. All of it.
And here's the hard truth for my own side: **we cannot keep playing by a different set of rules than these people.** We're the party that's supposed to care about ethics and morality and doing it right -- and that instinct is inherently good, but it's getting us slaughtered against an opponent that has no instinct at all except winning. Honor doesn't mean bringing a pamphlet to a knife fight.
So when we have the power, we must use it -- _relentlessly_. We expand the Supreme Court. We restore some basic semblance of justice and dignity and fairness to it. Not "reform" -- though I support reform -- but _expansion._ We put serious people on it. People who take the job seriously, who'll have a real debate about what the Constitution actually says and how it protects our freedoms, instead of operatives running cover for a party that has lost it's soul.
And the good news? More and more people get it. Pete Buttigieg gets it. Jon Ossoff gets it. J.B. Pritzker gets it. AOC gets it. There are real fighters out there, and there are more of them every single day. So when we get the chance, we don't flinch and we don't apologize for it. We bury these guys politically -- for a generation. To save the middle class. To save our democracy. To save the country.
That's the assignment.
But here's the most important thing I'll say all day. My son is out by the shoreline right now, beckoning me to get in the kayak. And I'm going to go.
Not because the fight doesn't matter -- it matters more than almost anything I can name. I'm going because the fight is _long,_ and the people on the other side are counting on exactly one thing: that we burn out. That we get cynical, throw up our hands, and decide it's all hopeless and rigged and there's nothing we can do. That's the whole play. Every ruling we just talked about is designed to make you feel powerless so you stop showing up. Don't give it to them.
So I'm going to go be a father for a few hours. Get on the water with my kid, and remember in my bones exactly what I'm fighting for. And then I'm coming back and getting right back to work -- and I want you to do the same.
That's the model. Love the people in front of you. Then fight like hell for them. And for the country they're going to inherit. Both. Always both. Burn clean, not out -- because a movement of exhausted, cynical people loses, and a movement of clear-eyed people who refuses to stop leaning into moments of joy -- no matter how big or small -- is unstoppable.
We expand the Court. We build a new party. We swing the pendulum back on these guys so hard they don't know what hit them. And we do it as whole people -- because that life on the water, with the people you love, _is_ the thing we're trying to protect.
Now go get in the fight. Then go get on the water.
God bless you guys. Love you. Happy Fourth.

subject: About what happened at SCOTUS

body:
Republicans and the far-right are already plotting how to take advantage.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260630-1&t=1&akid=3663%2E587540%2E7V4Q5G)
Peter,
**SCOTUS just blew the doors off campaign finance limits — and Republicans and the far-right are already plotting how to take advantage.**
Basically, the wall between candidates and unlimited party money just came down. By eliminating federal limits on how much a political party can donate to a candidate, billionaires and special interests just gained significant influence over our elections. Further, political parties can coordinate directly with candidates, granting parties more control in smoke-filled back rooms to pick the politicians they want, rather than letting voters pick their politicians.
**This is exactly the kind of decision that makes our work at Leaders We Deserve urgent.** It means our candidates, who rely on your grassroots support to compete, are about to be even further outgunned by corporate backed opponents.
**[Pitch in $5 now to help level the playing field for our candidates.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260630_1_scotus.WBo0xq&refcode=em20260630-3663&amount=5&t=2&akid=3663%2E587540%2E7V4Q5G)**
The court also upheld state bans on transgender athletes in girls’ and women’s sports, sending a brutal message to trans kids across the country. A decision like this sets a national precedent for how civil rights protections are enforced for trans students.
In one piece of good news, the court actually struck down Trump’s attempt to gut birthright citizenship. A massive win for millions of Americans — Trump’s mission to lay the legal groundwork to carry out his mass deportation campaign _failed._
**With millions more bound to pour into this year's elections, we need to be ready to fight back with everything we've got.**
This people-powered movement has already helped Leaders We Deserve take on the GOP and the establishment — but today’s rulings means we need your support more than ever.
**[SCOTUS just made tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline our most important one yet. Will you rush a $5 right now to power our work and help us elect the next generation of bold young leaders?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260630_1_scotus.WBo0xq&refcode=em20260630-3663&amount=5&t=3&akid=3663%2E587540%2E7V4Q5G)**

Today's landmark decision by the United States [Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/64121d5d-4c17-447a-9a31-4007306c28dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a major victory for fairness, safety, and the original intent of Title IX and allows states to protect women's sports and the Equal Protection Sports.
_**For too long, female athletes have faced the loss of scholarships, championships, medals, records, and competitive opportunities. This decision marks an important step toward restoring the level playing field that Title IX was created to protect.**_
As an eye doctor, this issue is deeply personal. Throughout my medical career, I have performed pre-competition physicals for athletes, including male and female boxers, and I understand that biological differences are real and have important implications for athletic competition and safety.
Our responsibility is to protect girls and women at every level of competition--from our youngest student-athletes competing in youth and school sports, to high school and collegiate athletes, and all the way through adult competition. Every female athlete deserves the opportunity to compete fairly, safely, and based on merit.
> _**This ruling helps restore opportunities that should never have been taken away. It means more young women can earn scholarships, stand on the podium, break records, and achieve their dreams through hard work and dedication.**_
As your Congressman, I will continue fighting to protect women's sports, preserve the integrity of Title IX, and ensure that fairness remains the foundation of athletic competition. Today's decision is a tremendous victory, but the work is not over. Congress must continue to strengthen these protections so they endure for future generations.
This is the fairness I am fighting for. This is the future our nation's girls and women deserve. And this is one of the reasons I am running to represent Connecticut's 4th Congressional District in Congress as Physician input is needed directly in Congress.
> **I hope this will encourage all Connecticut Residents to contact their state lawmakers and the Governor to protect women 's sports and restore an equal playing field and fairness in athletics.**
**Dr. Michael Goldstein**
Republican Endorsed Candidate for U.S. Congress
Connecticut's 4th Congressional District

SCOTUS just made life easier for MAGA billionaire megadonors

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oYWxleWZvcm1pLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.NTqOqPJbS32BMGFmBPerVJ6X0BjrfBR7TciK532-Fks?) for more

# [The Rules Just Changed](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=204288641&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA0Mjg4NjQxLCJpYXQiOjE3ODI4NDYxMzAsImV4cCI6MTc4NTQzODEzMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.aal3EsLAL_vkzmgrNe3YhpVXtPItS_gv3a0-WeoeMjM)
### SCOTUS just made life easier for MAGA billionaire megadonors
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jun 30
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL3RoZS1ydWxlcy1qdXN0LWNoYW5nZWQ_.kpTw-0tHs_L0oZb-GYe0dTnGe318DQEB0WBZStrC5u4?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/the-rules-just-changed?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

**This morning, the Supreme Court made it easier for billionaires and the GOP to work together to spend massive amounts for their candidates.**
In a case brought by the National Republican Senatorial Committee, the Court struck down a longstanding limit on how much money political parties can spend in coordination with a candidate.
That might sound technical, but it isn't. For years, there was a basic guardrail on the books: Party committees could help their candidates, but they could not coordinate directly with them to spend unlimited sums on their behalf.
This morning, the Court blew that guardrail to smithereens.
Now, super-wealthy MAGA donors have another way to pour big money into a campaign and gain more access to the people in power. **MAGA megadonors in this country just got a bigger, cleaner lane to buy influence with the politicians they fund.**
I'm going to be honest with you: This makes our work harder.
Here is what I need you to understand, though. This was not a surprise. And it was not the first time.
This is the Supreme Court that gave us _Citizens United_ , which opened the floodgates to unlimited corporate money in our elections. It is the same Court that just gutted a core protection of the Voting Rights Act and made it easier to silence Black voters through redistricting.
**Again and again, this Court takes power away from ordinary folks and hands it to the wealthiest and best-connected people in the room.**
Some MAGA Republicans will call this ruling a victory for free speech. They will say a megadonor's right to spend money was being restricted.
But a voter with a few hundred bucks in her checking account also has free speech. A single mom working the night shift has free speech. A retiree in Saginaw rationing his prescriptions has free speech.
The question this Court keeps answering the wrong way is whether those voices get to count at all - or _whether they get buried under those of people who can afford to write seven-figure checks_.
It's a recipe for corruption. That is democracy getting auctioned off, one check at a time.
What worries me most about today's ruling is what this means for Michigan. Our battleground race will likely decide control of the Senate, and National Republicans and their billionaire allies were already trying to buy this seat. Now the NRSC and the MAGA donor machine have even more room to flood Michigan with money for Mike Rogers and try to bury our grassroots campaign.
I know that can feel discouraging. This is a hard moment.
**But I was raised the Michigan way: Hard work doesn 't intimidate me.** Michiganders know what to do. We stand up. We get more dogged. We show up. And then we show up again and again and again and again.
Money can buy TV ads, Washington consultants, a mansion in Florida, and a closet full of nice suits. (Mike Rogers knows.) But it cannot buy a real record of fighting for working people. And it can't outwork a campaign full of people who are sick of watching politicians bend over backward to help the wealthiest Americans. It can't buy results for Michigan.
This campaign is powered by folks who chip in what they can, make calls after a long day, knock doors on the weekend, and believe Michigan deserves a senator who fights for the working people who actually live here.
That is our biggest advantage - and we are going to use it.
I am not backing down. I am not getting discouraged. And I am not going to let Mike Rogers, the NRSC, or the billionaire class buy this seat out from under the people of Michigan.
But I cannot do it without you.
So I'm going to ask for your help. **[Will you chip in $30 right now to help us fight back against the megadonor money flowing into Michigan?](https://substack.com/redirect/aacd2d3f-b6c6-4f9f-8bd9-01c03da4a57f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/aacd2d3f-b6c6-4f9f-8bd9-01c03da4a57f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Your contribution will go to help us knock doors, make calls, and build the kind of grassroots campaign that wins because regular folks showed up for one another.
We've got a tough fight ahead.
Good. We're tough, too.
Let's do it together.
With grit,

Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/aacd2d3f-b6c6-4f9f-8bd9-01c03da4a57f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

It's PRIMARY DAY!
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
🇺🇸 Thank You, Colorado! What a weekend!

Thank you to everyone who joined us at the Rocky Mountain Voice Freedom Festival to celebrate America's 250th Birthday and Colorado's 150th Birthday. From the inspiring speakers and incredible entertainment to the rodeo, Family Fest, and thousands of patriots who came together, we couldn't have asked for a better celebration.

We're grateful to our team, speakers, sponsors, volunteers, vendors, and every attendee who made this event such a tremendous success.

If you missed it—or just want to watch your favorite speaker again—stay tuned! We'll be releasing speaker videos soon and launching a dedicated section on our website where you can catch up on all the highlights.

Thank you for celebrating with us. Now it's back to the newsroom as we bring you comprehensive coverage of Colorado's primary election today...

**🗳️ It's Primary Day in Colorado**
Today is the deadline to return your Colorado primary ballot. Republicans will choose [nominees in key statewide races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—including governor, attorney general, U.S. Senate, and several contested legislative primaries—while Democrats are voting in closely watched races that could reshape the direction of their party. _**Polls and official drop boxes close at 7 p.m.**_ , and ballots must be received by then. Before you vote, check out [RMV's complete voter guide](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and election coverage on [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) tonight! **[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, June 30, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[They almost stayed home: What a Douglas County couple took away from RMV's Freedom Fest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
By Saturday morning, Russ and Deb Minary were home, a refrigerator due to be delivered and an ordinary weekend resuming around them. They couldn’t stop replaying the day before. They almost hadn’t gone.
Their Friday had cleared at the last minute, and they drove over on short notice for day one of Rocky Mountain Voice’s two-day Freedom Festival, marking America’s 250th birthday and Colorado’s 150th.
“It’s frightening when you see how easily our elections are being changed and manipulated,” Deb said. “But it’s also encouraging to know there are people trying so hard to fight for our freedom.”
The day had split in two for them—what frightened them, and what gave them hope.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Volunteers bring America’s 250th birthday party to Grand Junction’s fairgrounds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Liberty on the Lawn was organized entirely by about a dozen volunteer community members with no major institutional backing, funded through public donations and local business sponsorships — a grassroots effort that coordinator Austin Dewitt hopes will remind Americans that "we share a lot more in common than we often realize."
* The free, family-friendly event runs seven hours at Mesa County Fairgrounds and features live music, patriotic karaoke, a cornhole tournament, food trucks, and meaningfully, historic Chautauqua reenactments and public readings of America's founding documents — keeping the focus on faith in country and civic heritage.
* The celebration ties into the congressionally established America250 commemoration and coincides with Colorado's own 150th anniversary of statehood, marking a once-in-a-lifetime convergence that local organizers, not bureaucrats, are stepping up to honor.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**

**[The SAVE Act is about citizenship not suppression](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | JUNE 26** _Today, many Americans across the political spectrum are uninformed and/or unfamiliar with the US Constitution and US legal code. Yet they want elections and election results to be fair and accurate. Confusion, division and conflict are common, often guided more by opinion or emotions, but not the truth or facts. Social or mainstream media will never be a substitute for primary research from reliable sources._
**[Initiative 195 would raise taxes on Colorado’s top earners. A new report asks whether they’d stay.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JUNE 26** _The income tax on a Colorado household earning under $25,000 would fall by $9 a year under Initiative 195. A filer reporting between $2 million and $5 million would pay about $13,914 more. Both figures come from the measure’s certified ballot title._
**[Colorado Secretary of State now prosecutes Pueblo Democrats in bingo finance case it dismissed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JUNE 25** _The Colorado Secretary of State’s office dismissed the complaint. Now, after a judge sent the case back, the state itself is the one prosecuting it. On June 15, the office’s Elections Division filed its own complaint against the Pueblo County Democrat Party. The complaint alleges the Pueblo County Democrat Party failed to report contributions and expenditures tied to its affiliated Central Committee and its bingo-funded headquarters._

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|

🧐**DID YOU KNOW?** Colorado is the only state in the country where registered unaffiliated voters automatically receive both a Democratic and a Republican ballot in the mail for the primary election. However, you can only fill out and return one of them; if you return both, neither will be counted.

name: ARI
subject: New data center playbook gives voters, officials advocacy tools
body:
| | Americans for Responsible Innovation
# The ARI Briefing
June 2026 | [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/4OdfR5qmGqo?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
---|---
Friends, June was a fast-paced month for AI policy, with legislative action on AI-enabled surveillance, movement on legislation enabling AI research, and more. But before we dive into what's happening in Congress, this month's newsletter takes a closer look at an issue that's gaining attention in towns and neighborhoods across the country: data centers. This week, ARI launched a new [Data Center Playbook](https://us.list-manage.com/kNQEqQtiPlc?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) to help communities navigate one of the fastest-moving forces in the country: the data center boom. As facilities go up at a record pace, residents and local officials are often caught off guard by impacts to their grid, energy costs, and their neighborhoods. The Data Center Playbook puts practical tools in the hands of voters and local officials.
| Lead Story * Data Center Playbook
## Behind the Build: A Field Guide for the Data Center Boom
---
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/1AUZEXgsG1e?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
ARI's new playbook, [_Behind the Build: Grid Mitigation & Data Centers_](https://us.list-manage.com/1BXWdHdoZ2Q?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf), is a practical field guide for communities navigating the data center boom: residents, county officials, state lawmakers, civil society groups, and federal policymakers. Whatever outcome a community is hoping for, the playbook lays out the tools to secure local benefits, hold down utility costs, and bring transparency to the process. Data centers can generate substantial tax revenue and jobs, but only when governments require transparency, make developers pay for the infrastructure they need, and secure enforceable community benefits. The playbook explains where those tradeoffs come from and what communities can do about them. It also collects real examples of communities leading successful advocacy efforts: West Des Moines, where officials negotiated more than $2 billion in tax revenue; Port Washington, where residents passed a ballot measure giving voters a say over future incentives; and Pima County, which capped NDA terms and now discloses active agreements quarterly. Each comes with concrete tactics, from public records requests to public utility commission interventions and enforceable community benefit agreements.
[Explore the Playbook ->](https://us.list-manage.com/1CmtC1UqFt3?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
| 🔒 Civil Liberties
## A Coalition Warning: Don't Let AI Supercharge Surveillance
---
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/cwThXdWyM4F?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
As Congress considers the reauthorization of FISA, ARI joined a broad coalition of civil rights, privacy, and tech groups urging Senate and House leaders to [close surveillance loopholes](https://us.list-manage.com/Gpwt2Y9XKqe?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) before AI makes them far more powerful. In letters sent to the leaders of the Senate Judiciary and Intelligence Committees, the coalition called on Congress to include a warrant requirement for accessing Americans' communications and to close the data broker loophole. FISA Section 702 lets the government surveil foreign targets abroad, but it can also sweep up Americans' private communications, a concern that grows sharper as agencies adopt AI that can analyze, aggregate, and weaponize sensitive data at a scale never possible before. [Research shows](https://us.list-manage.com/10wUfNBTH6y?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) AI can compress into seconds what would take a human investigator hours, assembling granular portraits of individuals' lives through inference, pattern matching, and data fusion.
| "Americans should not have to surrender their constitutional rights because surveillance tools have become faster, cheaper, and more powerful. If Congress fails to act now, AI will not just expand existing privacy violations, but will make them harder to detect, easier to scale, and far more dangerous to democracy."
---
[Read the Coalition Letters ->](https://us.list-manage.com/15ehbxIsWuE?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/fPD9LwNIwhq?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
For more on the debate over AI and privacy, check out ARI's new policy byte, [_Congress Can Ensure AI Doesn 't Turbocharge Mass Surveillance_](https://us.list-manage.com/1BMCUQAAjR6?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf). The piece makes the case that the bipartisan, bicameral Government Surveillance Reform Act is the strongest reauthorization vehicle on the table, because it closes both the "backdoor search" loophole in FISA Section 702 and the "data broker" loophole that lets the government buy sensitive data it would otherwise need a warrant to obtain. [Read the Policy Byte ->](https://us.list-manage.com/174iRZtssTy?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
| 📈 Research & Innovation
## CREATE AI Act Clears Committee 29-0
---
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/10hoBeUfj7l?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
AI research and development requires access to expensive datasets, compute, and other tools that currently only a handful of major technology companies can afford. That's where the CREATE AI Act (H.R. 2385) comes into play. The CREATE AI Act would permanently establish the National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource (NAIRR) and passed the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology in a unanimous vote last week. ARI [applauded](https://us.list-manage.com/17JDacJBb7b?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) committee passage of the CREATE AI Act, cheering the work of NAIRR to democratize the development of AI technology. Piloted over the past two years by the National Science Foundation, NAIRR provides datasets, cloud computing, AI testbeds, software, and educational tools as a shared national resource. Codifying NAIRR would give universities, nonprofits, and researchers the tools to pursue new breakthroughs.
| "As AI reshapes America, we need to make sure more Americans have a seat at the table shaping the future of AI. The CREATE AI Act puts the tools for AI research into the hands of students, researchers, and entrepreneurs across the country." -- ARI President Brad Carson
---
[Read ARI's Full Statement ->](https://us.list-manage.com/i4yuEwBMfY2?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
📚 Also This Month
## NDAA Movement
[Senate NDAA Draft Strengthens Human Oversight of Autonomous Weapons.](https://us.list-manage.com/11uAt5GNtON?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
ARI welcomed the Senate's draft National Defense Authorization Act, which would require Pentagon review and verification of AI models, privacy impact assessments, and an incident repository to track when AI-enabled systems fail. President Brad Carson called it an initial step toward deploying AI in military operations safely and securely. A recent [national poll](https://us.list-manage.com/JgaGdIE6i7t?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) from ARI finds that 75 percent of Americans believe decisions about lethal force in war should involve meaningful human judgment, not AI alone.
From the nation's grid to the nation's Capitol, we're here to keep you informed about developments in AI policy. For more news and analysis, please be sure to follow ARI [on X](https://us.list-manage.com/jKykIsz0tU6?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) and on [LinkedIn](https://us.list-manage.com/x31KtLiVCD0?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf). Thank you for reading, sharing, and staying engaged. Onward, The ARI Team
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/iZkhXMEPdw5?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/eDEVe7ADQZ6?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/JzWL7fQP_LN?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
---

If Congress fails to act now, AI will not just expand existing privacy violations, but will make them harder to detect, easier to scale, and far more dangerous to democracy." For more on the debate over AI and privacy, check out ARI's new policy byte, . The piece makes the case that the bipartisan, bicameral Government Surveillance Reform Act is the strongest reauthorization vehicle on the table, because it closes both the "backdoor search" loophole in FISA Section 702 and the "data broker" loophole that lets the government buy sensitive data it would otherwise need a warrant to obtain. | 📈 Research & Innovation CREATE AI Act Clears Committee 29-0 AI research and development requires access to expensive datasets, compute, and other tools that currently only a handful of major technology companies can afford. That's where the CREATE AI Act (H.R. 2385) comes into play. The CREATE AI Act would permanently establish the National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource (NAIRR) and passed the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology in a unanimous vote last week. ARI committee passage of the CREATE AI Act, cheering the work of NAIRR to democratize the development of AI technology. Piloted over the past two years by the National Science Foundation, NAIRR provides datasets, cloud computing, AI testbeds, software, and educational tools as a shared national resource. Codifying NAIRR would give universities, nonprofits, and researchers the tools to pursue new breakthroughs. | "As AI reshapes America, we need to make sure more Americans have a seat at the table shaping the future of AI. The CREATE AI Act puts the tools for AI research into the hands of students, researchers, and entrepreneurs across the country." -- ARI President Brad Carson 📚 Also This Month NDAA Movement ARI welcomed the Senate's draft National Defense Authorization Act, which would require Pentagon review and verification of AI models, privacy impact assessments, and an incident repository to track when AI-enabled systems fail. President Brad Carson called it an initial step toward deploying AI in military operations safely and securely. A recent from ARI finds that 75 percent of Americans believe decisions about lethal force in war should involve meaningful human judgment, not AI alone. From the nation's grid to the nation's Capitol, we're here to keep you informed about developments in AI policy. For more news and analysis, please be sure to follow ARI and on . Thank you for reading, sharing, and staying engaged. Onward, The ARI Team | (C) 2026 Americans for Responsible Innovation 750 17th St NW, Suite 1200, Washington, DC 20006 • •

BREAKING: Today, the Supreme Court affirmed the constitutional right to birthright citizenship and struck down President Trump’s executive order that attempted to end it.
This is an enormous victory, and a historic, important, and critical day for our country.
Birthright citizenship is foundational to American democracy, and today’s ruling reaffirmed an enduring promise: if you’re born here, you belong here.
It upholds the principle that every child born in this country is entitled to the same dignity and protections as every other child under the law. And that every child born here has a personal stake in the American dream.
It’s unconscionable that just hours after swearing to uphold the Constitution, President Trump attempted to rewrite the clear text of the 14th Amendment with an executive order. For more than 150 years, this right has been settled constitutional law – and courts have repeatedly affirmed it – including the Supreme Court today in a 6-3 opinion.
Today’s decision reaffirmed that it’s the Constitution that governs this country, not a President. Donald Trump is not a king.
This victory also underscores the vital role that states play in defending our democracy and Constitution. I will continue to fight against tyranny in all its forms, and I remain vigilant, ready, and prepared to act.
Taking on this administration takes resources, so I’m asking for your help to power this work before tonight’s end-of-quarter filing deadline. Will you chip in any amount to my re-election campaign so we can keep this fight going? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]

If you are with VoteVets and the countless Veterans who are organizing against the Arc de Trump... we need your help.
#
10 years ago, Congress passed a bipartisan bill to plan for the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. They appropriated millions of funds. States, cultural organizations, museums, branches of government — they all put together plans that would honor America’s founding for weeks.
A celebration by all Americans, for all Americans.
Then, Trump got elected. And he killed it. He co-opted the entire celebration. He turned it into his own show, starting with that UFC fight on the White House lawn, and ending with a campaign speech before the fireworks on the National Mall.
And if all of that wasn’t enough, he put up his version 1.0 of his ridiculous arch.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-june26.aning7&refcode=em260630-1-120&t=1&akid=35290%2E3013755%2EA7yAuP) **And it looks like absolute trash.**
Think about that arch, but 250 feet tall, towering over our most sacred national cemetery, severing the link between the Lincoln Memorial and the hallowed ground where fallen Americans from the Civil War forward rest.
It’s a travesty. It’s an insult. It’s an eyesore. And it has to be stopped.
If you are with VoteVets and the countless Veterans who are organizing against the Arc de Trump... we need your help.

name: Paul Barringer
subject: I need your help - tonight!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Paul Barringer for Congress
body:
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=20260630hdr [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=20260630hdr]
Hello Peter,
Tonight at midnight marks our biggest fundraising deadline yet. And I need your help, because this could literally make or break our campaign.
See, my opponent, Brad Knott, is being funded by million-dollar MAGA PACs and far-right extremist groups. I’m relying on grassroots support from everyday people just like you, Peter.
But the numbers we report to the FEC tonight will be the deciding factor for a lot of folks about whether this is a serious campaign, and whether they should invest in this race. So we need to show them that NC-13 should not be counted out, because we deserve better.
I am running for this seat because Republican leadership has left rural communities like ours out to dry for far too long. We know that we need to fix how Washington works for us, and that starts by restoring discipline to our fiscal policies, standing up to party bosses and billionaires, and working to bring costs down across the board.
I think that’s a pretty great place to start. But that’s only possible if we have the resources we need to reach voters across the district, and that depends on showing the entire nation that we have real grassroots strength. This fundraising deadline is crucial, and we need all the support we can get to reach our goal tonight.
Can I count on you to please make a contribution to my campaign before midnight tonight? Whatever you can afford will help us be able to report a strong fundraising total so we can flip this seat. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=20260630bdy]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barringeremails?refcode=20260630btn]
Talk more soon,

{First Name or 'Friends'}, these are the most consequential midterm elections in our country’s history, and there is no path to a Democratic majority without re-electing Suhas Subramanyam in VA-10.
That’s why we set a goal of raising another $10,000 before the Federal Election Commission filing deadline — so we can build the grassroots foundation Suhas will need to win big in November and help flip the House. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/suhas-em]
After less than two years of this GOP trifecta in Washington, we’ve seen our democracy start to circle the drain. We’ve seen our President spend billions to bomb Iran while claiming we don’t have enough money to fund Medicare and Social Security. We’ve watched him fight for vanity project after vanity project — including $600 million for his gilded ballroom (half of which will come out of taxpayers’ pockets!). And don’t get us started on the reflecting pool debacle.
Meanwhile, Democrats are trying to lower costs, protect our rights, balance the budget, and pass policies that actually make life better for the American people.
This November, we can make a strong statement about who we are as a country. We can take our power back as a people. And we can win. But we need to put in the hard work right now if we want to do it.
Will you chip in just $10 today to help us reach our FEC deadline goal and get ready to re-elect Suhas and win big in November? We have $1,592 left to raise to meet our goal, and less than 9 hours left to do it. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/suhas-em]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/suhas-em]
Every dollar you give today helps us communicate with more voters, organize more volunteers, and build the campaign we'll need to win this November.
Thank you for stepping up!
—Team Suhas
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/suhas-em]
Congressman Suhas Subramanyam has dedicated his life to public service.
