Trump cast the gathering as a launching pad for the next chapter of American greatness, tying it to the nation's ongoing 250th anniversary celebrations. Trump congratulates Xi Jinping for birthright citizenship victory in SCOTUS The Supreme Court upheld birthright citizenship Tuesday in an opinion authored by Chief Justice John Roberts, ruling that children born on US soil are American citizens under the 14th Amendment regardless of their parents' immigration status. The decision struck down President Donald Trump's executive order attempting to end the practice. The President responded in classic Trump fashion: A frustrated Trump wrote on Truth Social shortly after, " I would like to congratulate President Xi, and the Great Country of China, on their massive Birthright Citizenship WIN!" Trump 's post mocks the alarming practice of "birth tourism"; wealthy Chinese nationals who travel to the US specifically to give birth and secure citizenship for their children. He called the outcome "too bad" for the country but immediately pivoted to urging Congress to pass legislation ending birthright citizenship, arguing no constitutional amendment would be necessary. Justice Brett Kavanaugh partially concurred and partially dissented, suggesting Congress could change the outcome through legislation. Justice Clarence Thomas dissented sharply, accusing the majority of repurposing the 14th Amendment beyond its original intent. Read More: The Capitalist 2 hours ago 82 likes Brooke Brandtjen GOP rebellion halts Save Act in the House More than a dozen House Republicans procedural votes Tuesday, freezing legislative business in protest over the Senate's failure to act on the SAVE America Act, Trump's top legislative priority requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote. The 198-224 procedural vote failure, with 14 Republican defections, effectively shut down the House floor ahead of the July 4 recess deadline. Speaker Mike Johnson attempted to appease the holdouts by proposing to attach the SAVE Act to the must-pass National Defense Authorization Act, hoping bipartisan support for the defense bill would force Senate action. Conservative rebels largely rejected the approach, arguing it wouldn't guarantee a Senate vote and demanding the measure be embedded as an amendment rather than paired legislation. Despite sharp criticism from both Trump and Johnson, the rebel faction, including Reps. Luna, Boebert, Roy, and Massie, defended their tactics as legitimate legislating rather than obstruction. Charlie Kirk's parents, widow expected to attend murder trial hearing date Charlie Kirk's widow Erika, his parents, and other family members are expected to attend the preliminary hearing scheduled for the week of July 6 in the murder case against Tyler Robinson, according to a source familiar with the matter. Kirk, the founder of Turning Point USA, was fatally shot while speaking at Utah Valley University on September 10, 2025, leaving behind his wife, two young children, parents, and a sister. Robinson's defense team previously sought to delay the proceedings and secured a postponement from the hearing's originally scheduled May dates before Judge Tony Graf. Hi Peter,

I’ll be upfront: I'm about to ask for your support. But before you close
out of this email, give me one minute. 🙏 I think what I'm about to share
is worth your time.

A general poll came out recently, and here’s what it shows:

* Mallory McMorrow vs. Mike Rogers: 41-47, losing...
* Haley Stevens vs. Mike Rogers: 41-45, losing...
* Abdul El-Sayed vs. Mike Rogers: 47-42, winning! ✅

We’re the only campaign in this race who beats Mike Rogers in November.
Every other candidate loses — and it's not close.

Now, I don't want to come off as overconfident. But I do want to be
straight with you about what this means, because I think it's important:

* Michigan is the epicenter of the battle for the soul of the Democratic
Party. If we screw it up here, we’re doomed elsewhere. We are the key
swing state with a competitive primary to determine who’ll fight Mike
Rogers for a must-win U.S. Senate seat. And right now, the data says
there's only one campaign who can actually send Mike Rogers packing
back to Florida.
* AIPAC knows we're the strongest campaign in this race. That's exactly
why it's already spending tens of millions to take us out before the
primary. AIPAC wants to nominate a Democrat who votes at times like a
Republican, who schmoozes with corporate PACs, and who will
undoubtedly depress Democratic voter turnout in November.
* This is a do-or-die moment for our campaign and the odds of keeping
this Senate seat out of Donald Trump’s hands. Today is the last day of
the last quarter before our primary election. It's one of the most
important fundraising moments of this entire primary. The numbers we
report after tonight tell political pundits, our opponents, and the
national press whether our people-powered campaign has what it takes
to go the distance.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260630-5-ak.WtM9Ev&amount=10&refcode=em20260630-2495&t=1004&akid=2503%2E251025%2EXJBxYp ]If you can afford it, please pitch in $10 or any amount
before midnight. I’m the only candidate in this race who’s never taken
corporate PAC money and never will, meaning I’m truly relying on support
from people like you to fuel our campaign through the final stretch of
this primary race.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260630-5-ak.WtM9Ev&amount=10&refcode=em20260630-2495&t=1023&akid=2503%2E251025%2EXJBxYp ]Donate $10 ››

I can’t thank you enough for taking the time to read this. I know it was
long, but I hope it left you feeling hopeful for what’s to come.

In solidarity,

Abdul

Small shifts in participation can decide who controls the House
#
Peter,
If we’re going to flip the House this November, it’s going to happen because we showed up and did the work early.
House Republicans are vulnerable, and we’re within striking distance of winning a Democratic majority. But **close races don’t just flip themselves.**
Voto Latino is going all in on early groundwork and voter mobilization efforts — because we know the Latino vote will be the determining factor in whether we can regain a Democratic majority in the House this November — or not.
To fully fund this work, we’ve set a critical **$30,000 goal by tonight at midnight** — and right now, we are almost to our goal, but we need _one last push_ to cross the finish line.**If 12 people from your area pitched in before midnight, we’d definitely reach our goal.**
[**Peter, will you rush in $3 right now to power Voto Latino’s voter mobilization efforts and help us reach our goal?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260630-2.9ikZDv&amount=3&refcode=em20260630-328&t=1&akid=328%2E1366028%2EnqZ5cD)
**This year, we are focusing our voter registration and organizing work across nine critical states: Arizona, California, Colorado, New Mexico, Nevada, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia.**
These are states where _small shifts_ in participation can decide who controls the House, who represents us, and what gets done for our communities.
**We are organizing across 22 target congressional districts in these nine states** to protect Democratic incumbents in swing seats and flip vulnerable GOP-held seats, while continuing to build statewide engagement that lasts beyond a single election.
**But this kind of work takes resources.**
Training volunteers, printing materials, setting up tables and supplies, knocking on doors, and persuading voters. All of this requires time and resources, which is why we could use your support today.
**[So what do you say? Will you chip in $3 right now to give us the push we need to reach our goal so we can power voter registration and voter outreach in these 22 target districts across 9 states?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260630-2.9ikZDv&amount=3&refcode=em20260630-328&t=2&akid=328%2E1366028%2EnqZ5cD)**

Thank you for your support,
Voto Latino

I didn’t run for Attorney General because it was easy. I ran because I knew what was coming — and I knew Arizona needed someone in this office who would not flinch.
I was right about what was coming.
In the last few months alone, I have watched this administration attempt to seize Arizona’s voter data. I have seen the Supreme Court gut a key provision of the Voting Rights Act, opening the door to discriminatory maps across the country. I have watched Pete Hegseth try to criminally charge our U.S. Senator, Mark Kelly, for reminding service members of their oath. And just last week, Donald Trump promised to deploy a self-described “Election Integrity Army” to every state in America — with Arizona squarely in his crosshairs.
This is not a coincidence. This is a coordinated assault on the foundation of our democracy — and it is happening right now, in real time, months before a midterm election that will determine the balance of power in this country.

Hi, the Supreme Court just issued the worst ruling for campaign finances since Citizens United and changed the playing field for the rest of our election.
I’m alarmed. Angry. Worried about what comes next. But I’m also reminded of just how important this Senate race is – and what could happen to our country if we fail to win it this November.
**Let me be very clear:** The reason we have an ultra-conservative majority on the Supreme Court right now is because of President Trump and his Republican allies in the Senate.
Trump always set out to stack the Court with justices who would help him rewrite our laws for the benefit of billionaires and corporations –** and the Republican Senate majority has bent the knee, ready to confirm his judicial nominees who promise to do exactly that.**
Now, they’re making the American people pay the price. This latest Republican power grab gives the big donors who fuel the Republican party even more power in races like ours. They’ve already committed over $100 million against me, and that amount is about to skyrocket.
I know that at times like this, it’s easy to feel hopeless – like we have no power to change anything at all. But the _opposite_ is true. We have an incredible opportunity to change the course of our democracy and flip the Senate, and it lies right here in Ohio.
**With experts saying that this race could decide Senate control, a win here would mean taking back the majority. Regaining control of the judicial nominee process. Undoing the harm that Trump and Republicans have caused and pushing for more, for better.**
And given that there are reports coming out about potential Supreme Court retirements over the next two years, the stakes truly couldn’t be any higher.

body:
Dear Peter,
Right now, working families are struggling. The cost of living is too high, housing is unaffordable, and healthcare and child care bills are cutting deep into already tight budgets.
When I ran for governor, I made sure our campaign focused on solving these exact issues. When supporters saw us standing up for them, they had our back. Our campaign raised over $10 million— _all while refusing donations from corporate PACs._
We proved that when Democrats talk about the issues that matter most to working families, the people will show up. When I look at the candidates running across the country, I see so many other leaders carrying on that same fight. They’re running to lower costs and kick corporate money out of politics.
**I founded Truth to Power to make sure these types of candidates have the resources they need to win where it matters most.** We ensure the candidates we support can organize, reach voters, and get their message out far and wide before polls close.
The midterm elections will be here before you know it, and these candidates need to make the most of every single day. Truth to Power is ready to support them, but we can’t do it without you.

| | Friends,
This race is heating up, and it’s becoming clear that Bill Foster realizes he finally has serious competition. But his campaign spending can’t hide the fact that many voters are frustrated by his lack of visibility, his absence from the district, and his failure to deliver the leadership we deserve.
Bill Foster’s campaign is fueled by contributions from corporate interests, university elites, and the far-left political establishment. 51% of his contributions come from out of state, the two biggest locations being California and New York. Two very liberal far-left states.
My campaign is different.
From day one, I’ve built the campaign around the people of Illinois’ 11th District - not special interests. Every conversation, every local meeting, every event, and every mile traveled has been focused on listening to hardworking families and fighting for common-sense solutions.
Now I need your help.
Our second-quarter fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight. The numbers we report will determine how seriously national Republican organizations and other supporters view this race. A strong showing sends a powerful message that this district is competitive and ready for new leadership.
If you’re able, please consider making a contribution of [**$5**](https://us.list-manage.com/3hVJWDZzabe?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20), [**$10**](https://us.list-manage.com/13qYBMYLR7T?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20), [**$25**](https://us.list-manage.com/MhzeIS2qkct?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20), [**$50**](https://us.list-manage.com/RTphymvPKjP?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20), or whatever you can afford. Every dollar makes a difference, not just because it helps fund our campaign, but because it represents another hardworking American who believes it’s time for change.
Our goal is to raise [**$100,000**](https://us.list-manage.com/koFIEEkugnH?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20) by midnight tonight and we are getting close. With your support, we can show that this campaign has the momentum, the grassroots support, and the determination to beat Bill Foster.
Thank you for believing in my campaign and for standing with me. Together, we can bring common-sense leadership back to Illinois’ 11th District.

Peter, I'm not
going to sugarcoat it.

We watched immigrants get ripped from their families. We watched voting
rights get carved up to keep MAGA in power. We watched working people get
squeezed while billionaires wrote themselves another tax cut.

And yet — here we are. Still in it. Still refusing to quit.

That’s because of you and this grassroots movement. The people who show up
when it counts and don’t ask for anything in return except that we keep
fighting no matter what.

Alexandria, Ilhan, Rashida, and I are still in the fight. And we’re not
backing down.

We are in the thick of primary season right now — and the Squad is headed
to our ballots. These are not hypothetical races or distant elections.
They are happening, they are real, and the outcome is going to depend on
whether this movement shows up with the resources to match our conviction.

The establishment and our opponents have money, corporate backing, and
billionaire donors who will do anything to silence our voices. What we
have is each other — and a grassroots base that has never once let us down
when the moment called for it.

Tonight, at midnight, our end-of-quarter deadline closes. We need to hit
$255,000 to determine what we can do in the weeks ahead. More organizing.
More voter outreach. More making sure our Squad — who refuse to sell out
to corporate interests — has what they need to win.

The Squad Victory Fund doesn't run on corporate money or billionaire
checks. It runs on people like you deciding that this is the hill worth
standing on.

I believe this is that hill. I know you do too.

Derek, I’m really
sorry to bug you again, but Pennsylvania is squarely in Donald Trump’s
sights.

Last week? He traveled to Pennsylvania to rally support for his disastrous
agenda.

And my opponent – who cannot name a single issue where she disagreed with
Trump – was right there in lockstep. Make no mistake: If she wins this
race, she’ll rubber-stamp Trump’s agenda here in our Commonwealth, period.

Now, our End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline is just hours away, and we’re
still falling a little bit short. Here’s the good news: If you’re reading
this email just a few minutes after it hit your inbox, your donation could
literally be the one that puts us over the top.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/3185?t=1001&akid=105%2E245147%2Enl0sgT ]So what do you say? Will you rush your first donation of the
year right now?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

We beat Trump’s handpicked candidate in 2022 because so many folks like

Josh Shapiro

| It's Sue. I'm writing this a few hours before our fundraising deadline because I wanted to reach out one last time personally. By midnight tonight, we'll close the books on the most important public filing of this campaign. Soon, everyone will be looking at the numbers and drawing their conclusions about where this race stands. And my team will be forced to make decisions about where we put our dollars this summer as we head towards the primary (that feels like it’s coming up so fast). But tonight, I'm thinking about something else. I'm thinking about all the people who have gotten us this far. The volunteers who have knocked doors. The supporters who have hosted events. The people who have chipped in $5, $25, or whatever they could afford because they believe Rhode Island can do better. This campaign has never belonged to consultants or political insiders. It belongs to people who believe our state deserves leadership that shows up, takes on our hard challenges, and fights for working families. That's what makes me so proud of what we're building together. If you're able to make a contribution before midnight, I'd be incredibly grateful. You can use this link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sue_juneeoq#chip-in**](https://sue4ri.com/l/XcerAe3Qu4LT) Thank you for being here. It means more than you could possibly know. — Sue

# Know An Outstanding High School Student?
Encourage Them To Apply For The 2026 Patriot Games —◆— Ages 14–17 | National Competition
**Apply TODAY!**
Dear Friend, Know an outstanding high school student? Encourage them to apply for the **2026 Patriot Games** — a national athletic competition built to spotlight the best of the next generation of Americans. | | [ Apply Now! ](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
---
| [](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

Applications are now open for the 2026 Patriot Games, a national athletic competition built to spotlight outstanding high school students from across the country. If you know a student between the ages of 14 and 17 who has what it takes, share this with them and encourage them to Apply TODAY!
Freedom 250 is seeking outstanding young Americans from states, territories, and tribal nations to participate, inspire, and show the character and determination that define the next generation of American leaders, competitors, and champions.
Selected students will compete in a series of high-intensity challenges designed to test strength, speed, agility, teamwork, resilience, and leadership.
To apply, students should submit eligibility information using the link in this email. Selected applicants will advance through additional screening and verification rounds before finalists are chosen.
[Apply Now! Share this application link with any outstanding high school student you know and encourage them to apply for the 2026 Patriot Games.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

Competition Format | A series of high-intensity challenges designed to test strength, speed, agility, teamwork, resilience, and leadership

The 2026 Patriot Games are designed for students who want to do more than compete. If you know a student who should be considered, please share the application link and encourage them to apply today.

Hi, Peter – it’s Becca.
I had a few moments to sit down and take a breath. We’ve been hitting the trail pretty hard, but I wanted to take a moment to send a quick note to you, because it’s important.
I don’t like asking for money, but we need to show our grassroots strength — that Wisconsinites are ready for new, people-powered leadership. This FEC deadline is one of our biggest chances to do just that.
We’re so close to reaching our end-of-quarter goal — just $2,057 to go. It’ll only take a handful of folks chipping in before midnight to get us across the finish line.
So before this quarter ends, I have to ask: will you make a contribution right now to help us finish strong and stay on track to flip WI-03? [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q2-2026**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134358723/630961367/-521162218?refcode=em-6.30.26-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjZlZjZlYi1kYTc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oX7d8E7mt_-VQyDstPK7VoF3WPAmDijDtAJgw7eHNHs=)
With a big showing tonight, we can make clear to Derrick Van Orden that we mean business – and that the people of WI-03 don’t want a bully representing them any longer.
And unlike his elite-backed funding, this campaign isn’t powered by the billionaires or super PACs trying to hijack our government. It’s powered by folks like you – hardworking people hungry for pragmatic leadership in Congress. More security and less chaos.
Every dollar helps us connect with more voters, hold Van Orden accountable, and keep this campaign grounded in the real needs of working families.
Will you chip in a contribution before midnight? Any amount will help us meet our goal and win back this swing seat. Here’s the link again: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q2-2026**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134358724/630961368/-521162218?refcode=em-6.30.26-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjZlZjZlYi1kYTc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oX7d8E7mt_-VQyDstPK7VoF3WPAmDijDtAJgw7eHNHs=)

name: eric sorensen (personal)
subject: The power of your support
body:
Hi Peter, I’m glad I caught you before June comes to a close.
My team and I have been in touch quite a bit lately, but I assure you we only do it because it’s completely necessary as we approach a crucial fundraising deadline.
Tonight at midnight, we’ll report our second quarter fundraising numbers to the FEC – making them public for all to see, including our opponent in IL-17, "100%" Trump backer Dillan Vancil, and the Republican leadership trying to unseat me.

Birthright Order Struck Down
The Supreme Court closed its term with a blow to President Trump, [striking down](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L2OpDAQBOCngcyopw0GAgeXkM2lFyLjn6HnDLb8s6z26VczyeYbl1Sq-v7d17siT-fjrzqsTMWtJpi1pHpEH7LNG6WyJ3rsRVOhrxUBBQPBOKynX2-tkUYbddOtlbdxwknwHud2l7MagE8GjBhwAMXRTCNuAJvZxCZgakm-qkBwQD4Ajh0opwDncRj6mQsHTQ_K21S6ZGPdPGl1FpX_u5C07XQ4Wi_3UmJu-J8GlwaX67o6Fz5Pe-VX3uASg6dCOje4vB-xXJ2zKbNDPUNiucZkD8t0qKkwY51VhT1rLqRtZjXuwRv2A8DeAvbMO8U2SRMv8p6yGJseHoci_15VfoH4IfE7AAD__8Pphbs) his executive order ending birthright citizenship for the children of illegal and temporary immigrants in a 6-3 decision. Chief Justice John Roberts wrote the majority opinion, while Justice Brett Kavanaugh supplied the sixth vote on statutory grounds without reaching the constitutional question. Justices Thomas, Alito, and Gorsuch [dissented sharply](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1urDAQhZ_GdF4NYzBL4eI2dHvblMhrm2WU4Udjkyh5-gia9GmmGemc831vj_HhiWl9_fdLclKmMW5xLHIsO2855SdJmYVecwlU6HtEQKvBagPjymNdRRdD9HWokqu7O96tabCvZtdCW3fGThhijdCY0GH77MEG26Qaoq3InVFgDaBpAbsb-MkD9l3bNr2xE6gGPCcpN0n78WQKfi0-v0-bhHQL21Kxm0vZszL_FA4Kh-iJv4JnTnL-FQ5ng8IBzmNA4ZCPXdKSdNgOKfqizPoXUV-Mac0z7XqTmETLccpROFTi4v5JzJRtpxp4LZ742lH-oO3D4U8AAAD__yl2fG4), warning the ruling cheapens American citizenship. Trump called the outcome disappointing but pledged to [turn to Congress](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LHynCAQx_GnwY4bXBC9giKN3T9tSgdhlU0QHMAzk6fP3DXp039nZz-_H1_Ll6VIaf9uDzSlbYvPfmnlOs6YK9aVSguF9tAcNfqzgADNheZSLCkufeeNd972rkPTjxNMWip4dsFM6-h1r9Qmt1VLq6cVrFJ-VAhymMatI_M-JbQUIAcB40PYzQp4jsOgnlJvgilhI5b2KHheayRnU7P115aLw4fLRxdNaO2sTH5jMDOY7_t-3LYGSnvLCX_bgxKWd8pgTnjXdxOoIQ_5qshgVlqKSfQM5g-Yn_TKrXKX016wVv4Pzz96TDXQyfMLS7BX5PU6Cx7IXb5K4wV_omuUE4O5K8afN8VIVY9Mif2wFD9ft_8Y-WXgbwAAAP__spKQLg) for legislation rather than a long constitutional amendment. Conservatives split immediately over whether ordinary legislation can succeed where the order failed. ★★★
Biological Men in Women's Sports Bans Upheld
In a major win for the right, the justices ruled 6-3 that states may [bar biological males](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L3unDAQBPCnMZ1PZm0MFC7S0F3alGixDaziD2SbEOXpo0uZ8l_P6KfR_Hivb6RA6fiO0ZvS9tVlt7Zyxyvk6utGpZ2FjrNZavRnBQGaC82lWFNY-84ZZx32tvOmHyeYtFQwd6cRUw9KS-vGESftBc6oBoAJpO8na4eOzIcSWgqQg4DxJXBHAfM4DGqWehdMCQy-tFfx170Fspga1p97Lta_bI5dMGdrV2XyG4OFwfI8z-vBelI6Wk7-N0ZKvnyqDJbkn8pgqfdVfPTc5rs0Bosa9NSP6v-E39eZg6t8w8Q3yiEfZDHw6BN_cvSp8nrl0j5kV4y7HgqBqh6ZEkdECv8Gti_8-cvA3wAAAP__NYuHBw) from girls' and women's sports, upholding laws in West Virginia and Idaho. Kavanaugh's majority opinion concluded the protections violate neither the Equal Protection Clause nor Title IX. The decision effectively [shields similar laws](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DturjAUBODVmM7IHPMsXNyG7r9tSnSwD2DFD2SbkGT1EVlCmqlG80nz9lpeaJ0N-3_0pFLZFhPNUtLlTxcz5dWmciS7H0XbYr8XENBz0XMpluCWpjLKaIONrkg1wwhjL1uYqkOhnsa26VpCo2nr10EMuK6NGWGc1lZ2lVXPlOilANkJGGqBGwqYhq5rJ9lvgrUCHaVSJzqv1VmNoWB-32LSVOvoK6eOUs7M5D8GM4P5vu_aoHVf2e4B3dNhMD8Kg1k8IQWDOV9nIk9cxysVni5HmcfAc8FC3OGdOX1qdxkbdu4p8C1Fz-_oKWSez5hKZjBXSZnzts7Z3A-sFbtH-ytW5Q8nfij4CQAA__-BGYKT) in roughly 25 other states and hands conservatives one of their most durable culture-war victories in years. West Virginia Attorney General John McCuskey [called it](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOpDAQRL8GMiNjGzCBg0smm0svRI1pBmtsjNrNsdqvX7H7B5uVVKoq1fv3nJ4QYthffyGhI16nJS8T05mOmAuWORBvFF4b-8Dhc1JS9UL2Qstpj1NbL27xC7S-RtcOVtleGzXWm5OrxVla722LozXgZ6-1H6wxLXTtAHVwd5XstVS6k2poJKwg1Th0nRl1v8rKSIhI3BAe5xyDh52hvNdMHhufUx3dxnyUSv-p1KNSj-u6mjV_7HiV26_UoxyZuNziPAgTCp9PYpHgjUXQed8WTLAXAbxFZCziygn3In6SNbnluEKMofRDZeQrQYjf2_wLVP-d-goAAP__Cfp8Hg) one of the most important rulings for women's athletics since Title IX's passage. President Trump cheered the result on Truth Social. ★★★
Party Spending Caps Struck
The Court also handed Republicans a campaign-season victory, voting 6-3 to [strike down caps](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGunDAQAL8GOiNjAz4KF2noLm1KtGcvsDpjW_YSknx9dO8TXj3SaDS_nusTKFDcf8KJtvC2-uRXLteZQ6pYX1T4KLQf7Ijp36qkmoSchJZrDGvfeuudh961aHvzUI9JD2puD6tgM8NgsIcenEbvDPQj4qyMMtOGuiX7UclJS6VHqUwnYQOpZjOOw6ynTTaDhICFu4L5egVyEBnqe0vFYefS2QZ7MOfa6B-NWhq13PfdbelPxLt-eKOWnAIxudqopV654InCpauwqFzojVX4dEcR6CQWGQr_FQ7ODLRHUTNGT3EXLqXiKQJTisJB9OSBsbbF-nxTCFQn0wxyP4HCVxZ_4-Jvq_4HAAD__ysyhrs) on how much party committees can spend in coordination with their own candidates. The challenge traced back to a 2022 lawsuit from then-Senate candidate JD Vance and GOP committees, who argued the limits [violated free speech](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFurDAQRb_GdCAzNmYpXLyGbl-bEg1mgFFsg2wTonx9tClTpr5XR0fn7Tk9kT3H7T8Gsqms03IsU0lXOP2RKc-cyp5424vjwl8TSDC1NLWSU_RTWy12cQu2riLb9g94GKVhqHa7Gnro2bSdWedB0jpAj-B67DSCcqgqti-UNEqC6iT0jcQVJQx91-lBmVUKLdFTKk2i85o9O4wF8_t6JEeNO0Ll7V7KmYX6J2AUMN733dyYd45bOSJ9YuBI6XUVMEa6s4AxX2eiQLU7rlQEjFoPfTfo30vtMJzIW6zzSXHhuNWeA5dcx5SdgLFKdjlv9p6z6YWWW0D2P1blDxE_LHwHAAD__0Dlg48). Kavanaugh's majority warned that weakened parties distort the political system. With the RNC holding a sizable cash edge over Democrats, analysts say the timing could [reshape midterm spending](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL_OnDAQxJ_GdD4tC5iPwkUaui9tSrRnr-9WWcCyzeXP00cXKS-QZpoZzYx-3z63TxKV4_GVdvalpS2ecWvl2rOeletdSnsWeTxbkCa_NwR0FpwdYDt067voY4jUh459P3_ghxtGXLqnjws5SKl3ARmHPkzLRPPo4A5EgDB24t9V4AbAYQKcb0CJAJd5msZlcAnMCKRc2q1wvu4qgY5G9Xs6S-BbOPdO_bO1XM3wxeBqcI0k-iuQKpe3b3B9Lxhc4S0DGFzrlQvvbMN5lWYTRy6kVmWXVm0-VZoEUpupNOFq-WfmI0q7Cv8LpeuIcjzsUWqwr2oTBzK4dsXH_ENUpbrZjPDYSfTvy_YfUF8e_wQAAP__P2GIEg) just months before the November elections.
